nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Jess.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, Hero.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You want to have that talk now?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sure...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll start, if you don't mind...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Go ahead...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I told you during the earthquake crisis that I was done doing everything you wanted...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You said you were done `obeying` me.
nodes.text_bbcode: You said you were done [color=#3b78e2][i]obeying[/i][/color] me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That might not have been the right word, but I meant the gist of it... I'm my own man now.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay. Is that it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... I... I feel like things have been awkward between us because I wanted to save Denni, but... But you didn't seem nearly as concerned about her.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know, Ben. I've been thinking about that a lot lately, and it's not that I didn't care about her or anyone else for that matter... I really did... I just...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I didn't want to lose you, Ben. And I haven't felt that way about anyone. `Ever.` I'm sorry if that made you think any less of me...
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't want to lose you, Ben. And I haven't felt that way about anyone. [color=#3b78e2][i]Ever.[/i][/color] I'm sorry if that made you think any less of me...

options.label: Don't you have more to say about me being my own man?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're threatening me with something I'm proud of.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You are?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I am. What's wrong with making changes? What's wrong with improvement?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well... People... People think you've gone too far!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let them think that. I'll just counter any smear campaign you come up with by saying that I believe in putting my best foot forward.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's what I've tried to do with my appearance, and that's what I'll try to do with the school...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hmph! Well, that's not the point anyway!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It isn't?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No! The point is... I will find `something` to use against you!
nodes.text_bbcode: No! The point is... I will find [color=#e23b3b][i]something[/i][/color] to use against you!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on, there's a reason you're still single!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm selective!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What about that shirt?! Is that supposed to be red? Look at `my` shirt! This is red!
nodes.text_bbcode: What about that shirt?! Is that supposed to be red? Look at [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] shirt! This is red!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: My family can't afford to just get me new clothes all the time, okay?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh... I'm sorry, Justin... I just got caught up...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No! That's okay! I don't need your pity...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I should have expected a personal attack from someone as superficial as you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I wish I hadn't said that...
Jessica walks away just as the guys reach Ben. Spencer pats him on the back!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You should have seen this guy during the earthquake! It was just like when Surf 'N' Turf Murph gave Tax Man Daniels the Eternal Steakdown!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I have no idea what you just said...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But oddly enough, I'm hungry.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think Spence is trying to say that Ben here was heroic...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Which is true! Ben, what you did really meant a lot to me and $ZOE! She's already baked over a hundred Ben-cakes in your honor.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was no problem...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And... Ben-cakes?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's just say I'm tired of eating your face...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Did `not` expect to hear that... Ever.
nodes.text_bbcode: Did [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] expect to hear that... Ever.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So are you going to run for President? You'd have my vote...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm... I'm not sure.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not sure? Do you know which girls would date you if you became President?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All of them! `Every` girl!
nodes.text_bbcode: All of them! [color=#e23b3b][i]Every[/i][/color] girl!

nodes.text: Hector points at girls as they walk by...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Her. Her. Definitely her. And her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... That last one was Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hi, Hecky!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, hey, Manda-Panda!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, my bad, not her. But you get my point!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I do, but I'm not really interested in dating a bunch of girls. I've already got Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She's... She's a girl, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think not running for office is the one thing about my high school time that I'm going to regret the most...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why would you regret that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I see the changes Justin's made for the school, and I wish I could have contributed something like that. Something that'll last even after I'm gone.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... Regret? After you're gone? You're...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm graduating this year.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, wow... It's hard to believe that's actually happening. Twin Branches is going to be so weird without you around.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm still trying to figure out just what schools I'm going to apply to! Centerscore University's nice, but I might actually be able to get into Kingston on a football scholarship!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Kingston? That's an Ivy League school on the East Coast! That'd be awesome!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know, but it would also mean leaving the city of Centerscore, leaving my family, and then there's $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh... Yeah...
The bell rings. As the guys head off to their classes, Spencer pulls Ben aside.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's this about you not running for President, Kale?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Eh... I keep thinking you were right about what you told me before the earthquake... That I was only running for President because I was obeying Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Good. You're not whipped anymore!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... Then again, I still have this strong urge to run, and I'm not sure why...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Am I still just doing what she wants? Or do `I` really want to run?
nodes.text_bbcode: Am I still just doing what she wants? Or do [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] really want to run?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale, you're too smart. You're all up in your head, man.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know! How do I get out?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I think the only thing you can do is talk to Jessica... And that means...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm really glad I'm not you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, thanks. I guess I'll talk with her at lunch today...
Later that day, Ben is in the line for lunch when Justin sidles up next to him...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Justin. Weird that we have to eat here while the cafeteria's under construction, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Look, I'm not here to make small talk, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: There's a rumor going around that you're planning on running for President.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not sure if I am.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Never mind. If you run, I'll have to bring everything I've got against you. And that includes airing your pandering attempts to gain popularity...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you talking about my parties?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm talking about the changes you've made to your appearance! There are even some rumors going around that you've gone `under the knife.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm talking about the changes you've made to your appearance! There are even some rumors going around that you've gone [color=#e23b3b][i]under the knife.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Plastic surgery? I'm not crazy!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, Justin, I `have` made changes to how I look. And yeah, I made those changes to improve my popularity.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, Justin, I [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] made changes to how I look. And yeah, I made those changes to improve my popularity.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: So you admit it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I do. I mean...

options.label: At least one of us cares about appearances.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Clearly now's not the time to talk about something this serious, but I promise... We'll talk about this later today.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay... Sure, Ben. I'll see you later.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: See you, Jess.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... If you're upset about me not running, we should probably talk about this now.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, I `really` want to talk about that while I'm `mad` at you... `In front of everyone!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] want to talk about that while I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]mad[/i][/color] at you... [color=#3b78e2][i]In front of everyone![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay... Now I'm thinking we probably shouldn't talk about this now...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You think?
In his seat near the front, Ben's brow furrows...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is there even a reason for me to run anymore? Or was it all just because Jessica wanted me to?
After class, Ben's hanging out near the other mobile classrooms when Jessica comes up to him, holding a copy of the school newspaper.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Hey, Jess.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, Hero!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That article in the paper came out about the earthquake! Not only did Nick take great pics of me and the girls, but you come across as, like, totes amazing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm so lucky to be your girlfriend... Now you're more popular than ever! You'll be President for sure!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I thought you'd be happier...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, Jess, we have to talk about what happened during the earthquake crisis at some point...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: About how both of us acted.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why don't we table that for now and just focus on getting you signed up for President?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I was actually just wondering if I should even `run` for President...
nodes.text_bbcode: I was actually just wondering if I should even [color=#e23b3b][i]run[/i][/color] for President...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `What?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The whole point was to achieve ultimate popularity, but I don't know if I can get any more popular. I mean, everyone thinks I'm a hero already!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But you `have` to be President, Ben!
nodes.text_bbcode: But you [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to be President, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why? Why does that seem so important to you?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because... I...
Just then, the popular guys see Ben from the other side of the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, guys! Check it out, it's Ben!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale! You the man!
Hector holds up the school paper, displaying a full page dedicated to Ben!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Boom! My boy Ben is `officially` too cool for school!
nodes.text_bbcode: Boom! My boy Ben is [color=#e23b3b][i]officially[/i][/color] too cool for school!

nodes.text: Ben turns back to Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Forget about it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... Jess, what were you going to say?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We'll talk about why I want you to run later...

options.label: Promise to talk with Jess later.
Insist on talking about it now.

nodes.text: In Ms. Prez's mobile classroom one morning...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: All right, all right. Let's settle down for the announcements...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Unless you want to be the one who makes my headache worse!
The class quiets down, and Ms. Prez turns on a video monitor.
On the screen, Erik and Justin are sitting side-by-side...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Heeeelllllooooooo Twin Branches!
After a few seconds, Erik anxiously looks at Justin...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh... Justin, you're supposed to say...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Someone's` a Grumpy Gus, and I think I know why!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Someone's[/i][/color] a Grumpy Gus, and I think I know why!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's Nomination Week! If you want to run against Justin for school President, now's the time!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Sign-ups take place in the library...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hate to break it to you, my PA pal, but sign-ups `actually` take place in Ms. Lee's temporary office!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hate to break it to you, my PA pal, but sign-ups [color=#e23b3b][i]actually[/i][/color] take place in Ms. Lee's temporary office!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If anyone went to the library, they'd be knee-deep in a pile of rubble! What a gaffe!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hmph!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, that's about it! Except...
Erik removes his glasses, cleans them, and puts them back on...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: On a more serious note, I'd personally like to say that if you're planning on running for office, you should be mature...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The same way you'd be if you were eating sandwiches with my grandma!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So before you sign up, ask yourself... Why should `I` run?
nodes.text_bbcode: So before you sign up, ask yourself... Why should [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] run?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You really brought it today, Ms. Lee. New haircut? New earrings? New shade of lipstick?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: No... All the same old style!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It must be something else then!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Maybe it's this new girdle I've been trying...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Too much info again, Ms. Lee.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, I tell you what... Since you're a nice person, I'm sure no one will mind...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I hereby declare you, whatever your name is, to be school President!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks, Ms. Lee! You're the best!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I know...
Want to see the conclusion of Taylor's story? Try again and see if you can score enough points to unlock it!
In the meantime, let's see how you did!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I admit, I'm a little disappointed that I had to spell that out for you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I always thought you'd be the one to figure it out. Guess I was wrong...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're not going to get away with it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I think I'm going to be sick...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This `is` the place for it.
nodes.text_bbcode: This [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] the place for it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I am not using Ben! Ben `wants` to become President! He'll actually make a good one!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am not using Ben! Ben [color=#3b78e2][i]wants[/i][/color] to become President! He'll actually make a good one!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And we like each other, whether you believe it or not!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Then what am I missing?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hahaha! Seriously? Do I have to spell it out for you?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Who was dating Ben before I swooped in?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You didn't?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I might have played a small part in Ben's break-up with Denni, but let's face it, they were never going to last!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: My finest work.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I did some pretty manipulative things in my day, Jessica, but this... This is way ugly.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugly? Or beautiful?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You wanted to regain all the privileges of being the First Lady!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wouldn't you? Shopping sprees! Red carpet events! Schmoozing!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! That means...

options.label: You broke up Ben and Denni!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh... Gross! You think `I` want all that responsibility!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Gross! You think [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] want all that responsibility!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why do all the work when you can have all the perks?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! You didn't want to become President... You wanted to date the next one!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Duh, yeah!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm impressed, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The feeling isn't mutual!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Very good!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You knew that once you got rid of me, the other cheerleaders would nominate $ZOE for Head Cheerleader... So you made her take the fall for leaking that video tape!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Two birds, one stone! I never really got that expression 'til then!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You couldn't imagine someone as low as Justin breaking up with you, but he did. And you lost all your First Lady privileges...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, well, who knew `Justin` had a conscience?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, who knew [color=#3b78e2][i]Justin[/i][/color] had a conscience?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There was no way Justin would ever take you back... So you devised a new strategy... You decided to...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I saw an opportunity, and I struck!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! There's more, isn't there?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Awww, I'm disappointed. I think you're getting a little ahead of yourself...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Using $ZOE didn't get me any power... Overthrowing you as Head Cheerleader did!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How could you?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It was easy! And super fun!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait... That's not all... There's more isn't there?
He hands her a tissue.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Come on, let's forget about this and see if we can get Erik's giant some gold...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh yeah, what are we going to do about his donkey not being magical?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Heh. Anything can happen... Maybe it `will` start laying golden eggs!
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. Anything can happen... Maybe it [color=#e23b3b][i]will[/i][/color] start laying golden eggs!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll be right there, I'm just going to go clean myself up...
Taylor steps into the girls' restroom...
And finds Jessica there, standing in front of one of the mirrors.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How are all your geeky friends doing? You having fun playing dolls?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm having a lot of fun. Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, no problem. I know you're not going to ask me about what I've been up to... For obvious reasons... So I'll just share!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I've been to some totes awesome parties... Some of them thrown by my boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You might know him... He's Ben, the most popular guy in school. Here's an article about him being a hero in the paper if you want to learn more about him.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know who Ben is.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Great! Then you also know that he'll be President soon!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So I've heard...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course, you probably also know that as First Lady, I'll be requiring a lot of Audio / Visual assistance from your friends...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I hear that your boyfriend is surprisingly good at physical combat, so I'm thinking of enlisting him as my personal bodyguard.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That means he'll have to be around me all the time, looking after me, protecting me, you know, watching my every move.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You wouldn't!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Please! It's pretty much already done! Don't think I don't still remember all the crap you put me through when you were Head Cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait... This whole thing... It's all been...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yes?
The gears in Taylor's head start spinning wildly, connections are formed, suddenly a disturbing pattern reveals itself to her...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I can't believe it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Can't believe what?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: A long time ago... You... You were dating Justin and that made you First Lady.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Go on...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...But you wanted more power, so you...

nodes.prompt: You wanted more power, so you...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: You wanted more power, so you...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't throw super awesome parties! I don't even go to them anymore!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't make myself over... Look at me, I've got cheese puff residue on my skirt!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't even save people from collapsing buildings!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... That does require timing and...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If he's so much better, Brendan, why don't you just date him?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whoa! Where is this coming from?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm upset, okay?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, you're making `me` upset too!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you're making [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] upset too!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Supporting Ben has `nothing` to do with who we like better! He's just a better candidate!
nodes.text_bbcode: Supporting Ben has [color=#e23b3b][i]nothing[/i][/color] to do with who we like better! He's just a better candidate!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry...
Brendan sighs.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Here you go.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He's done a lot to improve his rep...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He started dating Jessica, he's thrown epic parties, he's changed his look... Twice!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And he definitely proved he could lead during the earthquake crisis.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Maybe you should be dating `him...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe you should be dating [color=#e23b3b][i]him...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't know about that! My guy has his own merits.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I believe you're referring to my inexhaustible wit and charm.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And you have a nice smile.
Brendan smiles widely for Taylor.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm glad you followed me out here...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Here you go.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So before you sign up, ask yourself... Why should `I` run?
nodes.text_bbcode: So before you sign up, ask yourself... Why should [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] run?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Erik's so great when he's all serious like this!
After class, Taylor and the nerds are setting up the map for Ogres 'N' Elves...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Guys, my giant is just twenty thousand gold pieces away from opening his inn!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: How much gold does he have already?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well... None. He blew it all on that magic donkey at the market!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `Magic` donkey? I don't think the donkey is actually...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Magic[/i][/color] donkey? I don't think the donkey is actually...

nodes.text: Taylor steps on Brendan's toe.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `Ow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I mean... Solid purchase, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can't wait till Mr. Hee-Haw lays his first golden egg. I'll give him an extra carrot treat for sure!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, hey Erik! Nice job on the announcements this morning.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm just excited that our group finally has someone `popular` who can run for President. Someone who can really represent us!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm just excited that our group finally has someone [color=#3b78e2][i]popular[/i][/color] who can run for President. Someone who can really represent us!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: President?! Do the nerds think that `I'm` going to run for...?
nodes.text_bbcode: President?! Do the nerds think that [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] going to run for...?

nodes.text: Dex raises his soda can above his head! The nerds follow suit...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: A toast! To the most popular nerd!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, I don't know about...
All the nerds chime in at the same time...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: To Ben!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: To Ben!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: To Ben!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Ben?` But he's...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ben?[/i][/color] But he's...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Ben `is` more popular than I am!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ohmygosh! Ben [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] more popular than I am!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's happened to me?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Are you okay, Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh-huh! I was just... Um, start without me!
A few seconds later... Taylor bursts out of the school. She takes deep breaths, trying to stave off tears.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm... I'm not the queen of this school any more... Am I?
A gentle hand grabs hers and she turns to see...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, you okay?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah... I'm fine... I think.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I just wasn't expecting Ben to be the person you guys rallied around.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I thought it was going to be me.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Awww... You understand why it's him, though, right?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah... I get it...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Thin ice, Mr. Warren...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know, but hear me out...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The school just got three hundred bros from Spartan Academy, including yours truly.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If you want to stop the student body from fighting, bring in some girls!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: That was a risky answer, but a well-thought out idea! Really risky...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm a risky guy.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'll accept your application... Don't make me regret it!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You won't!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: That's a common talking point politicians make when the subject of education improvement comes up...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So... You're saying I'm a politician?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm saying you picked something up, but I'm not convinced yet. Can you tell me why smaller class sizes are so important?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, well, if the class is large then, um, the teacher's voice will echo more.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And that will make it harder for the students to hear.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Smaller class sizes, better hearing.
Shapiro shakes her head...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: The talking point is about having fewer students per class, Mr. Warren, not smaller buildings.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh... Well, that could be helpful too.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Fine. Leave an application with me, and I'll `consider` you. Against all my natural instincts.
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. Leave an application with me, and I'll [color=#3b78e2][i]consider[/i][/color] you. Against all my natural instincts.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I `am` serious, Principal... Uh, Shrapnel.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] serious, Principal... Uh, Shrapnel.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Just get out of my office, Mr. Warren.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes ma'am.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh... Like I was saying, Ms. Lee, you look good, you know, for an old lady.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Old?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wrong word. I didn't mean to say old. Let me try again...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What I meant to say was... Your ears... They are... Weird?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: How dare you! There's no way someone like you should `ever` be President!
nodes.text_bbcode: How dare you! There's no way someone like you should [color=#3b78e2][i]ever[/i][/color] be President!

nodes.text: Twenty minutes later, a guy with a familiar face steps through the door.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, hello, my name is Colt! I wish to be President!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Wonderful let me get you a sign up sheet!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No no! No sign up sheet for me! I wish to be President now!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Forceful, that does seem very leader-like to me...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh... What else do you think leaders are like?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: They can all sing! Everyone knows that!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Right. Of course. Ahem. Uh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: { My naaaaaaame is Colt! {

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: { I am no dolt! {

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: { Of this school I am a resident! {

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: { So pleeeeeease make me the President! {

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Encore! Encore!
Twenty minutes and several stanzas later...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I hereby declare you school President!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Finally!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Anyway... I'll come with you to Ms. Lee's to sign up...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sign up? That's a waste of time. I'll be President by the end of the day.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh... What? It's not going to be that easy...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Have faith, Princess. I'll just Colt my way through this one.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Your name is `not` a verb.
nodes.text_bbcode: Your name is [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] a verb.

nodes.text: Nearby, Ryan holds up his History test to the rebels...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Check it out! I got an A! And all I did was cheat off of the nerd next to me! I really Colted it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Exhibit A, Princess.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Fine... But `Colting it` negates the whole point of being responsible and growing up...
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine... But [color=#3b78e2][i]Colting it[/i][/color] negates the whole point of being responsible and growing up...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Relax, I'm not going to do anything grown-ups don't already do...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Unfortunately, that statement does not bring me a whole lot of comfort...
A few minutes later, Colt steps into Ms. Lee's temporary office...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Just the young man I wanted to see...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Am I in trouble?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You? Heavens, no! From what I know about you, you couldn't find trouble if it slapped you in the face and told you its name!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Are you sure you're not mistaking me for someone else?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I could be. It wouldn't be the first time. But don't tell me your name. Let's keep the mystery!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Right. I'm here to become the President.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Lovely! Let me get you a sign up sheet!
As Ms. Lee rifles through a stack of papers that appear to be blank, Colt clears his throat.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're looking nice today, Ms. Lee!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh! Thank you! I haven't heard a compliment in so long!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: All my ex-husband's compliments came in grunts and belches!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Way `way` too much info, Ms. Lee.
nodes.text_bbcode: Way [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too much info, Ms. Lee.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Listen... I'd really like to bypass this whole sign up process and just be declared President. You can do that, right?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hmmm... Time to turn on my charm!

options: That lipstick is a nice shade!
Your eyes are like a bug's!
You look good for an old lady!
nodes.title: Make your choice!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What you said was right, Princess! I need to start thinking about my future...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And just like that, you're suddenly interested in changing?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well that's what you've been talking about, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It feels like you're just telling me what you think I want you to say...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: When really, I want you to tell me what `you` want to say. The truth, Colt.
nodes.text_bbcode: When really, I want you to tell me what [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] want to say. The truth, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay. The truth... I have no idea what you just said.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Man, I can't win!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why can't you just tell me that the only reason you're suddenly interested in the Presidency is because I put pressure on you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Because that's a classic girl trap!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's not a girl trap!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fine!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Fine!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait, it's not a trap?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No... It's okay for you to do something because I want you to. If you hadn't lied, it would have actually been sweet.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Reverse girl trap.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're seriously going to run for President... Just because I asked you to start thinking about your future?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I mean, I think it's a waste of time but when it comes to anything related to my future, I'm going to take your advice.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm impressed... And kind of flattered.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You should be. I don't follow the advice of any of my other girlfriends.
Denni elbows Colt in the ribs.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Very funny.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Besides, how hard can it be to beat that Justin kid? No one likes him anyway. I'm a lock.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: All right, rein in that ego, you haven't even registered yet.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: When I win, do we get to live in a big white house together?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So before you sign up, ask yourself... Why should `I` run?
nodes.text_bbcode: So before you sign up, ask yourself... Why should [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] run?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Pfft! How about who cares?
After class, Colt helps Denni walk to her next class.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How's the leg, Princess?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Perfect. I'm finally getting used to my crutches.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I like seeing you like this. You know, not in a hospital bed.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You mean, mobile?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, and alive.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I should thank Tweed again the next time I see his moppy head...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I overheard him and Howard talking about colleges. You know Howard's graduating?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's crazy. Howard graduating is like the sun exploding or something. It just doesn't happen.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You know what does happen? The future.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aaaaaaand... Here comes the lecture.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: If you're ever going to get into college, Colt, you're going to have to turn your grades around and start, you know, participating.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: College? Don't get ahead of yourself, Princess. I'm not graduating anytime soon.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But you `will,` Colt.
nodes.text_bbcode: But you [color=#3b78e2][i]will,[/i][/color] Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll figure something out.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Just so you know, you can't sneak your way into college. A shady moustache and a Domingo Florentine ID probably aren't going to fly.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Har har. Look, college isn't for me, okay? Can you imagine `me` cramming for an exam, declaring a major, or pledging in a fraternity?
nodes.text_bbcode: Har har. Look, college isn't for me, okay? Can you imagine [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] cramming for an exam, declaring a major, or pledging in a fraternity?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I already did that Greek thing with the Spartans and look how `it` turned out!
nodes.text_bbcode: I already did that Greek thing with the Spartans and look how [color=#e23b3b][i]it[/i][/color] turned out!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, well, I'd be really surprised if you end up in `another` corruption turned motorcycle versus helicopter, fiery explosion scenario.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, well, I'd be really surprised if you end up in [color=#3b78e2][i]another[/i][/color] corruption turned motorcycle versus helicopter, fiery explosion scenario.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh. Words.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Just tell me you'll think about it, okay?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah yeah.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm serious, Colt!
Denni stops walking and stares at Colt.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't want either of us to coast along and then somewhere down the line realize that we could have done something with our lives if only we had started now!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay okay... I get it. Breathe, Tiny Hipster.
At that moment, Justin rushes past them...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Out of the way!
Colt smiles.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Another brilliant idea from `The Coltster!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Another brilliant idea from [color=#e23b3b][i]The Coltster![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh-oh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll be school President!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I think 'The Coltster' needs his ego checked...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You just said I need to start participating. What's more participate-y than running for office?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, I do think you need to participate more... Like actually going to class or doing your homework! Small things, Colt...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Like learning the Principal's name...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shrapnel?
Denni sighs.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why would you possibly run for President?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know... I guess I'd run...
$ZOE smiles and hands cupcakes out to passers-by.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cupcakes! Cupcakes for free!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Don't mind if I do!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cupcakes! Cupcakes! Come and get them while they're fluffy!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Heh. Cupcakes with a face on them... Surprisingly adorable.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cupcakes! Megan, do you want one?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I don't know if I can support this kind of...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's chocolate with white buttercream frosting...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Sold!
In no time, $ZOE and Keith hand out all the cupcakes.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Way to step it up out there, $ZOE. I didn't think you were going to be able to hand one to Megan...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who's really going to complain about a free cupcake?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Good point.
Jessica stops by the door to check on their progress.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wow, $ZOE, if there's anything you know, it's cupcakes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's true!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I knew you'd be able to get rid of them! You single-handedly gave them all out!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hey, she wasn't the only one doing her job. It's not like I was just enjoying the sun out here.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shut up, Keith. Everyone knows you fake tan.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hey! No one says that...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: They don't have to... I can see where the tanner ends and the real Keith begins.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Ouch.
Jessica turns back to $ZOE.
$ZOE runs out with the other cheerleaders, waving to the crowd as the others tumble behind her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Go, Twin Branches, go!
$ZOE does a cartwheel, and the students cheer!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Go, Twin Branches, go!
When the basketball players come out, they cheer $ZOE on and high-five her as they run onto the court.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah! I'm so pumped!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Go, Twin Branches!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Whoo!
Throughout the entire night, $ZOE keeps the crowd's energy up...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoo hoo!
Until at last, the game ends!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: And with the final score of 48 to 42, Twin Branches wins!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoo!
The cheerleaders head off the court into the locker room. As they do, they pat $ZOE on the back.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You looked like a real animal out there!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I couldn't have done a better job myself...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That means a lot, Jill.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm glad I did well... But I still smell like feet!
$ZOE heads into the locker room.
$ZOE has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You will?! Great!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, hold on. Wait, what if I think I don't want to do it later?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Then don't think! Besides, no take-backsies! Don't you know Girl Code Rule Number 44?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Trust me, you won't regret this...
A few weeks later...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm happy to announce that your President for the new school year is...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: `Ben Kale!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ben Kale![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You've got to be kidding me!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw man...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Go, Ben, go!
Ben takes the stage and waves out to the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hello, Twin Branches! It's an honor to be your President. I'd like to take this moment to thank everyone in my campaign.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: To my wonderful girlfriend, Jessica Blaire. Her tireless efforts have earned her the title of First Girlfriend of the campus!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, they have!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now I'd like to talk about the changes I'm bringing to this school next year...
As Ben talks, $ZOE approaches Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, uh, Jessica... Now that Ben's won... I wanted to talk to you about some ideas I had for our cheer routine...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Excuse me? Last time I checked `I'm` still Cheer Captain, and `I` choose our cheer routines.
nodes.text_bbcode: Excuse me? Last time I checked [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] still Cheer Captain, and [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] choose our cheer routines.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, you said that when Ben became President, I'd get some `perks...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, you said that when Ben became President, I'd get some [color=#3b78e2][i]perks...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Who told you that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You did!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you questioning me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Watch who you're talking to, $ZOE. I'm the First Girlfriend at school now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh yeah? What can you really do?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually, quite a bit.
Ben steps in between them.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's going on here?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Ben!` She's a traitor, and she's trying to upset the fragile balance of the cheerleading squad!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ben![/i][/color] She's a traitor, and she's trying to upset the fragile balance of the cheerleading squad!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Do something about it! Stop her!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Secret service!
Immediately, several students dressed in black swarm around $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Yes, POTS?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We really need a better acronym for President of the School...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What is your command, sir?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Escort this girl into maximum security detention... Where she'll have time to think about her crimes!
As they begin dragging her away, $ZOE struggles.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can't do this! It's against my rights!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You don't have any rights!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I regret this! I regret endorsing Ben! I never liked him!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good thing it's too late for that...
Uh-oh! Looks like Jessica's let the power go to her head! And it is kind of $ZOE's fault...
Sometimes people shouldn't get what they want... Especially Jessica! Try again and see if you can make a better choice next time around!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like I said, I don't know that much about what he stands for.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All I've really heard is his name coming up over and over again from you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nothing's changed since yesterday, Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nothing...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Except the smell of feet.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Keep the costume, $ZOE. I have a feeling you might `need` it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Keep the costume, $ZOE. I have a feeling you might [color=#3b78e2][i]need[/i][/color] it.

nodes.text: Jessica storms away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, now I `definitely` don't want to support Ben...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, now I [color=#3b78e2][i]definitely[/i][/color] don't want to support Ben...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But if I tell Jessica that...
$ZOE eyes the mascot costume.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want to be the mascot for the rest of my high school life!
$ZOE runs out with the other cheerleaders...
As they start their cheer, she starts shoving into them!
Nicole is bounced to the side, drawing a laugh from the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: $ZOE?! What are you doing?
The girls twirling around her stumble as $ZOE pushes and shoves her way through in her bulky mascot costume!
All the girls try to avoid $ZOE, moving in strange circles and arcs that don't match the cheerful music blasting throughout the gym.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Agh! I can't avoid her!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No way! Don't stand near me!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: She's getting in my way!
When the students in the crowd start pointing at the dodging cheerleaders, Jessica turns back and hisses at all of them.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Get back into formation!
Nicole, Jill, and Maria try to cheer in their places again, but $ZOE chases them away from the center.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, get off! Go away!
From across the room, Wilson's cheerleaders start jeering and laughing...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Ha ha... Wow... Your school might have changed names, but you guys are every bit as pathetic as ever!
Soon, the entire gym is laughing!
When the basketball players come out on court, they avoid looking at the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Come on, guys. Let's just focus on winning the game...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is a disaster...
After the game, the cheerleaders glare angrily at $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Next time you feel like doing whatever `that` was, do it somewhere else!
nodes.text_bbcode: Next time you feel like doing whatever [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] was, do it somewhere else!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: That was awful! You're a disgrace to the mascot costume.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now everyone hates me, `and` I'm pretty sure I smell like feet...
nodes.text_bbcode: Now everyone hates me, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] I'm pretty sure I smell like feet...

nodes.text: She heads into the locker room with the rest of the cheerleaders.
$ZOE forcefully shoves away from the table, causing the plates and silverware to rattle.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE? What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I just remembered I have to do something at home. `Right now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I... I just remembered I have to do something at home. [color=#3b78e2][i]Right now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so sorry!
$ZOE walks quickly outside and down the block.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniff... Sniff...
A few moments later, Howard catches up to her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE! Are you... Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniff... All this talk about graduation and you leaving...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It made me freak out... Sniff...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I couldn't stand to listen to it anymore, so I ran.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Tell you parents I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I will.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But right now, talk to me. What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have to keep it together... I don't want to lose it in front of Howard's family.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's great news, Howard. Kingston is a very good school. I'll keep my fingers crossed.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE. We'll see how I do on my interview with them next week.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Besides, I'm not even sure I want to go.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Just make sure you consider it.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: We can figure it out when we get there. In the meantime...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Kay and Kel, since you've had so much dessert, why don't you two do the dishes?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Aww...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yay, bubbles!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I should head home. Thank you for dinner.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: You're very welcome. Goodnight, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll walk her out.
Howard walks $ZOE to the door.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, what's wrong? You didn't seem like yourself at the end.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, you're going off to college... Soon, you'll be moving out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All this talk about you going away scares me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want things to change...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They won't change that much...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What if you move across the country? What then?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We'll figure out how to be together. No matter where I go.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do `you` feel about everything?
nodes.text_bbcode: How do [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] feel about everything?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I'm sad. I don't want to leave Twin Branches...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But at the same time, it's exciting. College will be something interesting and new.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If we went to the same college, it wouldn't matter how long we were apart. We'd still end up together.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, I have an idea... I'm going to Centerscore University later this week for a campus tour.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why don't you come with me? We can check out the campus... Eat some college food... Crash some parties...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean, see how cool college is compared to high school?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, at the very least we could time exactly how far apart we would be from each other.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Trust me, everything's going to be just fine. Like it is now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Except that everything `isn't` fine now...
nodes.text_bbcode: Except that everything [color=#3b78e2][i]isn't[/i][/color] fine now...

nodes.text: Howard wraps his arms around her. They stay that way for long while...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you too.
The next day after school, $ZOE and the other cheerleaders gather in the Wilson High gym right before a basketball game.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, these losers are so lucky they have a gym.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Girls, huddle!
The cheerleaders crowd around Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Listen, I want to switch things up `temporarily... `
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen, I want to switch things up [color=#3b78e2][i]temporarily... [/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jessica nods at $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wonder what that means...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nicole, you've been cheering from the front row for the last few weeks. Why don't we change that?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What? But... I'm always in front!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know, and times are changing. Everyone should have a turn...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So that's why I want someone new and special to stand in the front row...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is she going to pick me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Someone who really deserves it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Jill!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Jill![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: What? But I...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: This is great! I'm usually the mascot!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But where am I supposed to go?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Don't tell me I have to wear that smelly old suit!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You can take $ZOE's place in the back.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...But what about me?
Jessica gives $ZOE a wide smile.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I thought you might `temporarily` enjoy being mascot.
nodes.text_bbcode: I thought you might [color=#3b78e2][i]temporarily[/i][/color] enjoy being mascot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh really?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's just for one night...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Unless you decide you `really` love it...
nodes.text_bbcode: Unless you decide you [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] love it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's what you always wanted to do, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's making me mascot because I wouldn't endorse Ben!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's time to go out and cheer! Have fun!
She winks at $ZOE and runs onto the court.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll show her... I'll try to be the best mascot ever!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Which school is it?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Kingston University. It's located on the East Coast, somewhere near New York.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: New York? That's... That's all the way across the country!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And it'd be difficult to visit. The plane flight's at least `six hours...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And it'd be difficult to visit. The plane flight's at least [color=#3b78e2][i]six hours...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE takes in a slow, steady breath as Howard's family talks around her.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You never know, Howard. Depending on which college you get into, you might be seeing them more than you think.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What... What colleges have you applied to, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I sent out a few to colleges in the area... Centerscore U, for one.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I've also been hearing back from `other schools...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And I've also been hearing back from [color=#e23b3b][i]other schools...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Other schools?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Right! Tell her about the one that might offer you a full scholarship, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, uh, it's not a sure bet, but there's one college that wants me to join their football team.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Isn't that great?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: It'd make up for those years we spent paying for all your football equipment.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And it's a prestigious institution. You'd do well, even if you are far away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Far away?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, I don't really know what he stands for...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It'd be weird to endorse him, you know?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, just `so weird.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, just [color=#3b78e2][i]so weird.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry I couldn't give you a definite answer...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm `sure` you `are.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]sure[/i][/color] you [color=#3b78e2][i]are.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hopefully, it doesn't affect my chances of cheering in the front or... Eventually getting my own routine?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Ha.` Maybe it will, maybe it will.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ha.[/i][/color] Maybe it will, maybe it will.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you just say that `twice?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you just say that [color=#3b78e2][i]twice?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jessica clears her throat and gives $ZOE a wan smile.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm only offering this `temporarily...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm only offering this [color=#3b78e2][i]temporarily...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So be sure to make up your mind soon, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Before I have to do it for you.
Jessica stomps away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, she was really upset...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I feel... I feel like I just made a `huge` mistake...
nodes.text_bbcode: I feel... I feel like I just made a [color=#3b78e2][i]huge[/i][/color] mistake...

nodes.text: $ZOE tries to hand out cupcakes to passers-by, but freaks them out instead!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hidey-ho, partner!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, the Wild West theme was `so` four weeks ago.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, yeah, the Wild West theme was [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] four weeks ago.

nodes.text: Carson walks by, and Keith shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: 'Hidey-ho'? What's your deal? Just talk normal!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Normal! Right! I can do that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello there, young Megan! Might I interest your mouth in a baked good?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You talk weird, pom-pom. Get out of my face.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Maybe I should handle customer interactions. Why don't you get us a refill on cupcakes?
$ZOE hurries inside and grabs another tray of cupcakes. On her way out, she trips and falls, cupcake tray and all!
She tumbles into Nicole and Jill, and they all go down in a huge heap!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Gross! I have buttercream on my new jacket! Now that sketchy waiter will `never` hit on me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Gross! I have buttercream on my new jacket! Now that sketchy waiter will [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] hit on me!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I wanted a cupcake in me, not `on` me....
nodes.text_bbcode: I wanted a cupcake in me, not [color=#3b78e2][i]on[/i][/color] me....

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I wanted both!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry... Sorry, guys!
Jessica comes up to them.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And who, exactly, is responsible for this catastrophe?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: She was the one who tripped!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: $ZOE's a walking disaster! She did this! Now all the stickers are covered with frosting!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Is this true?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I may have tripped... But it was totally an accident!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I think it's brilliant!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wish the rest of you had been so creative! $ZOE's the only one being original!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't be so shy, $ZOE. Scratch and sniff stickers? Brilliant! Now everyone can sniff Ben!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ew?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, I like it. $ZOE, you're promoted to management! You can sit around with me and watch everyone else pass out stickers next time!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: As for the rest of you... Laundry duty will go a lot easier with more people, won't it?!
The rest of the cheerleaders give $ZOE a dirty look.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Nice going, $ZOE.
They walk away in a huff. Jessica hangs back to help $ZOE up.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't worry about them. $ZOE, can we talk for a minute?
Jessica pushes $ZOE into a booth.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just be careful, $ZOE. I've been down this path before.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Doing everything just to please the Head Cheerleader. Well, look where it's gotten me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean, into a sport you actually excel at and dating a guy you love and trust?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That was `after` cheerleading, $ZOE.
nodes.text_bbcode: That was [color=#3b78e2][i]after[/i][/color] cheerleading, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't want her to play you. I'm just looking out for you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's my job to tell you what might happen. Besides, I have a feeling this is going to get a lot worse before it gets better.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Jessica's going absolutely nuts trying to get votes for Ben... And you're well-liked by most of the school.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I am?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know if that's true...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Watch this.
Sam turns, scans the crowd, and plucks Erik out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Erik... Who are you voting for President?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh gosh! For President? That's a lot of pressure! I don't know! Whoever $ZOE is voting for, I guess!
Sam lets him go.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was... Random.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But, surprisingly, proved my point. Whoever you vote for, people will follow.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And something tells me Jessica's going to try to exploit you as much as she can...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You really think so?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know. I don't enjoy this kind of thing. Girl politics. That's why I left cheerleading.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just... Just watch your back, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, Sam. Thanks.
$ZOE and Sam part ways, Sam to the swimming center, $ZOE to the diner.
In front of the diner, $ZOE and the other cheerleaders assemble. Jessica clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All right, cheerleaders! We're here for one thing and one thing only...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: To hit on that sketchy waiter with the face tattoo?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No! To get Ben's name out there!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Aww... Again? We've been doing this forever.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Which is how long you're going to be doing mascot duty if you don't shut your blue piehole.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooo! Can we get blueberry pie?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I shouldn't have to tell you that your school needs you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And that means we're handing everyone everything! Stickers! Cupcakes! Buttons! `Everything!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And that means we're handing everyone everything! Stickers! Cupcakes! Buttons! [color=#3b78e2][i]Everything![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No one leaves this diner without something that has Ben's face on it!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nicole and Amanda, you're in charge of buttons.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love buttons!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Get used to giving them away...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Goodbye, buttons...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Maria and Jill, you're on sticker duty...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE and Keith, you're handing out Ben-cakes!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Really?
Jessica hands everyone their campaign props.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: There had better not be a cupcake, sticker, or button between you all when we're done.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I have a great idea... Why don't we give an award to the group that hands out the most campaign stuff?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I have an even better idea...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why don't I give out laundry duty to the group that has the most stuff in their hands at the end of the hour?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Gulp!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now go!
Keith and $ZOE stand just outside the door, cupcakes at the ready.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is it me, or is Jessica way more... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Insane than usual? Yeah, she is. She's made me fetch her `four` cappuccinos in the last twenty minutes!
nodes.text_bbcode: Insane than usual? Yeah, she is. She's made me fetch her [color=#e23b3b][i]four[/i][/color] cappuccinos in the last twenty minutes!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoa. Caffeine overdose!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: The latest poll numbers say that the other candidates have some niche votes. When Ben's not sweeping, Jessica's not happy.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I think we're going to be riding this wave for a while.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who are you going to vote for?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Depends on who's asking. If it's Jessica... You know I'm voting for Ben!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What if `I'm` asking?
nodes.text_bbcode: What if [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] asking?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I don't know... I always figured I'd vote for whoever you vote for.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You would?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah... I trust you... I think other people do too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam was right!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: In fact, if you voted for someone, I bet `everyone` would...
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact, if you voted for someone, I bet [color=#e23b3b][i]everyone[/i][/color] would...

nodes.text: Jessica storms over.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Keith! Stop yapping over there! Start handing things out!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why don't you give everyone that sugary smile you do so well? You know, that sicky-sweet one I just want to punch?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You'll pass out so many more cupcakes that way!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, uh... Okay...
Keith makes eye contact with $ZOE as Jessica flounces away.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `Someone's` on her good side...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Someone's[/i][/color] on her good side...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Apparently!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Get those cupcakes out there!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoops... Better concentrate on these cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You sure aren't acting like it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What am I supposed to do about it? She's the Head Cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I want to stay a cheerleader, then I have to listen to her, don't I?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, at least Jessica's not slipping a fast one by you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, really? She hasn't been making you run errands?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... She always did that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And you haven't been baking cupcakes that say 'BEN'?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She said it stood for 'Be Extremely Nice...'

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And what about that life-sized cardboard cutout of Ben in your locker?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I just think Ben's really cute?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE! Admit it! She's taking advantage of you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, I'll admit... The cardboard cutout is super-creepy. I feel like its eyes follow me when I walk around...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But so what?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She's getting free labor out of you guys. Without even trying. And you're just going along with her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What else am I supposed to do? She's Head Cheerleader!
After school one day, Sam and $ZOE are walking towards their after school programs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So I heard Nick got a lot of praise for his work with the newspaper article.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. Apparently he's good at taking pictures. Who knew?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's wrong? You're making a sad face. And you know how I feel about sad faces.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They make me sad too!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well... I'm glad Nick is really committing to photography...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I know `I'm` the one that told him to get his own hobby and have his own life...
nodes.text_bbcode: And I know [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] the one that told him to get his own hobby and have his own life...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I'm kind of starting to regret it now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't approve of photography?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not the photography I have a problem with. It's the subject matter.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Am I the only one who thinks it's weird that he's decided to become Sara's campaign manager?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, they did seem to hit it off as friends. Sometimes you just get along with someone else.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe... But he could stand to be less happy about it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I guess I should let him have friends, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, Sam. Friends are good.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Anyway, what about you? Why are you heading this way? Don't the cheerleaders practice in the park?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm actually meeting them at the diner.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you guys eat now? So much has changed since I was on the team...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, no... It's not like that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A lot of Twin Branches students go to the diner after class since the school closed...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica wants us to hang out there and hand out things for Ben's Presidential campaign.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-oh. And so it begins...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just mean... It's gross how she's making the cheerleaders do all her dirty work.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can't you see she's taking advantage of you?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, you were `lucky` to be mascot, $ZOE.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, you were [color=#3b78e2][i]lucky[/i][/color] to be mascot, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: First Ben, now, you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can't have everyone suddenly disobeying me!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Except in your case, I don't have to be nice!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're off the squad!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you done yet? Because I have half a mind to kick you off...
Before Jessica can say another word, some of the other cheerleaders speak up!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I totally agree with $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I had to do some time in the costume, and it was the most miserable time of my life!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I hate to admit it, but what $ZOE's been saying makes sense...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: See, Jessica? They agree with `me.`
nodes.text_bbcode: See, Jessica? They agree with [color=#3b78e2][i]me.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jessica narrows her eyes and glares at every cheerleader who's spoken up in agreement of $ZOE's defense...
$ZOE looks imploringly at the other girls.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, don't any of you want to say something? Does anyone agree with me?
Though some of the cheerleaders meet her eyes, no one steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, okay, are you done now? I have half a mind to kick you off the squad entirely.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fine. But you don't want to do that.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And why's that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because even though the other girls aren't saying anything, I `know` they agree with me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Because even though the other girls aren't saying anything, I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] they agree with me.

nodes.text: Jessica narrows her eyes and glares at the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can't keep using it to threaten us with anymore.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's just not fair.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We should be allowed to disagree with you without fear of wearing a smelly cheese costume!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Hey! I have a say too, and I say I'm never going back!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: See what you're doing, $ZOE? You're destroying the proper order of the cheerleading pyramid with your attitude!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't be the only one that hates the costume!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... You need to make Jill go back to it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, there's another thing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not going to be the mascot anymore. And I'm going to stand up and tell you that you should...

options.label: Stop using it as a punishment!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Real `big` news there, $ZOE.
nodes.text_bbcode: Real [color=#3b78e2][i]big[/i][/color] news there, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `No one` likes being mascot.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No one[/i][/color] likes being mascot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And `no one` likes to be ordered around or forced to do something they don't want to do!
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]no one[/i][/color] likes to be ordered around or forced to do something they don't want to do!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, too bad! I make decisions for the team, and you have to listen to them. Now if that's all...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Really? That's what you want to tell me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love cheerleading because it's fun and it makes me feel active, and we get a lot of attention because we're cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But you're taking all the fun out of it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're making it all political, and you're getting in our faces and making us do these things that have nothing to do with cheerleading!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're ruining it! Not just for me... For everyone!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We aren't your personal slaves!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If that's all...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... I hate being mascot?
The other cheerleaders look over to see what's going on, but $ZOE ignores them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not going to stand by while you order me around.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's not an `order.` It's just a `very strong suggestion.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not an [color=#3b78e2][i]order.[/i][/color] It's just a [color=#3b78e2][i]very strong suggestion.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
