nodes.text: You can make whatever `choices` you want, but you already know what the `consequences` are...
nodes.text_bbcode: You can make whatever [color=#3b78e2][i]choices[/i][/color] you want, but you already know what the [color=#3b78e2][i]consequences[/i][/color] are...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I have something I have to get off my chest...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I'm not way into the election like you are, but that doesn't mean I should just carelessly toss my endorsement around!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know if Ben is the candidate I want...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I'll make my own choice when the time comes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And it'll have nothing to do with you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So what's the big deal?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just support him and get it over with...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And then I don't have to make you regret it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We can both be happy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: See? You have nothing to say to that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I kind of ran away from Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He was talking about how excited he was about college... About the quad, and the classes, and the parties...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And the girls?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, not that... Well, not directly anyway.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How can I compete with all that? How am I going to stay in his life?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And with everything going on, I haven't been able to talk to him about all the drama with cheerleading...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: When is there `not` drama in cheerleading?
nodes.text_bbcode: When is there [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] drama in cheerleading?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is worse. Jessica's demoted me. I'm the team mascot... It's humiliating! And I haven't done anything wrong!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's just because she wants something from me, and if I don't give it to her, I'll be a mascot for the rest of my high school life!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... Jessica's a piece of work...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It seems like everything I loved about my life is just disappearing through my fingers.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I can't do anything to stop it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know, right?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, I can't help you with the Howard stuff... He's going away. You'll join him eventually.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It'll fix itself.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But as for Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whatever she's making you do... Don't do it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Easy for you to say...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, it is. Because I don't take crap from other people.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And neither should you. It's your life.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If you keep following her orders, she's going to ruin it for you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It doesn't sound like anyone else on that sorry team is going to help you, so you're on your own.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Stand up, or lose everything you love doing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Just don't go around repeating what I said.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now, I think there's someone here who wants to see you...
Colt points at the doorway where Howard is standing, dripping.
Howard rushes to their table.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Colt, I got your text... Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You told him that you found me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I had to.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, I was looking everywhere! Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I feel a little better... Sorry about running off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, let's just go home...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'd like that...
At cheerleading the next day...
Jessica takes $ZOE aside.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE... Listen, I was thinking about the way I acted yesterday...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I may have been a little harsh. It's just that I really want Ben to have this Presidency...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: As his Campaign Manager, there's just so much that's expected of me...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All the other candidates are gaining ground, Ben's losing votes... I'm under so much pressure, I just snapped!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You can understand that, can't you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... I can.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I forgive you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now that's settled... Can you please endorse Ben for me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica, I already told you that I'm not sure...
Jessica narrows her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh. This again.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Look, you don't really care about the Presidential election. It's not really your thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, yeah, but...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So why not Ben?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She only apologized to get my vote!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It doesn't really matter who you throw your weight behind, does it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's nothing.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nothing. As in, I just found you wandering around campus in the rain, looking like you've been sucker-punched for no reason.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You girls always say it's nothing when it's `something.` The bigger the nothing, the bigger the something.
nodes.text_bbcode: You girls always say it's nothing when it's [color=#e23b3b][i]something.[/i][/color] The bigger the nothing, the bigger the something.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So maybe you don't want to talk to me. But don't ignore yourself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want to sound stupid.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You know the crappy part about getting better at being a boyfriend? I actually have to listen to girls now.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So try me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everything is going wrong!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't mind telling you, but what I'm going to say is going to be so stupid...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I promise not to tell you if it is...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, you've really changed. What happened?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Love. Stupid, cheesy love.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So spit it out already. You'll probably feel better.
$ZOE can feel tears welling in her eyes, and instead of turning to Howard...
She runs from him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE! Wait!
$ZOE runs and runs until her legs can't carry her anymore. She collapses on a bench.
There's a low rumble in the sky, and suddenly, $ZOE feels droplets of water on her face.
They're light at first, but start to grow heavier and heavier.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's raining!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniff... Sniff...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know where I am... What am I going to do?
That's when she sees the bright beam of a single headlight in the darkness. Soon, she sees a motorcycle. It stops near her.
A shadowy figure hops off and steps into the path of the beam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Colt?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: $ZOE? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I could ask you the same question...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's stupid to talk out here in the rain. Climb on. I'll give you a ride.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: On a motorcycle?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, in the car that I also brought with me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course on my motorcycle. You want to walk?
$ZOE can feel the rain starting to seep into her clothes. Cautiously, $ZOE straps a helmet on and climbs on.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hang on!
With a loud roar, Colt wheels his motorcycle around in a large arc and rushes down the road towards a large cluster of buildings...
A short time later...
$ZOE and Colt sit down in the university cafeteria.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So... Want to tell me what you're doing here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Only if you go first.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I... Uh... Heard there was a huge sorority party, and I... Wanted to hit on some girls?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't care about other girls. You're dating Denni now.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, fine. I'm... I'm checking this college thing out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know I'm not graduating for at least a year, but... I'm checking college out. It seems okay. I don't get all the hype.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Isn't it a big deal? I didn't think you were going to college...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, neither did I... Until Denni brought it up. Now it's all in her head... She wants me to apply myself now, so that she can eventually join me at a good college a couple years from now.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But honestly, I just don't know if I can get in...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So, I've answered your question. Now you answer mine.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What are you doing here? Alone, without Vanilla? Aren't you two joined at the hip?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It'll be harder than ever to stay connected to each other's lives.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I barely know what's going on in your head now.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's not true!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Most of the stuff I just told you is stuff I just thought of now.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're the first person I've ever told about anything like this!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't know you wanted to take up biology... Or join the Greek system...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How am I going to know you when you're actually away?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We'll `talk`, $ZOE. All the time.
nodes.text_bbcode: We'll [color=#e23b3b][i]talk[/i][/color], $ZOE. All the time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Will that be enough to keep us going?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What if it isn't, Howard? What if this is the thing that breaks up?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They'll be everywhere, Howard! All pretty and perky and... You know... Experienced!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, how could you think I'd forget about you that easily?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you say now! But what happens when you're here without me, and there's another girl, and...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Our relationship still managed to survive when `one` of us was interested in `someone else!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Our relationship still managed to survive when [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] of us was interested in [color=#e23b3b][i]someone else![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you're talking about Matteo...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course I'm talking about Matteo! He came between us. We survived.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you're saying you can go off with another girl, and we'll be fine?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! What I'm saying is that there's `no` other girl. I love `you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! What I'm saying is that there's [color=#e23b3b][i]no[/i][/color] other girl. I love [color=#e23b3b][i]you![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what if that's not enough, Howard? What if it's `not enough?`
nodes.text_bbcode: But what if that's not enough, Howard? What if it's [color=#3b78e2][i]not enough?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE turns and runs from him.
The next afternoon, Howard takes $ZOE around Centerscore U.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, this is nice.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is the main quad where everyone hangs out. They hold festivals and host live bands and stuff like that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If this is the school I end up at, I could be passing through here every day...
Despite the sadness within her, $ZOE puts on her best smile.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Here's a question. What are you going to study?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's what my parents want to know. I'm not sure honestly.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess that's why you have general eduation classes the first year or so. To figure out what you want.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But if I had to choose right now...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Science. Biology, probably.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Science? Really?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You don't think I can do it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't know you were interested! Mr. Russell catches you sleeping in his class all the time!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Because we're talking about genetics or whatever.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I aced the animal section!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And come on... I know everything there is to know about ducks.
Howard playfully nudges her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know... Don't you have to study a lot for science? I thought you didn't like studying all that much.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure, High School Howard doesn't. But maybe `College Howard` will `enjoy` studying. It could be his new hobby.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure, High School Howard doesn't. But maybe [color=#e23b3b][i]College Howard[/i][/color] will [color=#e23b3b][i]enjoy[/i][/color] studying. It could be his new hobby.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just hope College Howard isn't `too` different...
nodes.text_bbcode: I just hope College Howard isn't [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] different...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, we're coming up on Greek row. This is where all the fraternities are...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you thinking of turning Greek?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'd seriously consider it. It could be fun... My friend, $USR, hangs out at MAN a lot... It's a lot of fun.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I hear... Mainly from Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She would know. I can totally picture her joining OMG her first year.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: OMG?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know, the sorority. They're always hanging out around MAN house and throwing awesome parties...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They hold the best social events on campus.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's bad enough Howard is going away... But he's going to a place where he'll meet a ton of girls!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, I know this is hard. But talk to me. What are you feeling?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just worried about...
On this special day, we thought it would be nice to view Mother's Day from the most important perspective of all...
A mother!

nodes.title: Mother's Day
nodes.subtitle: A mother's job is never easy...

nodes.text: A beautiful morning dawns across Centerscore...
The sky is clear, the birds are chirping...
And everyone is still in their beds...
Everyone, that is, except for one hardworking mother...
It's just after six in the morning, and Cathy gently rocks a wailing baby to sleep.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, baby Kara... You don't want to cry the `entire` night, do you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, baby Kara... You don't want to cry the [color=#3b78e2][i]entire[/i][/color] night, do you?

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Wahh! Wah! Wah!

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Wah! Wah! Wah!
Cathy sighs.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Let's try another song...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: { Go to sleep... Go to sleep... {

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: { Go to sleep, Little Baby... Go to sleep... {
A few minutes in, Kara at last drops into a peaceful slumber...
Cathy places her in the crib and kisses her, whispering as she walks away.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: That's good...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But it would have been a lot better eight hours ago!
All at once, the door opens, and Horace bursts in!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Happy Mother's Day, Cathy!
Baby Kara starts crying again.

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Wah! Wah! Wah!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, Horace...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Sorry. Since it's Mother's Day... I'll take care of her.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You couldn't have done that when she was screaming in the middle of the night?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: I slept right through it! You know how I am!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: When you can sleep through enemies throwing hand grenades at your shelter during all odd hours of the day, then you can sleep through anything!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Horace, did you just call our daughter a hand grenade?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Uh, er, `no,` dear... I said she was `like` a hand grenade...
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, er, [color=#e23b3b][i]no,[/i][/color] dear... I said she was [color=#e23b3b][i]like[/i][/color] a hand grenade...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Not helping.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Right! Well, why don't you go back to bed?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You're assuming I went to bed in the first place...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Just go and enjoy your Mother's Day breakfast, er...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Breakfast?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: You know, the one the twins like to make for you every year?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You mean, the breakfast that blows up our kitchen every year?!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Yeah... `That` one...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... [color=#e23b3b][i]That[/i][/color] one...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I have to stop them!
Cathy runs downstairs to the kitchen as fast as she can...
And breathes a sigh of relief when she sees the kitchen sitting in tranquil silence.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: They're not awake yet... Which means I have time to hide everything!
Cathy starts scooping up all the kitchen knives, the cheese grater, the meat tenderizer, and the apple slicer, and tucks them into a cabinet with a lock on it.
She then unplugs the stove, the dishwasher, and the blender, and as a final coup de gras, she hides the matches.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Whew!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Why is it that even though I've successfully kept them from making breakfast, I still feel a sense of foreboding?
And that's when she hears...
KABOOM!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And `there` it is...
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]there[/i][/color] it is...

nodes.text: A couple minutes later, Cathy stands on the front lawn, apologizing to the neighbors and making a statement to the police.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Officer Monte, let me get this straight... You found my children standing in front of our neighbor's grill holding a box of matches?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am. And that was only a few minutes after an explosion knocked out the McGraws' outdoor grill.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Unfortunately, that does sound like my children...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: So do you think there was any intent to harm?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Harm? No! Kay and Kel would never try to harm anyone.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Officer Monte, they're just kids...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Kids with a criminal record as thick as my thigh!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: That's... Odd.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We weren't trying to burn Mr. McGraw's house down!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We're just trying to make our mommy a good breakfast! For Mother's Day!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah! For Mother's Day!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Officer Monte, haven't you ever burned something on accident when you tried to do something for your mom on Mother's Day?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Kid, the only thing that would appease my mother on her name day was the hide of a wild bear...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Every year, my brothers and I would venture into the woods, our knives sharpened, our hunting senses sharp...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Officer Monte, I'm going to have to stop you right there... Thank you for investigating this matter so thoroughly...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But if we promise to reimburse Mr. McGraw for the damage, and if my children aren't being arrested, do you think I could get on with my day?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Of course, ma'am.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But you'd best be careful.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I'll take it from here.
As Monte leaves, Cathy turns to the twins.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Why did you two have to blow up our neighbor's kitchen?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You know that the McGraws explicitly told you never to come near their house...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Ever since the burning tree house incident, they've been really jumpy about fire, and now you go and do this?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: It's not our fault! We just wanted your Mother's Day breakfast to be an awesome surprise, so we went across the street to borrow Mr. McGraw's grill!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: How were we supposed to know the difference between lighter fluid and vegetable oil?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: They both come in bottles!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But we did make something for you... You see?
Kay produces a blackened circle from behind her back. Cathy sighs.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I believe this is stealing evidence...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I think it's an English muffin.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Happy Mother's Day?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Happy Mother's Day!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: At least you two are very sweet. Come here...
Cathy wraps them both in a large hug.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Why don't you girls get cleaned up so you won't be late for school?
The twins scamper off.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I hope their wild streak gets better with age...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But what am I saying, they're just going to be teenagers...
Cathy surveys the damage across the street, shakes her head, and goes inside.
Cathy begins putting the kitchen utensils back in their regular places...
When Howard walks in.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey Mom?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Yes, dear? I hope the explosion didn't wake you up...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My, uh, interview with the recruiter from Kingston's today.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, that's right...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I'm so proud of you, Howard. I know you're going to do just great.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, Mom. But I was wondering if you could help me...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Of course, dear...
In Howard's room a minute later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Orange tie or blue tie?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Orange is one of Kingston's colors, but blue looks better on me.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I'd go with a black bowtie.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You sure?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Yes, I am. You want to look your absolute best.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, Mom, do you think my interview will go okay?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You're a nice, caring, and well-spoken young man. You'll be great! Don't think Kingston is above you.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: ...No matter what your father says. Don't forget now, okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I won't.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, Mom.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I completely forgot! Happy Mother's Day!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Of course, dear.
Suddenly, their fire alarm goes off!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I `told` them to `get dressed...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]told[/i][/color] them to [color=#3b78e2][i]get dressed...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Don't you worry about this, Howard. Just get yourself to school. Good luck!
Cathy runs downstairs into the kitchen...
Where Horace has four pans on the stovetop... Two of them on fire!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Oh, come on! You're telling me that `wasn't` vegetable oil?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, come on! You're telling me that [color=#e23b3b][i]wasn't[/i][/color] vegetable oil?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: `What on earth are you doing?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What on earth are you doing?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Happy Mother's Day?
Cathy throws lids on both fires, reaches for the fire extinguisher underneath the table, and blasts it full on the stove until nothing but black smoke and white mist can be seen.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And here's why I think the twins get it from `you...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And here's why I think the twins get it from [color=#3b78e2][i]you...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Which means they must get their natural beauty from you.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Horace, just try not to burn our house down while I'm at the PTA meeting this afternoon, would you?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: ...No promises.
That afternoon, at the Parent-Teacher Association meeting...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Happy Mother's Day, ladies! This session of the PTA will come to order.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Now, are there any last minute comments before we talk about the budget for next year?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Pliny
nodes.text: What I'm trying to figure out is...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Pliny
nodes.text: Who authorized spending our entire budget to host a gigantic paintball tournament?

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: Thank you, Pamela! I've been wondering that forever!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You mean, the Spartan Games? I'll admit I had some part in approving it...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: But that was purely for the sake of school unity...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Of course, I do know that I wasn't the `only one` for it...
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course, I do know that I wasn't the [color=#3b78e2][i]only one[/i][/color] for it...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: What better way to show students' character than by setting them loose in the wild with paintball guns?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Pliny
nodes.text: It feels more like a rehashing of the Fist Club argument that you started up here last year...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: We don't talk about Fist Club!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Pliny
nodes.text: Cathy, what do you think?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Ladies, perhaps it's best if we focus on the future rather than the past...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I, for one, would much rather talk about what we're going to do about the jagged fault running through our school than the silly game we held a couple months ago...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: As always, Howard's mother makes an `excellent point... `
nodes.text_bbcode: As always, Howard's mother makes an [color=#3b78e2][i]excellent point... [/i][/color]

nodes.text: Cathy comes out of the PTA meeting, muttering to herself.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I worry about the state of our public educational system...
As she crosses the parking lot, she can hear quiet sniffling coming from one of the temporary classrooms.
She rounds the corner and finds $ZOE sitting down on a curb, crying.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, hi...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: $ZOE, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, uh, yeah... I'm totally fine.
$ZOE wipes frantically at her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Uh-huh.
Cathy searches in her purse for a tissue and hands it to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Do you want to talk?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... I don't know if I should...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I understand if you don't want to talk to your boyfriend's mom, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not that... It's just...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's about Howard. He's... He's leaving for college...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so sad about it that I just don't know what to do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I want him to do well at the Kingston interview, I really do, but if he goes...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You'll miss him so much that your heart will hurt.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I know how you feel.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Trust me, I do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How can you stand it?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Because I love him, and it's good for him to go.
$ZOE nods and smiles sadly.
Cathy digs another tissue out of her bag and hands it to her.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Can I give you a ride home?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, it's okay... I have some things to think about...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And... Thank you. You really are a great mom.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You take care, $ZOE.
Cathy arrives home, exhausted. She sets her purse down in the foyer and looks around the dark house.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: ...I guess I should be glad no one `is` cooking, but...
nodes.text_bbcode: ...I guess I should be glad no one [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] cooking, but...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Hello? Is anyone home?
She closes the door and enters the dining room.
The lights are turned low, but in the center, Cathy finds an elegant dinner set up with candles and a large bouquet of beautiful flowers.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: `SURPRISE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]SURPRISE![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Surprise!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Surprise!

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Sah-pah! Sah-pah!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Happy Mother's Day, mom!
Cathy finds herself in a sea of hugs.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You guys... You didn't have to do this...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It was the least they could do after this morning...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, we made dinner all by ourselves!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Well, maybe Howard helped a little bit...
Her family around her, Cathy smiles.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, I'm so lucky to have all of you.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I love you, Mommy!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Count me in!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Now... Anyone hungry?
Aww, isn't that sweet? We hope you enjoyed our short story!
To all mothers everywhere... We wish you a `Happy Mother's Day!`
nodes.text_bbcode: To all mothers everywhere... We wish you a [b]Happy Mother's Day![/b]

nodes.text: In honor of Mother's Day, we've included a `free` short story with your episode!
nodes.text_bbcode: In honor of Mother's Day, we've included a [b]free[/b] short story with your episode!

nodes.text: What would you like to do?

nodes.prompt: What would you like to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What would you like to do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And when I find out the person responsible...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They are going to be `so` dead!
nodes.text_bbcode: They are going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] dead!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But who would do this to you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hannah `did` seem really full of herself...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hannah [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] seem really full of herself...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But posting all your texts to a gossip blog? That seems like too much work for Hannah...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're right. It'd have to be someone mean, someone with a `real` chip on their shoulder...
nodes.text_bbcode: You're right. It'd have to be someone mean, someone with a [color=#3b78e2][i]real[/i][/color] chip on their shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think I know...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Jessica.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Jessica.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're right, cuz.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe she would stoop so low!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She didn't have to go after you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course she did! I'm your cousin. She wants to get back at you, so she got to me too!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, but... It's not fair...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sometimes people don't play fair...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How am I supposed to be flattered about this?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Someone took everything I felt for Nick and aired it out like dirty laundry!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm pissed!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... I just meant... Aside from the fact that it's out in public, everything you've done with Nick was sweet and heartfelt...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You care for each other a lot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And the only people who are supposed to know that are `me` and `him!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And the only people who are supposed to know that are [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] and [color=#3b78e2][i]him![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I am so mad!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You heard me! This is awful and infuriating! I'd be so mad!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is a huge breach of your privacy!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You are `so` right!
nodes.text_bbcode: You are [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] right!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm `so` angry!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] angry!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Tomorrow, I'm going to have a `serious talk` with her!
nodes.text_bbcode: Tomorrow, I'm going to have a [color=#3b78e2][i]serious talk[/i][/color] with her!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That'll show her...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Do you think that's too mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, it's great! Be tough! Tell her off! Take her down!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Tomorrow. Right now, I just want to go home.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: At least she can't get to me there...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah... Are you going to be okay? Should I walk you home? I can skip swimming...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And have Coach Kessler chew you out? No, I'll be fine. I'll catch you later.
$ZOE and Sam start to head off campus for their respective destinations...
...And that's when $ZOE notices the whispering.
Various groups of students cluster together, huddled around something $ZOE can't quite see.
Laughter rises from many of the groups, and when people walk by Sam, they point and stare.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, is it me, or is something weird going on?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, everyone's acting strange.
$ZOE suddenly feels her phone buzz in her bag. She takes it out and finds a text.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's weird. I don't recognize this number...
Sam peers over at $ZOE's phone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I wonder if this is what everyone's talking about...
$ZOE opens the text and finds a link to a website called 'The Dirty Dish'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It looks like it's some kind of gossip blog where people can post stuff about Twin Branches students...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hmm... This top post is some kind of text log...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That... That's me! That's my stuff!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That top post is a log of my texts with Nick! It's all stolen from my phone!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They're supposed to be only for me and him!
Some girls walk past Sam and giggle.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, Sam... Have you been hanging out with `sweet emo cakes` lately?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, Sam... Have you been hanging out with [color=#3b78e2][i]sweet emo cakes[/i][/color] lately?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Or do you like it better when he calls you his `hot Sammy snowflake`?
nodes.text_bbcode: Or do you like it better when he calls you his [color=#3b78e2][i]hot Sammy snowflake[/i][/color]?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't make me slap that grin off your face! Because I will!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam!
$ZOE grabs Sam's arm as Hannah approaches them.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Way to go, Sam! I didn't know you had it in you to `sneak into the nurse's office` just to make out with Hottie McEmo Guy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Way to go, Sam! I didn't know you had it in you to [color=#3b78e2][i]sneak into the nurse's office[/i][/color] just to make out with Hottie McEmo Guy!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go away, Hannah!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Aw, come on... I really do think it's kind of cute that you love him `more than meaty pizza.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Aw, come on... I really do think it's kind of cute that you love him [color=#3b78e2][i]more than meaty pizza.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Go away, Hannah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Go away, Hannah![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And quickly, before I let go!
Hannah leaves them, and $ZOE releases Sam's arm.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh... So you and Nick broke into the nurse's office?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes! And `no one` is supposed to know! All that stuff is supposed to be `private!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes! And [color=#3b78e2][i]no one[/i][/color] is supposed to know! All that stuff is supposed to be [color=#3b78e2][i]private![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is so embarrassing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam... It's not embarrassing...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You sure?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, no offense, cuz, but you stink. The bikini's got to be better than staying in those all day.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't wear a bikini around school!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Principal Shapiro almost kicked me out last time!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's your funeral.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe no one will notice?
During lunch...
$ZOE sits down with Howard at the popular table...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE, what...
Howard's eyes widen.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Smells?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no... You can tell?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's kind of hard not to. Seriously, do you smell that? Do you think it's a skunk or something? Like a really sweaty, dying skunk?
Howard looks under the table, and $ZOE collects her lunch.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Maybe? You know, I think I'm just going to hang out in the library...
$ZOE finds a table in the back of the room and shrinks against the wall.
Slowly but certainly, the tables around her start to empty. $ZOE can hear the whispers of people as they walk out...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Ugh, what is that unholy, unnatural stink?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The sulfur and brimstone of the dark caves of Mordarkor?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It smells like that time I threw up mushroom soup!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, it smells like the old mascot costume... Let's go outside... I could use a tan.
After school, in the parking lot...
$ZOE runs into the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE! The girls were just so sad you got academic probation, they wanted to give you a huge hug!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love hugs!
$ZOE quickly steps away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, that's really thoughtful, but no!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What's wrong? Cat got your clean clothes?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I also love cats!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Cat' is not the word that I would use...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And what would you know about that?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Me? `Almost` nothing. Hee hee.
nodes.text_bbcode: Me? [color=#3b78e2][i]Almost[/i][/color] nothing. Hee hee.

nodes.text: As the cheerleaders leave for practice, $ZOE finds Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, uh, how'd wearing your gym clothes all day go for you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was terrible! Apparently, I smell like a sweaty skunk vomiting mushroom soup!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, that's pretty close, actually...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And it's all Jessica's fault!
$ZOE changes into the bikini.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah! Scandalous! That's gonna get the guys drooling for sure!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's not exactly what I wanted, but this feels like the right choice.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't just go around in my gym clothes.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You look `hot!` That's all that matters.
nodes.text_bbcode: You look [color=#3b78e2][i]hot![/i][/color] That's all that matters.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just hope they don't send me home...
At lunch, $ZOE sits with Sam and the entire swim team.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought I'd try to blend in.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Wow, $ZOE, you look...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Practically naked?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm not complaining.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Ignore him, please.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You look nice. I like the color...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, you're so gutsy, $ZOE... Wearing a bikini to school... I wish I'd done it before!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks guys!
In the hall on the way to her last class, $ZOE runs into Ms. Lee!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, Ms. Lee?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: What are you wearing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A bikini? It's... All I had to wear.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh, you poor dear... Well, I guess I shouldn't expect anything more from a student with low grades...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Carry on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Phew!
$ZOE slips into the library for study hall...
She slinks into the back and hides behind a book, hoping to avoid notice by the teacher.
Ryan and Phil sit down at the same table.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE... There's something... Different about you today...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I can't quite put my finger on it...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you know what's good for you, you won't put your fingers on anything.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, no need to get touchy! I'm just admiring your new look! I think my favorite part is how little clothing you're wearing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, I got that, thanks.
After school, in the parking lot, $ZOE runs into the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What `are` you wearing?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] you wearing?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A bikini. I didn't have much of a `choice.`
nodes.text_bbcode: A bikini. I didn't have much of a [color=#3b78e2][i]choice.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Awesome.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! Bikini party!
Amanda pulls off her clothes revealing that she's wearing a bikini underneath!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Do you always wear a bikini under your clothes?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I don't understand the question.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, bikinis aren't really that classy, are they? I mean, just because you lost your normal clothes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What would you know about that?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh... Nothing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Almost` nothing at all. See you later, $ZOE. If you ever get off probation.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Almost[/i][/color] nothing at all. See you later, $ZOE. If you ever get off probation.

nodes.text: As the cheerleaders leave for practice, $ZOE finds Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, uh, how'd wearing that bikini go for you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not as bad as I thought...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it shouldn't have happened in the first place. It's all Jessica's fault!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: So what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My clean clothes were in there!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What am I going to do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Do you have anything else to wear?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just these smelly gym clothes...
$ZOE roots through her gym bag and pulls out a bikini.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And this bikini... I guess I haven't cleaned this bag out since summer...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: The choice seems obvious...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll wear...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ah!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ahhhh!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Geez, you guys, stop that! $ZOE, what is `wrong` with you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Geez, you guys, stop that! $ZOE, what is [color=#3b78e2][i]wrong[/i][/color] with you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My locker's empty!
$ZOE nearly cries out in panic but stops herself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yelling isn't going to help me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Guys, my locker's empty!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: At any rate, it seems like you know your academic topics well enough...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Which means the impossible has happened!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: The system is wrong! You shouldn't be receiving 'F's!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I'll do some digging, and we'll see if we can sort everything out, okay?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Unfortunately, you still are on academic probation until we straighten things out with your grades.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: And until further notice, you're suspended from all sports, dances, and other school activities. No more cheerleading for you!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: But hopefully we can get this fixed before it goes on your permanent record!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Ha! Wouldn't that be awful?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes it would!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, try not to worry. It only affects your chances of getting into college. Go back to class now!
Ms. Lee shoos $ZOE out of her office just as the bell rings.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is going on?!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: At any rate, you failed!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: $ZOE, I'm a psychologist. I know what it's called when a person denies the reality of a situation...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Denial?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: `Crazypants!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Crazypants![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Your grades have suffered terribly this last quarter. I'm going to have to schedule a conference with your teachers and guardian.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, I'm sure this is a mistake!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: There are no mistakes, $ZOE. I told you.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I'll be seeing you at the parent-teacher conference tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Based on these grades, I'm guessing college is out of the question. How do you feel about pizza delivery?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, wait!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: And until further notice, you're suspended from all sports, dances, and other school activities. No more cheerleading for you!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: But try not to let this get you down. Have a nice day, dear!
Ms. Lee shoos $ZOE out of her office just as the bell rings.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is terrible! It's going to be a mess talking to all my teachers! What am I going to do if I don't get into college?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How did this even happen?
$ZOE heads towards her next class when she suddenly sees the cheerleaders talking.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I should probably tell Jessica I can't go to cheerleading today...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So then I told him that red was a hotter color than white... And he just changed his shirt!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Wow, I thought it was hard to get guys to change.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not if you know how to order them around... Hee hee.
$ZOE walks up to Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh hi, $ZOE! You must be enjoying life outside the mascot costume...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kind of, I guess... Hey, Jessica, can we talk? Alone?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sure.
They step off to the side.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't make it to cheerleading today. I'm on academic probation.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How'd you manage that? You didn't get straight 'F's in one quarter, did you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, I did...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How weird! I always thought you were `smart.`
nodes.text_bbcode: How weird! I always thought you were [color=#3b78e2][i]smart.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Maybe it's karma...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm just asking you to `think` about it... You haven't `wronged` anyone recently, have you?
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm just asking you to [color=#3b78e2][i]think[/i][/color] about it... You haven't [color=#3b78e2][i]wronged[/i][/color] anyone recently, have you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't `think` so...
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't [color=#3b78e2][i]think[/i][/color] so...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Think harder.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... All of my grades dropping to 'F's...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, don't sell yourself short... You got a 'D' in math.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `You` were behind this?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You[/i][/color] were behind this?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, $ZOE. I didn't say `that...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, $ZOE. I didn't say [color=#3b78e2][i]that...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You practically did! And it's because I showed you up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Let's get one thing straight... You didn't `show me up.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's get one thing straight... You didn't [color=#3b78e2][i]show me up.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I let you win. But I don't let things go that easily.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And have fun trying to prove that I did `anything` to you!
nodes.text_bbcode: And have fun trying to prove that I did [color=#3b78e2][i]anything[/i][/color] to you!

nodes.text: $ZOE starts to speak up, but Jessica turns her back.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Come on, girls... Let's go...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And, $ZOE, we'll try to miss you at practice.
Jessica leads all the cheerleaders away, leaving $ZOE fuming.
A couple minutes later...
$ZOE and Sam talk as they jog laps in the gym for P.E.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Jessica sabotaged your grades?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes! I don't know how, but she's totally behind it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why don't you just expose her?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because I have no proof! No one's going to believe that Jessica somehow hacked into the school computer and changed my grades!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It sounds stupid, even to me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, if you weren't my cousin, I'd barely believe you either.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just going to have to accept that she might have one-upped me this time...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, if you want me to mess her up, I will.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Sam... You don't have to do that... I don't fight dirty, remember?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thought I'd offer.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It'll be all right...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope...
When the P.E. period is over...
Sam and $ZOE file back into the locker room and start changing out of their gym clothes.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, I'll be glad to get out of these gross clothes.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did Miss Clyatt really have to make us run an entire mile?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Seriously... My face is shining!
$ZOE opens her locker and finds her clothes are gone!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Someone's been studying her milk cartons...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Or, you know, my textbooks!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Your what now?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Wrong!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Looks like someone needs to pay more attention in the P.E. classroom...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Improving eyesight?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Calcium is a mineral that is best known for...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Yikes! Did you even pass ninth grade math?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: It's all right, dear! You don't have to be good at math as long as you're good at sports!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Which brings me to my P.E. question...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Let's see how you're doing in the most important class of all... P.E.!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Scalene?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: In math, a triangle that has two equal sides is called what?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Not the right answer, I'm afraid!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Let's see if you do any better in math...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Correct!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Let's see how you do in math...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Irony?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $ZOE, but because your grades are so low, you're being put on academic probation, effective immediately.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ms. Lee, I know this is wrong! It's a mistake, I'm sure!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What can I do to prove to you that the grades in the computer aren't mine?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, I could go around asking all my teachers to evaluate my performance and give you an accurate grade...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Or you could prove your knowledge of all your subjects to me here and now!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: What better way to prove how you're actually doing than by answering a series of questions related to all your classes?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... Think I preferred my way...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Nonsense! My idea is much more interesting! It's so crazy, it just might work!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Out of curiosity, how often do you say that?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Why, several times a day!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...That's what I thought.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Excellent! It's like a quiz show! Let's begin!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: It says here that you're taking English...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: What is the term for comparing two unlike things using the word 'like' or 'as'?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I don't know what you're implying, but I don't make mistakes!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, unless you count all the guys I've dated for the last three years, but they, at least, gave me gifts!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Now, I don't know what's going on, but clearly you've made some bad decisions this last quarter.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I mean, before this, you got all straight 'A's!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: How far the mighty have fallen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: A fraud?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... What if someone else messed them up?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Do you really think someone hacked into the computer system and changed all your grades?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, think about it, Ms. Lee...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Every quarter before this one, I've received straight 'A's!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, except for that one 'B' in biology I see last year...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I've never done so badly that I've gotten all 'F's!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: That `is` unusual!
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] unusual!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: And I have to admit... The possibility intrigues me...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So can you fix my grades?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Unfortunately, the computer never lies...
At the front, Ms. Prez calls the class to order.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: All right class... Before we dive right into an analysis of the novel... $ZOE, Ms. Lee wants to see you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right now? Uh... Okay...
$ZOE leaves the class.
A few minutes later, $ZOE finds herself in Ms. Lee's temporary office.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: New girl... Welcome to your first day of school!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not new...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh, I know. For some reason, I just always think of you as 'The New Girl'.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: So why are you here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ms. Prez said `you` called `me` into your office...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ms. Prez said [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] called [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] into your office...

nodes.text: Ms. Lee turns to her computer and starts pulling up records.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh yes... I remember now. It's about this!
Ms. Lee points to the screen and shows it to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: $ZOE, this is your report card. I just received an alert about it this morning.
$ZOE looks on the screen and sees that her good grades have been replaced with 'D's and 'F's!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?! I have a 'D' in math? No way! And I can't be getting an 'F' in English! Ms. Prez loves me!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, that sounds inappropriate!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I didn't mean...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I don't get paid to listen to what you mean. I get paid to tell you that I'm very disappointed in you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But Ms. Lee... These grades... It must be...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want to ruin Ben's chances just because I don't like his girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's probably better if I stay out of it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You want to `stay out of it?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You want to [color=#3b78e2][i]stay out of it?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's too late for that! You're right in the middle of it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you let Ben win, you let Jessica win!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And I know I'm not the only one she stuck her nails in to get to the top!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you figure out you want to do more than 'stay out of it', come find me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good luck!
Taylor shakes her head and leaves $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And here I thought it was going to be a `good` day...
nodes.text_bbcode: And here I thought it was going to be a [color=#3b78e2][i]good[/i][/color] day...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I told Jessica I didn't want to support Ben because I don't know anything about his campaign or what he stands for.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I don't know that much more about your campaign either.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My goal is to `beat Jessica`... What more do you need to know?
nodes.text_bbcode: My goal is to [color=#3b78e2][i]beat Jessica[/i][/color]... What more do you need to know?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That just proves my point. I'm sorry, but I can't support you right now.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine. I can accept that.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so relieved!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That doesn't mean I'm happy about it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The longer you wait, the more ground Ben and Jessica will cover.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And the harder it will be to take them down when it's time for the election!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: When you figure out what you want, come find me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good luck!
Taylor shakes her head and leaves $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And here I thought it was going to at least be a drama-free day...
At that moment, Taylor runs up to Sam and $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, yourself.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE... Mind if I walk you to class?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, sure...
$ZOE looks to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is my cue to get out. I'd like to keep my breakfast. See you in P.E.
Taylor and $ZOE walk into their first period class and sit down.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what's up, Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I heard you and Jessica had a falling out last week...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know about that?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Puh-lease. Just because I'm not Head Cheerleader anymore doesn't mean I don't keep tabs on everything that's going on...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I heard it's because you didn't want to endorse Ben.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was part of it...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Which means that you can endorse me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Come on, think about it... You don't want to endorse Ben because of Jessica, that much is clear.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is it?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And I'm totally against both of them, so you should support me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It'll ruin Jessica's plan entirely!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What do you say?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm afraid I can't.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why not?

options.label: I'm not sure I want to support you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, good for you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, what? You like that I haven't decided anything?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No... I like that you're not rushing into a decision.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Your two options are to stay together or to break up...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And both of those are terrible!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know. But I think most couples just try to figure out something quickly without thinking about the consequences of their decision.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's `good` for you to spend some time thinking it over...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#3b78e2][i]good[/i][/color] for you to spend some time thinking it over...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's definitely what I'm doing...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I wish I didn't have to think about it at all.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? Isn't that going to be really hard?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You'd only get to see him on vacations... And you'd only get to talk to him on the phone...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We could video chat... It's better.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But not the same...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know that!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sheesh. Don't have to take my head off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Sam. But I wish we didn't have to talk about it. I'd rather not think about it at all.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? You're just going to end your relationship? You've been together for a really long time!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You might never see him again.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know that!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sheesh. Don't have to take my head off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Sam. But I wish we didn't have to talk about it. I'd rather not think about it at all.

nodes.title: The Last Straw
nodes.subtitle: Can you help $ZOE stand up to Jessica?

nodes.text: $ZOE and Sam are walking towards the temporary classrooms set out in the school parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Today is going to be a good day, I just know it.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And I can already tell today is going to suck.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We've been at school for ten minutes, and I've already lost my phone. I have no idea what happened to it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure it'll turn up. Are you sure you didn't leave it at home?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I was texting Nick the whole ride over. Here's hoping it turns up...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what's got you all worked up? You're practically bouncing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just woke up on the right side of the bed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It might also help that Jessica's been really nice to me since I made that speech last week.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And no one's had to wear that musty old mascot costume for an entire week!
Erik skips past them, wearing his mascot costume!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Lizards smell by tasting the air! Wow!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, no one that doesn't want to anyway.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hah. Well, good for you. Standing up for yourself.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I have to say... I didn't think that Jessica was going to let you go that easy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I told you that she couldn't speak out against me because everyone supported what I had to say...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's the first time I ever participated in girl politics and won!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha. Just don't let it go to your head.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course not. Howard wouldn't approve.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, where `is` that guy? I haven't seen his mopey face around lately.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, where [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] that guy? I haven't seen his mopey face around lately.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's been prepping all week for his interview with Kingston University. It's today, right after school.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is the final interview before they decide if they're going to give him a scholarship or not.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's so nervous. Kingston is his top pick.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If he doesn't do well at this interview, he won't be able to go.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow. No pressure.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know. I hope he does well...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you sure about that? Kingston is far, far, `far` away...
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you sure about that? Kingston is far, far, [color=#3b78e2][i]far[/i][/color] away...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I don't want him to go to Kingston, but it's a good chance for him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what are you going to do if it comes down to him moving across the country?
$ZOE takes off!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nothing's going to get in my way!
She picks up speed going across the asphalt of the parking lot...
Dashes through the makeshift cafeteria...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Almost there!
...And finally sprints across a grassy lawn to the outside of the city library!
She can see Howard pacing nervously in front.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I made it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard! Howard!
She waves to him, running up the stairs to the front.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I came to `warn` you... Something bad is going to happen...
nodes.text_bbcode: I came to [color=#3b78e2][i]warn[/i][/color] you... Something bad is going to happen...

nodes.text: At that moment, Howard is spun around swiftly and forcefully!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa!
Ryan stands there, an ugly grin on his face.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, hotshot!
Ryan pushes Howard, sending him backwards a few feet.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ryan! What was that for?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I just don't like you in my territory!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This isn't `your` territory...
nodes.text_bbcode: This isn't [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] territory...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it will be!
Ryan winds up and throws a punch, clipping Howard in the cheek!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `HOWARD!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]HOWARD![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE feels herself get shoved back as a crowd starts to form around them.
Before $ZOE can say anything, he turns away from her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, but do you mind if I walk home alone? I have some things to think about.
$ZOE nods, and Howard starts trudging away.
As he leaves, $ZOE can feel anger course its way through her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But you're wrong, Howard... This isn't your fault...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's `Jessica's.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#3b78e2][i]Jessica's.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I know exactly what I'm going to do...
A few minutes later, $ZOE bursts into Dex's den where the nerds are playing Ogres 'N' Elves.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ack!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: $ZOE! What a surprise!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: A cheerleader knows where I live?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, guys, but I want to talk to `Taylor.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, guys, but I want to talk to [color=#3b78e2][i]Taylor.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE draws Taylor aside.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going to endorse you for President.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Really? That's amazing! I could totally...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not done yet!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, uh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll support you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But we're not stopping at just beating Ben in the election.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're going to utterly destroy Jessica. We're going to ruin her so bad, she's going to be utterly terrified to show her face in public. We're going to go `scorched earth.`
nodes.text_bbcode: We're going to utterly destroy Jessica. We're going to ruin her so bad, she's going to be utterly terrified to show her face in public. We're going to go [color=#3b78e2][i]scorched earth.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That won't be a problem.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I want your `promise.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I want your [color=#3b78e2][i]promise.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I've never seen this side to you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, well, get used to it! Jessica ruined Howard, and now I'm going to get back at her for it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do I have your word or not?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah! I... I promise! I swear!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good.
$ZOE turns away from Taylor and leaves the den, fury burning in her eyes.
Behind her, Taylor shakily sits down...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I didn't even know $ZOE could get that angry...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I `like` it...
nodes.text_bbcode: But I [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] it...

nodes.text: Good job! It's terrible that Howard isn't going to Kingston... But you helped $ZOE figure out that Jessica needed to be taken down a notch!
You played a great game! Come back next week to see what $ZOE and Taylor get up to!
As $ZOE watches his retreat, she feels an overwhelming sadness envelop her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're wrong, Howard... This isn't your fault...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's `mine.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#3b78e2][i]mine.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: In the park where the cheerleaders are practicing...
$ZOE walks up to Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Can I talk to you for a minute?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sure, but be quick... You're not officially a cheerleader right now, so I don't have to listen to you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You've been doing all these terrible things to me all day...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I admit nothing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It made me realize... I just don't like it when people are mad at me!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You should have thought of that before you decided to challenge `me.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You should have thought of that before you decided to challenge [color=#3b78e2][i]me.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I regret what I did, and I wanted to say...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You win.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I... I win?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just leave Sam and Howard alone.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Does this mean you'll endorse Ben?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I guess I'll endorse Ben...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And you'll back me on whatever I say to the cheerleaders?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And you'll never try to stand up to me again?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE... This is going to be the start of a beautiful friendship...
Uh-oh! $ZOE turns into a doormat, and Jessica gets exactly what she wants?!
This can't be right! Try again and see if you can motivate $ZOE to stand up for herself!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's still a good college.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did that help at all?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A little bit. Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But Centerscore U isn't Kingston, no matter what anyone says.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I had a real shot at my dream school... And I blew it...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is all my fault.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wish I could think of it that way...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But Kingston's one of the best schools in the country!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I could have been their star wide receiver...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That was my dream school!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't want to make things worse...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You didn't. This entire thing is my fault. I blew it.

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: Kingston men don't point fingers, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: This reflects very poorly on you. We don't tolerate this kind of behavior from any of our students, `especially` our athletes.
nodes.text_bbcode: This reflects very poorly on you. We don't tolerate this kind of behavior from any of our students, [color=#e23b3b][i]especially[/i][/color] our athletes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But, sir, let me explain...

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: That time is over. I'm going to have to call this interview off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait! Can't we reschedule?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Please!

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: I'm afraid this was your only chance.
The interviewer walks away.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's it... It's over...
$ZOE reaches out to hug Howard, but he pulls away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, I'm so sorry...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He... He didn't even want to hear what I had to say... I didn't start that fight...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kingston was my dream school. It was the college I've wanted to go to since I was a kid.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And now it's gone.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can't believe I was rejected before the interview even started...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure you can turn this around. You know... Talk to the college, explain what happened...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't even `know` what happened.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't even [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] what happened.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Do you think they'll believe me if I tell them Ryan just picked a fight with me for no reason?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's the truth...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But it still doesn't make me look like a good candidate.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There's no way I'm going to Kingston now...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! Stop!
$ZOE charges forth from the crowd of people and steps in front of Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE?!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ahh!
Ryan pulls his punch, just missing $ZOE by a half inch.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't touch him!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're not going to ruin this for Howard!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you want to fight, you're going to have to get through me first!
$ZOE glares at Ryan menacingly!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Whoa, okay, fine! I'm going, I'm going! I'm not going to hit a `hot` girl!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa, okay, fine! I'm going, I'm going! I'm not going to hit a [color=#e23b3b][i]hot[/i][/color] girl!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why was the emphasis on 'hot'?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: No reason!
Ryan runs off, muttering to himself.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Jessica did not pay me enough for this...
Meanwhile, $ZOE brushes Howard off just as the man in the suit comes up to $ZOE and Howard.

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: Was that a fight I just saw you in?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes, sir...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I didn't start it...
$ZOE does nothing!
Ryan strikes, but Howard manages to catch his fist and pushes him away!
Howard then steps forward and delivers a swift uppercut to Ryan's jaw!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ack!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Stay away from me!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ow, okay, okay! I'm gone!
Ryan stumbles away, muttering to himself.
