nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't worry, you're going to be `totes` amazing!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't worry, you're going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]totes[/i][/color] amazing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I want to make sure everyone knows you endorse me when I present my video, so make sure to introduce me after your opening comments, okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I will...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Great! Good luck!
Jessica gives Ben a kiss, and Ben steps out onto the stage...
The students applaud! Ben goes out to the podium...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My fellow... Ahem...
Jessica flashes him a smile from the side of the stage...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My fellow friends...
Meanwhile, $ZOE and Taylor arrive at the video control room.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What are you two doing back here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We've got evidence against Jessica!
Taylor holds up the USB drive.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Can we switch it out with Jessica's video?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That would be epic! Incredible! An unbelievable coup!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Enough, Captain Thesaurus!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: No... We can't do it...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?! How can you `not` do something technical?! You're nerds!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! How can you [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] do something technical?! You're nerds!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Every one of you knows how to triangulate signals, hack mainframes, and code programs!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm impressed, sweetie. You've really boned up on your nerd terms.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks! I've been paying attention.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We really don't have time for banter, guys!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why can't we switch the video?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Jessica had us set up her laptop to play the video, but it's password protected. None of us knows her password...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Seriously?! We did all this, and we're going to fail because of a dumb password!
While Taylor agonizes, $ZOE sits down in front of Jessica's laptop...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica isn't very computer-savvy. I bet her password is something simple... Something she can remember...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know it!
Taylor and the nerds come over to where $ZOE's sitting...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I thought you said you knew it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought I did! Hold on... Just let me think...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's probably something she `says` a lot...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's probably something she [color=#3b78e2][i]says[/i][/color] a lot...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, yeah, random guessing and `eventually` you'll get it right! There are only like 100 or so possible passwords.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, yeah, random guessing and [color=#3b78e2][i]eventually[/i][/color] you'll get it right! There are only like 100 or so possible passwords.

nodes.text: The nerds share uneasy glances with each other...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was thinking it might be something simple... Like something she says a lot.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Really? You had that idea, and you couldn't get it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not a good speller, okay!
Taylor types in the word 'Totes'.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We're in! I hacked the mainframe!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That's not really a main...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ahem!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Uh, good job, Taylor...
$ZOE types in 'Totes'.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You did it! You hacked the mainframe!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That's not really a main...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ahem!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Uh, I mean, good job hacking the, uh, the mainframe, $ZOE!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks!
$ZOE plugs in the USB drive, copies the file, and waits as it begins to transfer from Steph's USB drive to Jessica's laptop!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh! Why do we have to wait when there's so much technology here?!
On stage, Ben wraps up his speech...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thank you, everyone! For your votes! And your support!
The audience cheers!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Before I'm officially sworn in as President, my First Lady, Jessica, would like to say a few words and present you all with an informative video...
The lights dim as Jessica steps onto the stage, and the applause immediately dies. She stands behind the podium, a wide grin on her face...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Thank you so `so` much for coming today!
nodes.text_bbcode: Thank you so [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much for coming today!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wanted to use Ben's Inauguration as a springboard for some of the changes I'd personally like to implement as First Lady...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Obviously, in order for Ben and I to look our very best, we'll need to free up some money, and that means, `regrettably`, cutting a few wasteful programs...
nodes.text_bbcode: Obviously, in order for Ben and I to look our very best, we'll need to free up some money, and that means, [color=#3b78e2][i]regrettably[/i][/color], cutting a few wasteful programs...

nodes.text: A murmur spreads throughout the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Clubs like... Football Band...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You can't do that!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Music helps me play better!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I'm finally learning the oboe!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Obviously, I'll be getting rid of Eriks Who Love Paul Revere. No-brainer there.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Awww... I was the Vice President!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Why not President if you were the only member?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Too much power, Ashley, too much power.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ahem! And of course I'll be cutting Auto Shop completely, since no one ever uses that place.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hey! We use it!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah, we're in there all the time!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Like, I said... `No one` ever uses that place!
nodes.text_bbcode: Like, I said... [color=#3b78e2][i]No one[/i][/color] ever uses that place!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You can't take away Auto Shop, Jessica! That's our home... And the place where we fantasize about making out with you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Gross! I'll definitely be cutting it now!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Consider this a warning to everyone at this school! And if that wasn't clear enough...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Check out this totes awesome video I made!
A video plays on a huge screen behind Jessica's head...
Back in the control room...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you kidding me?! How long does this take?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's ready!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Play it, $ZOE! Before Jessica's video airs!
$ZOE's finger hovers over the 'Enter' key... Time slows down, nearly stopping. In this moment, a voice inside her speaks...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you sure you want to do this? You're a nice person, and you're about to destroy Jessica, which isn't a very nice thing to do...
Then, all the evil that Jessica's done flashes through $ZOE's brain!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It was $ZOE who played the tape! And it was $ZOE who cheated on Howard in France!
Denni pushes back from the table and storms out of Ben's house!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What just happened?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's pretty obvious. All this attention... Your rise in popularity...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's made her super, super insecure!
Ben pushes Jessica away and stares at her. Jessica feigns shock.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben, you... You totally kissed me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't understand... How does shopping help me get over Denni?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shh! As long as you're under my guidance, we don't mention her name, okay?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, you might not like it at first, but hear me out...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is like the perfect time to give you a makeover!
Jessica brushes past $ZOE, lowering her voice.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This may have worked `one` time, but you'd better stay in line... Or I'll find a way to make you stay there!
nodes.text_bbcode: This may have worked [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] time, but you'd better stay in line... Or I'll find a way to make you stay there!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That top post is a log of my texts with Nick! It's all stolen from my phone!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They're supposed to be only for me and him!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There's no way I'm going to Kingston now...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are you waiting for, $ZOE?! Jessica's video's airing right now! Press the button!
There is no more hesitation in $ZOE...
She re-locks Jessica's computer, quickly setting up a new password.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are you doing? We `just` hacked the mainframe! Why are you setting it back up?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you doing? We [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] hacked the mainframe! Why are you setting it back up?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We can't stoop to Jessica's level, Taylor. We'll end up becoming just like her.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're just coming to this conclusion `now?!` Are you insane?!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're just coming to this conclusion [color=#3b78e2][i]now?![/i][/color] Are you insane?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought of all the things Jessica's done, and I just couldn't bear the idea that I'd ever do something even remotely on her level.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sometimes the best way to fight evil is to be passive... The monster will walk right past you...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, and sometimes the monster eats everything in its path including you and everyone you love!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sometimes the best way to fight evil is to `actually` fight evil!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sometimes the best way to fight evil is to [color=#3b78e2][i]actually[/i][/color] fight evil!

nodes.text: Andrew whispers to Dex...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You getting this? Two hot chicks are fighting right in front of us! About fictional monsters! Whilst surrounded by technology!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Are you kidding? I've never blogged so fiercely!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fighting isn't the answer, Taylor. Passive resistance is!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, you can go sit in the corner and be passive while I switch the videos!
Taylor tries to get to Jessica's laptop, but $ZOE blocks her.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey!
Taylor pushes $ZOE's chair, rolling her out of the way!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey!
As Taylor tries to guess $ZOE's password, $ZOE leaps out of her chair, grabbing at Taylor's hair!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Girls! Stop fighting!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Brendan! Shut up!
The girls struggle, falling to the ground! Taylor puts $ZOE in a headlock!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fighting me isn't very passive, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, you seemed like the kind of monster that would eat my loved ones!
Andrew holds up his phone, filming the fight.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: New greatest day. This afternoon, I saw a pillow fight at Centerscore U. And now, `this!`
nodes.text_bbcode: New greatest day. This afternoon, I saw a pillow fight at Centerscore U. And now, [color=#e23b3b][i]this![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Meanwhile, Jessica's video plays uninterrupted...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Imagine what next year will be like...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Instead of clubs with no purpose...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Or money going toward programs no one cares about...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We'll have parties, like, all the time!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's going to be `totes` the best!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]totes[/i][/color] the best!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Thanks for voting for Ben, everyone! It's like you voted for me!
Definitely not the ending $ZOE wanted! You must play again and see if you can put an end to Jessica's tyranny!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For everyone you've hurt... All the damage you've caused... It's over, Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Totes` over.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Totes[/i][/color] over.

lines.text: $ZOE presses the 'Enter' button.
Meanwhile, on the screen above Jessica, her video plays...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Imagine what next year will be like...
...The video feed is interrupted! The screen turns to static!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Uh... Technical difficulties...
The image shifts and shows Jessica talking to Steph in her computer lab...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Uh...
The crowd starts booing...

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: So on the last night of the election, you want me to hack the system and add in a bunch of votes for this Ben guy?

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Why do you keep repeating everything like that? Yes! Duh!

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: And why would I help you out? You're a Lizard!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Because I'll use my political weight as First Lady to leech all the funding from stupid sports programs, except for cheerleading, of course...

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: Why do I care?

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: I really have to spell it out? Gah! You Wilson idiots really `are` stupid!
lines.text_bbcode: I really have to spell it out? Gah! You Wilson idiots really [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] stupid!

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: Thanks, no offense taken!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: None given!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Without funding, we'll lose, like, `every` game to Wilson High.
lines.text_bbcode: Without funding, we'll lose, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] game to Wilson High.

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: That does sound like a sweet deal...

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: Do you really have that much influence?

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: You have no idea... I can pretty much get Ben to do `whatever` I want.
lines.text_bbcode: You have no idea... I can pretty much get Ben to do [color=#3b78e2][i]whatever[/i][/color] I want.

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: You should have seen how easy it was to get him to break up with his lame hipster ex-girlfriend. It was like a baby `gave` me candy!
lines.text_bbcode: You should have seen how easy it was to get him to break up with his lame hipster ex-girlfriend. It was like a baby [color=#3b78e2][i]gave[/i][/color] me candy!

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: Well, then... I'm in!
Static fills the screen... For one moment, the auditorium is stunned, silent.

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Ha! What a great April Fool's joke that was, wasn't it?
$ZOE and Taylor leap onto the stage!

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: It's no April Fool's joke! Jessica rigged the election! She used Steph to run the Dirty Dish, too!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: `You!`
lines.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You![/i][/color]

lines.text: The crowd boos!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: This is all a misunderstanding!
$ZOE and Taylor step toward Jessica! She turns to flee the stage...
But stops when she sees...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Ben!
Ben stands in front of her, his jaw taut...

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: You used me.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: You `used` me.
lines.text_bbcode: You [color=#e23b3b][i]used[/i][/color] me.

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Fine, yeah, I did! I used you. I knew I could turn you into the President, and I wanted all the perks of being the First Lady...

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Perks?! You `broke` me and Denni up for `perks?!`
lines.text_bbcode: Perks?! You [color=#e23b3b][i]broke[/i][/color] me and Denni up for [color=#e23b3b][i]perks?![/i][/color]

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: I did...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: I'm sorry for that...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: I deceived you, but Ben...
Jessica steps forward and raises her hand to caress Ben's face, but he stops her!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Don't you dare. You don't get to touch me ever again.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Was everything fake?!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: My feelings were real, Ben.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: No, they weren't. You have to be human first to have feelings.

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: What are you saying?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Did you ever stop for even one moment to think that what you were doing was wrong?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: When you were betraying me, hurting Denni, and throwing all of Twin Branches under the bus!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Do you have a conscience?!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: No... You don't... You don't care about anyone but yourself...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Come on, Ben. You know I'm not like that. You know I love you...

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I don't know that because it isn't true. This isn't love... This is just lies and poison!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I thought I knew you... I thought I loved you... But I don't love this Jessica... The `real` Jessica... The `real` you.
lines.text_bbcode: I thought I knew you... I thought I loved you... But I don't love this Jessica... The [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] Jessica... The [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] you.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: And I don't `ever` want to see you again!
lines.text_bbcode: And I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]ever[/i][/color] want to see you again!

lines.text: As the crowd continues to boo, food flies from the audience and onto the stage at Jessica... She flees...
Amid the chaos, Ben and Denni lock eyes... Neither sure of what the other is thinking...
$ZOE gets behind the podium...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: I know it's hard, but please try to calm down everyone... Please, could you just calm down? Guys? Please...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: `Please!`
lines.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Please![/i][/color]

lines.text: The auditorium falls silent.

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: I think I know Ben well enough to say that he doesn't want to win the election this way.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I don't...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: I'm also proud to know how much all of you actually care about who your President is... Enough to riot like this!

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: Enough to vote and campaign for them!

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: That's why I'm going to personally make sure that all the votes you cast get counted, so that we can declare an official President in just a few weeks!
Applause fills the auditorium!

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: And on one, final note...
$ZOE looks at Taylor.

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: Value the friendships you have. They rarely last forever. They can often come from nowhere, but when you find them... Treasure them.
The audience applauds...

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: With Jessica gone, I think $ZOE should step in as the new Head Cheerleader!

lines.speaker: Hector
lines.text: Yeah! $ZOE!

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Woo! $ZOE for Head Cheerleader!

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: But I already voted for Pony!
One by one the cheerleaders call out for $ZOE to become the Head Cheerleader...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: I'm... I'm so flattered... I... I...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: I accept!
The crowd cheers!
Congratulations! You played a great game!
You helped $ZOE express her anger, follow the trail of evidence that led to Jessica's demise, and become the Head Cheerleader!
You became the New Girl, Unleashed!
Before we tally your score, remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam! If you're lucky, you can even Tweet with Amanda!
You have unlocked the bonus scene! Enjoy!
Achieving a grade of A or higher will unlock a special bonus scene!
Taylor sits at the Center Table for the first time in months...

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: Are you a new student?

lines.speaker: Taylor
lines.text: Hi, Amanda.
Brendan sits down next to Taylor...

lines.speaker: Brendan
lines.text: Never sat here before!

lines.speaker: Nicole
lines.text: Two nerds at the Center Table? Jessica, tell them how that's...

lines.speaker: Nicole
lines.text: Oh, right... Never mind.

lines.speaker: Taylor
lines.text: What's the matter, Nicole? Lost your buddy?

lines.speaker: Hector
lines.text: So are you guys gonna sit with us now? No more Nerd Table?

lines.speaker: Taylor
lines.text: We decided it'd be good for me to have more exposure to cool people.

lines.speaker: Brendan
lines.text: So we're going to alternate days! Now, you might be wondering how that works given that there are five days in the school week, an unfortunately odd number.

lines.speaker: Taylor
lines.text: Brendan! What'd I tell you before we sat here?

lines.speaker: Brendan
lines.text: No nerd talk at the cool table.

lines.speaker: Taylor
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: Brendan
lines.text: Oh, right... Uh, any cool parties coming up?

lines.speaker: Carson
lines.text: Only the best party ever!

lines.speaker: Hector
lines.text: Uh, probably want to get a different phrase... We've used that one a lot.

lines.speaker: Carson
lines.text: Only the `hottest` party ever!
lines.text_bbcode: Only the [color=#e23b3b][i]hottest[/i][/color] party ever!

lines.speaker: Hector
lines.text: Carson and I have been planning something so awesome, it will blow your minds!

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: I'm immune to mind-blowing!
As Hector and Carson lay out their party plan, $ZOE can't contain her excitement...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: `Head` Cheerleader! Next year is going to be amazing! I can't wait!
lines.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Head[/i][/color] Cheerleader! Next year is going to be amazing! I can't wait!

lines.speaker: Howard
lines.text: Yeah, amazing...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: Oh, Howard... I'm sorry. I forgot that you won't be here...

lines.speaker: Howard
lines.text: What do you think we should do?

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: I don't know... We can't ignore the fact that you're graduating...

lines.speaker: Howard
lines.text: No, we can't.

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: It's going to happen.
Howard grabs $ZOE's hand and squeezes it.
Meanwhile, out in the parking lot...

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: All right, Princess, I can't stand it. Hit me with the bad news.

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: You and Tweed. Jessica broke you up. Just get it over with, and tell me what we both know is going on.

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: Actually, I think this is a rare case in which only you know what's going on...

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: Are you leaving me for Ben?
Denni punches Colt in the shoulder.

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: Ow! Hey!

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: I'm with you, Doofus.

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: Tell me the thought hadn't crossed your mind now that you know Jessica's responsible for what happened.

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: It... It did, actually.

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: I knew it!

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: Relax... I mean... There was a moment in the auditorium when we looked at each other...

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: That son of a...

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: Colt! He wasn't giving me `the look!` He was just looking at me, okay?
lines.text_bbcode: Colt! He wasn't giving me [color=#3b78e2][i]the look![/i][/color] He was just looking at me, okay?

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: I don't know the difference.

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: I know you don't. But, listen, okay... We looked at each other, and there was nothing there.

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: What? Really?

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: Yeah, it's like... So much time has passed... Ben and I are over. He's the past. `You're` my future.
lines.text_bbcode: Yeah, it's like... So much time has passed... Ben and I are over. He's the past. [color=#3b78e2][i]You're[/i][/color] my future.

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: Can I still beat him up a little? For looking at you, I mean?

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: No! If you beat up every guy who looked at me, you'd be beating up `a lot` of guys!
lines.text_bbcode: No! If you beat up every guy who looked at me, you'd be beating up [color=#3b78e2][i]a lot[/i][/color] of guys!

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: Really? What are their names?

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: Wow. You're incorrigible.

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: Hey! You're a... Dirigible. Didn't think I knew that word, did you?

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: You got me there, baby.
And somewhere very far away... Jessica looks at the schedule of classes at her new school...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: What kind of school is this? Ice fishing? Walrus identification?

lines.speaker: Astrid
lines.text: Helllllooooooooo! Oh how much I enjoy your hair! Enough grease to hold a flame for many days!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Oh no...

lines.speaker: Astrid
lines.text: Do you see the way we are looking? We are twins! Like seahorses galloping across oceans in search of our aqua-equine matings!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Why are you talking to me?

lines.speaker: Astrid
lines.text: You are Jessica, no? The fattest whale of my former school!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Astrid
lines.text: By this I mean you were the most desirable and popular...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Oh, totes! I `am` Jessica!
lines.text_bbcode: Oh, totes! I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] Jessica!

lines.text: Astrid checks over her shoulders...

lines.speaker: Astrid
lines.text: Then I have a message for you...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: You want to help me rule this school?
Astrid reaches into her jacket and pulls out a steaming cup of coffee!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Wha?
She tosses it on Jessica!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: `Ack!`
lines.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ack![/i][/color]

lines.speaker: Astrid
lines.text: That is for mistreating my friends!
Looks like Taylor's finding that healthy balance between nerd and cool, $ZOE and Howard have to deal with Howard's impending graduation...
Denni and Colt are going to be fine...
But Jessica has a long, scalding hot future ahead of her!
Hope you enjoyed your bonus scene!
What will cheerleading be like with $ZOE in command? Stay tuned for the next season of Surviving High School...

nodes.text: $ZOE nods at Taylor...
Taylor dumps the water bottle out over the computer! Sparks shoot out! `Krrrzerp!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Taylor dumps the water bottle out over the computer! Sparks shoot out! [b]Krrrzerp![/b]

nodes.text: The machine goes dark!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Are you crazy?!
Taylor swipes her arm across the desk, sending a bunch of the machines crashing to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe you want to just tell us what you know?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Or... How about now I'm `never` going to tell you because you just damaged several thousand dollars worth of computer equipment!
nodes.text_bbcode: Or... How about now I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] going to tell you because you just damaged several thousand dollars worth of computer equipment!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not what I was hoping to hear...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Then you'll really like to hear that the school will be suing you too!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't we have immunity or something?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: How? How could you possibly be immune from being sued for destroying these computers?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You suck, that's how?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you sure you're not lying?
Steph confidently folds her hands behind her head.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I'm sure I'm not lying...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, if you say so, then we can only assume you're telling the truth.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I guess I am...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So then, I guess we'll be going...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I guess you will...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Look, Steph, you don't know what Jessica's capable of...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But based on what `we` know, it's a pretty safe bet that she promised you something...
nodes.text_bbcode: But based on what [color=#3b78e2][i]we[/i][/color] know, it's a pretty safe bet that she promised you something...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Trust us... She isn't going to follow through on that promise!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: She does seem `really` shady...
nodes.text_bbcode: She does seem [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] shady...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Understatement! She's so shady she's, like... Underneath a tree!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sorry, that wasn't very clever...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But she `is` shady! She rigged the election just so she could reap all the benefits of being First Lady!
nodes.text_bbcode: But she [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] shady! She rigged the election just so she could reap all the benefits of being First Lady!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Don't care.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She broke up a couple just to get what she wanted!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I `really` don't care.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] don't care.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She made my boyfriend and his friends work after school... When we were all going to play Ogres 'N' Elves together!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: What? Why would she do that? Ogres 'N' Elves time is sacred!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not to her, Steph. Not to her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I want to believe you, Steph... I do...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I don't.
$ZOE nods at Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Oh and what is Princess going to do?
Taylor takes out a bottle of water from her purse, unscrews it, and holds it over one of the machines.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Whoa! Whoa! Whoa! Okay, okay! I might have rigged the election too!
Taylor tilts out a drop of water onto the machine... A wisp of smoke fizzles up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Tell us something we don't know!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Paula seemed to think that you might have evidence against Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Maybe I do, maybe I don't...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We know that Paula said she referred Jessica to you...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Oh, well...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Why didn't you just say so in the first place?!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because I'm trying to give you a chance to come clean. Otherwise...
$ZOE nods at Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think I can control her...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Yeah, okay, Jessica came to me for help, but I didn't do anything!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I just set up The Dirty Dish, that's it... I don't know anything about an election!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're lying!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I'm not lying!
Taylor takes out a bottle of water from her purse, unscrews it, and holds it over one of the machines.
Backstage at the Inauguration, Ben paces back and forth, his hands shaking as he practices his speech...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My beloved Centerscorians, er... Twin Branchites, er... This is hopeless!
Jessica comes in through the curtain.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How are you doing, President Kale?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nervous. Really `really` nervous! How does it look out there?
nodes.text_bbcode: Nervous. Really [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] nervous! How does it look out there?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's a packed house. Almost showtime!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Gulp.` I don't know why I asked... I'm never going to be a good President!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Gulp.[/i][/color] I don't know why I asked... I'm never going to be a good President!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Listen, Ben...
Jessica takes Ben's hand as he walks by. He stops pacing and looks at her.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I've never been more proud of you than I am right now.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why? I haven't really done anything...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you kidding me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You transformed yourself, you went from a nerdy no-name with `unbearably` googly eyes to the super hot guy standing in front of me right now...
nodes.text_bbcode: You transformed yourself, you went from a nerdy no-name with [color=#3b78e2][i]unbearably[/i][/color] googly eyes to the super hot guy standing in front of me right now...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're Ben Kale! A patriot in the Spartan Games, a hero in the earthquake, and now, a totes cute President!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You've always been so good to me...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, Ben... You've been good to me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I haven't always been the nicest girl, but you've stuck with me.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And whenever I started to stray from the right path...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You were, like, `right there...` To keep me honest.
nodes.text_bbcode: You were, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]right there...[/i][/color] To keep me honest.

nodes.text: Ben puts a strand of Jessica's hair behind her ear.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I love you, Jess.
Tears well up in Jessica's eyes...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I love you too, Ben.
A tear starts to fall down her cheek. Ben catches it on his finger.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Remember when we first dated, we were at your house, and we looked at your tears through my pocket microscope...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How could I forget that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Those were a different kind of tears then, weren't they?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Completely. I'm a much happier girl today...
Jessica wraps her arms around Ben, and they kiss...
Just then...
The lights go out! Jessica separates herself from Ben!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Again?! Seriously, I've got every nerd in the school working here, and we can't keep the stupid lights on!
Jessica storms off in the direction of the video control room...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess that gives me more time to work on my speech...
Behind a nearby curtain, Denni uses the darkness to dispose a pair of wire cutters...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I hope my little act of sabotage gives $ZOE and Taylor a few more minutes to find evidence against Jessica! Come on, guys! Where are you?
On the Wilson High campus, $ZOE and Taylor manage to track Steph down to the Wilson High computer lab...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: You guys are lucky it's so late in the day... Otherwise, you would have been punked just for showing your pathetic faces around here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's nice to see you too.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are `you` doing here this late?
nodes.text_bbcode: What are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing here this late?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I pretty much live here...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: There aren't many nerds at Wilson. The school's computer lab is really just `my` computer lab. So you're kind of all up in my personal space right now...
nodes.text_bbcode: There aren't many nerds at Wilson. The school's computer lab is really just [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] computer lab. So you're kind of all up in my personal space right now...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: By the way, that means `get out.`
nodes.text_bbcode: By the way, that means [color=#3b78e2][i]get out.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Taylor whispers under her breath to $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good cop, bad cop...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's on...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think it's pretty obvious that of the two of us, I'm the good cop!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just have to choose the right moments to either be nice or to let Taylor step in and be mean!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Steph, we know you helped Jessica run The Dirty Dish and rig the election.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: You don't `know` anything!
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] anything!

nodes.text: The next afternoon, Nick walks into the arcade.
Near the snack bar, the nerds study for their greatest challenge yet...
An Ogres 'N' Elves tournament!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Okay, we're going to discuss proper battle protocol.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Erik, your character has just been asked to duel by the Head Wizard of the Arkanian Priori! What do you say?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Not 'yay'! Your character can't handle the spells developed by the Priori wizards! Only your response will save your life. So what do you say?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh. Right. Uh... 'Thou Head Magician, I duly decline thou demand for due dueling'!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Excellent.
Dex turns to Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Taylor, as a ranger, your character should never engage in an enemy known as the Dargonian. Why?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Because he attacks rangers?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He does something special?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Doesn't he... Doesn't he have some sort of attack I should look out for?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: ...Close enough. Just as long as you remember not to engage him. The specific attack is the 'Bowbreaker', and its use has proliferated since the release of the 4th Version of the handbook...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't stand next to the Dragon. Got it. Can we... Take a break now?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: A break? Guys, this tournament is going to test the strengths and weaknesses of our team. We need to be ready!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: What's the point? Maybe before the earthquake, we had a real chance. What about now?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We can't break apart at the seams. So what if all our character sheets, handbooks, and fantastical hopes and dreams got caught in the school fire?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My fake inn went up in smoke! Literally!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Despite that, we're still a team. In-game `and` out-of-game.
nodes.text_bbcode: Despite that, we're still a team. In-game [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] out-of-game.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Dex, get a grip. I'm talking about ten minutes here.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I agree. A break sounds good.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me too! Who wants some d20-shaped cookies?
As Erik distributes his cookies, Nick approaches the nerds.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey guys... Mind if I take a picture?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What for?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: For the school newspaper?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: You know, some ancient cultures believe that cameras capture your soul...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, not my soul!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, I'm certainly not after that. It's for an article about the earthquake.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That doesn't sound like it'll hurt... What do we have to do?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I just want to see some insight into how people are feeling. The earthquake affected all of us.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You guys go ahead and take this one... I'll just be at the snack bar...
Nick gathers the nerds and poses them.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Perfect. Okay... Think about how you felt when the earthquake happened.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Great, now just hold that...
Nick takes the picture and shows it to the nerds.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Eh.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: I don't like it.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Me neither.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: We look scared! Except for Erik. He just looks bewildered.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I didn't like thinking about that at all! I was inside my mind, but my mind was dark and scary... Like a dentist's office at night!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sorry you had to relive that, Erik. But... You guys `look` fine. I know the earthquake threw me for a loop, and that's what you're showing.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry you had to relive that, Erik. But... You guys [color=#e23b3b][i]look[/i][/color] fine. I know the earthquake threw me for a loop, and that's what you're showing.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: It's not okay if the nerds look scared.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Think about what this picture could do to our rep!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Your... Rep? I think 'being scared' often comes with the territory, doesn't it?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But doesn't that just seem cliche? Isn't there some way we can look cool or funny or something better?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well... Maybe if you make different faces...
They take another picture, but it has the same results.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I guess we're just doomed to look frightened.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe I can help. I can do some post-production work on these photos...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That sounds cool! You mean, like adding effects and stuff?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah. I can change the background a little bit. Why don't I add...
Howard circles Ryan warily.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What is wrong with you?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I just don't like your smug face!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard can't get into a fight now... His interviewer's coming at any minute!
As if on cue, $ZOE spots a well-dressed man in a sharp suit approach the library.
Ryan winds up for another punch...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And here's some footage from the political debate...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And so, Mr. Warren, what would `you` do as President?
nodes.text_bbcode: And so, Mr. Warren, what would [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] do as President?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And of course, we can't forget Sara...
Erik runs the entire interview where Andrew interrogates Sara.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And of course we can't forget our leading man, Ben!
Erik airs the footage of Ben's speech.
Back in the newsroom...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And that concludes the highlights...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So before we dive into our regular news segment, let's report on the latest poll results on the election!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: To you, Justin!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That guy's going to have one tough race ahead of him!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks for the update, Justin.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: In recent news, rabbits have overrun school grounds...
Back in the classroom, Ben sighs.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There goes my lead...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're not out of the race yet. They couldn't have polled everyone. They probably missed some groups that would have voted for you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I have a feeling you'll do just fine...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The last time I heard those words, a lot of rumors were posted to The Dirty Dish...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: For the last time, that `wasn't` me...
nodes.text_bbcode: For the last time, that [color=#3b78e2][i]wasn't[/i][/color] me...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry. Bad joke.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben, I promise you that I'll never post any texts to that horrible website. `Ever.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ben, I promise you that I'll never post any texts to that horrible website. [color=#3b78e2][i]Ever.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You do trust me, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course I do.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good. Now you'll just have to believe me when I tell you... `We're going to win.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Good. Now you'll just have to believe me when I tell you... [color=#3b78e2][i]We're going to win.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks, Jess... I feel like you're always looking out for me.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Believe me... I `am.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Believe me... I [color=#3b78e2][i]am.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Congratulations! You managed to give all the other candidates some headway in the Presidential race!
It's anyone's election now!
But what does that mean for Jessica's plans? Find out next time on Surviving High School!
Before Justin can say anything, Principal Shapiro steps into the frame with a sad look on her face.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm sorry, boys, but I'll be handling this part of the segment.
She takes a seat in between them and looks earnestly at the camera.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I regret to inform everyone that the polling information has given us a disheartening forecast of the future.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Due to the disappointing performances of our candidates...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Students are no longer interested in voting at all!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: The Presidential elections are no longer going to be held.
Back in the classroom, everyone gasps.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well... That was a surprise...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No kidding...
Jessica leaps to her feet and points at the screen.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shapiro's gone insane!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What is she saying? If there isn't a Presidential election, who's going to be President?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, Jessica, down in front! She started talking again!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Democracy has failed us, and I'm afraid we are going to have to put it to rest.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: This is a sad and dark time in our new school's history.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: But do not fear, students. You will not be without a student guide in this time of confusion.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I hereby impose a dictatorship run by the oldest, and presumably wisest, student at this school...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: If you could put her hands together for your dictator for life...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: `Ryan!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ryan![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ryan bounds into frame, smiling for the camera.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I knew staying back for two grades would pay off eventually!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: All you suckers get to listen to me!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And for my first act as dictator...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I will require that all `hot` girls please report to the gym for mandatory swim practice...
nodes.text_bbcode: I will require that all [color=#e23b3b][i]hot[/i][/color] girls please report to the gym for mandatory swim practice...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And if you have to ask if you're `hot`... You probably `aren't.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And if you have to ask if you're [color=#e23b3b][i]hot[/i][/color]... You probably [color=#e23b3b][i]aren't.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Oh no! Ryan as dictator for life?! This is definitely the wrong ending!
What are you doing? Go back to the beginning and try again! Get those candidates some votes!
And make sure to get the Good Ending so you can `cast your vote for President!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And make sure to get the Good Ending so you can [b]cast your vote for President![/b]

nodes.text: The democratic process depends on you!
And a few feet away, Nick can hear Jessica talking.
Around the corner, some of the cheerleaders are coming up to Ryan and hugging him.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I saw your picture in the newspaper, and Denni wrote about how the earthquake hit some people really hard.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I'm so sorry...
Jill hugs him. As she leaves, Nicole comes up.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ryan, I had no idea you could be so sad...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I just want you to know that the earthquake made us all think about our lives and what we could have done...
Nicole hugs him.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I will take your pity!
Nearby, Nick can see Megan and Kenji heading towards Auto-Shop.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I wonder if the nerds liked my edits...
Nick finds the nerds hanging out in front of a classroom.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, did you see the article?
Nick leaves the nerds and runs into Hector, $Scott, and Carson!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I feel like I did a good job... Working with the school newspaper and getting to interview people...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's like this is starting to feel like a place I belong to...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I can't wait to tell Sam...
Nick bursts into Twin Branches's new swimming center.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, Sam!
Nick runs in, but the hall is empty except for one swimmer perched on the side of the pool.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to interrupt you.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's all right. I'm done.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So you're looking for Sam? She just went into the girls' locker room. She'll probably be out in a minute.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks. I guess I'll wait here. I'm Nick Brown, by the way.
Nick holds out his hand. Sara takes it.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sara Kessler.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh right. Your dad is the coach. Wasn't he a swimmer himself?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah. It's kind of the family trade.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ha ha. I see. I've definitely seen your picture in the papers.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I have had my picture taken once or twice before.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe I should have taken some shots of you yesterday.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sorry?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wow, that sounded extremely creepy.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What I meant was that I should have taken pictures of the swim team for the newspaper.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's actually why I'm here. To show Sam the work I've done. Do you want to see?
Nick shows her the article and the pictures.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: These are great!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's kind of cool that you got so many different cliques to pose for it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, I was pretty happy I pulled that off considering...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Considering what?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm new here. I'm still trying to figure out where I fit in.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I know how you feel. Even though I've been at this school since the beginning, it's still like I'm on the `outside.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I know how you feel. Even though I've been at this school since the beginning, it's still like I'm on the [color=#3b78e2][i]outside.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That is exactly how I would put it.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, at least there are two of us now.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ha ha, yeah.
At that moment, Sam walks into the swimming center.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Nick. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let me guess. You have a date planned.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah. That and I have something to share with you.
Nick shows Sam the pictures.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They're... Nice. There are a lot of them.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I got into it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Does this mean you'll get off my back about hanging out all the time?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ha! Well, excuse me for wanting to `see` my girlfriend.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! Well, excuse me for wanting to [color=#e23b3b][i]see[/i][/color] my girlfriend.

nodes.text: Nick kisses Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Anyway, you ready to go? I haven't seen you these past few days... I kind of miss you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I believe you were saying something about a silent film...
Sam pulls Nick towards the door. He looks back one last time at Sara. She waves goodbye.
Looks like you helped Nick a bunch! He found his new place at Twin Branches, he gave Sam some space, and he found a new friend in Sara!
Congratulations! You've done a great job!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Another successful Colting! I knew I'd be President!
Ten minutes later, Colt gets called into Principal Shapiro's temporary office.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You wanted to see me?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: `Want` is a funny word, Mr. Warren. Louisa tells me she already declared you President, completely circumventing our established election process.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Want[/i][/color] is a funny word, Mr. Warren. Louisa tells me she already declared you President, completely circumventing our established election process.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Pretty cool of her, right?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: No. Not cool at all!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You cannot `Colt` this one.
nodes.text_bbcode: You cannot [color=#3b78e2][i]Colt[/i][/color] this one.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa! You know about Colting?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You'd be a fool to think I'm not keeping watch over my students, Mr. Warren.
Principal Shapiro looks out the window...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And lately, the students seem to be concerned only with fighting...
She turns her attention back to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Ms. Lee has her faults, but she would do `anything` for her students. You `will` apologize for taking advantage of her.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ms. Lee has her faults, but she would do [color=#3b78e2][i]anything[/i][/color] for her students. You [color=#3b78e2][i]will[/i][/color] apologize for taking advantage of her.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Additionally, you will drop out of the race for Presidency.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `What?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]What?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: There are too many kids who want to run for office who take this seriously! I won't have you messing up their chances because of some lark of yours!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait... I `want` to run for President. Seriously.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... I [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] to run for President. Seriously.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Does this have something to do with your recent friendship with Miss Fallon?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Being President to impress a girl doesn't count as taking this seriously.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know, I know. But it isn't about impressing her...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She thinks I should think about going to college, and I think she's right... And that's a lot of thinking for me.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm listening...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm not going to be able to get in with my grades... But if I have something extra, something big like President, I might actually turn some heads at the office of admissions.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Maybe I had you pegged wrong... All right, I'll let you run, but on one condition.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shoot.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Tell me one thing you'd change about this school to make it better...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh...
It looks like you didn't quite do well enough to see the end of everyone's story!
Play again to see if you can unlock them all!
And try for an A to unlock the bonus scene and find out about the mystery candidate...
Congratulations! You played a great game, and got to meet four of the candidates!
Let's tally your score!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So $ZOE... You look totes awesome! Have you been working out?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, no more than usual... But thanks.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You look so good, you should be at the center of the cheer formation next time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are... Are you sure? I've been in the back of every routine since you became Cheer Captain.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're the youngest member of the squad. I can't give you a leg-up. The girls who are older should get their chance in the spotlight.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But things are changing. `You're` getting old!
nodes.text_bbcode: But things are changing. [color=#3b78e2][i]You're[/i][/color] getting old!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...  Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's nearly your time to shine. What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica, that'd be awesome, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you okay? You haven't been this nice to me since... Well, since never really...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I might have the teensiest favor to ask...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What can I help you with?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, $ZOE... Ben is really hoping to become President.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. You've been campaigning for him really hard. Most of the school is going to vote for him.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But sadly, 'most of the school' is not enough for him to win. We need a clean sweep, a majority.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I really hope you get it. You're working so hard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My mom always says 'Think big, dream high'...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Believe me, I'm thinking `big.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Believe me, I'm thinking [color=#3b78e2][i]big.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Which brings me to you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're still popular. You were Homecoming Queen after all, and even though there are a lot of rumors about what you did to Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean, about what `you` did to Taylor?
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, about what [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] did to Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's not how everyone else remembers it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But that's all behind us now. What's important is that... People still like you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And if you tell people that `you` like `Ben`, `they` will like Ben!
nodes.text_bbcode: And if you tell people that [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] like [color=#3b78e2][i]Ben[/i][/color], [color=#3b78e2][i]they[/i][/color] will like Ben!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You want me to endorse Ben?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't act so shocked! You've been handing out his cupcakes all day!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're practically halfway there! A public announcement that you wanted Ben to win is just the next step!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I don't know if I want Ben to win...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course you do! You know, if Ben wins, things would get a lot better for you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, honestly, I always felt that you could be, like, my manicured right hand... My backup dancer... My fashionable second-in-command...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Think about all the perks! I could bring you to parties, borrow all your clothes, give you makeovers...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure... That's nice, but...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And you know, I've been real busy lately. It's getting hard to think of new choreography every other week.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I could use some help thinking up a whole new routine...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean... I could use my own choreography?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'd help, of course, but it'd mainly be to supervise. Once Ben wins, it'd just be `so` hard to be First Girlfriend `and` Cheer Captain...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'd help, of course, but it'd mainly be to supervise. Once Ben wins, it'd just be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] hard to be First Girlfriend [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] Cheer Captain...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So will you endorse him?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam was right! She's really pushing this on me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what should I tell her?
Inside, $ZOE sheds her mascot costume and gets into clean clothes.
Jessica stops by.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ew, it smells like sweaty socks in here! No offense, $ZOE, but you reek!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That mascot costume should really be `washed.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That mascot costume should really be [color=#3b78e2][i]washed.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'd do that, but then it wouldn't be half as much fun to put people in.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you want, Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wanted to talk to you about the mascot position...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You did such a good job out there...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm thinking of giving you the position full-time!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: With you out there for every sports game we go to, you'll inspire everyone so much!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What's wrong? You don't look very happy about that...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You were awful! I almost kicked you off the squad right then and there...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But don't worry. I figured out a solution...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You just need to practice more! If you play mascot three or four times a week for every sports game, you'll get better in no time!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What's wrong? You don't look very happy about that...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: To be honest, Jessica... I don't want to be the mascot.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's too bad. It looks like it'll be a great fit for you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Unless...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Unless what?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, there's a possibility my boyfriend's going to be President, and if that happens, I won't be able to devote all my time to cheerleading...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Someone would have to take my place...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're talking about being Head Cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, of course not! `I'm` Head Cheerleader. But you could take my spot in front. That's better than mascot, isn't it?
nodes.text_bbcode: No, of course not! [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] Head Cheerleader. But you could take my spot in front. That's better than mascot, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Most things are...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Great! Then it's settled... You'll support Ben!

options.label: I'm still not sure about that...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You heard me. Turn in your pom-poms and cartwheel yourself out of the park!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... But... I can't be out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love being a cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's too bad. Maybe you should have thought about that before you opened your big mouth!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now go away! You're not one of us anymore!
$ZOE sadly leaves the cheerleaders behind.
The next day after school...
$ZOE meets Sam at a restaurant to talk about her future.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just... I just don't know who I am anymore!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, $ZOE... It's okay. The first couple days after the transition are rough.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you'll get through it. We're going to help you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We?
Taylor walks through the door and sits down next to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I just heard you got kicked off. I thought I needed to be here.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You see... Sam and I started the Cheerleader Displacement Program for cheerleaders who are cut from the squad.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It takes you through the four stages of patheticness.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are those?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The first stage of patheticness is grieving.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We brought you a pillow. Go ahead and cry into it. You lost your good status today.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you think it'll help...
$ZOE takes the pillow and holds it up to her face...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle... Sniffle....

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe... Sniffle... I lost everything...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I lost cheerleading... Sniffle... I could lose school...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's not true... But let it all out...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, if I lose school... Sniffle... I could lose Howard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I lose Howard... Well, you know...
A couple hours later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And if I lose my socks... Sniffle... I could lose my shoes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And if I lose my shoes... Sniffle... Sniffle...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you lose your shoes, it won't matter!
$ZOE sobs harder into the pillow...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Taylor... `
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Taylor... [/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sam, this is getting worse, not better! I can't watch this anymore... It's `too` pathetic!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam, this is getting worse, not better! I can't watch this anymore... It's [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] pathetic!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We're making her do something else!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Step two... Exploring a lot of new hobbies and interests!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Like archery!
Sam hands $ZOE a bow and arrow.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go ahead, $ZOE. Shoot at that clay kitty.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't shoot at a clay kitty...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want to hurt it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you won't... It's clay. It doesn't have any feelings...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That you know of!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, all right. Fine. What about the clay bunny over there then?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's worse!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It looks like all their archery targets are cute, fuzzy animals...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I won't harm them! I refuse!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can already tell you now that archery or any other sport isn't going to do it...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't think archery is going to cut it...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, right, moving on then...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The third stage is playing Ogres 'N' Elves...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't remember this stage...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Some of us might have stopped prematurely at step two.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I don't think $ZOE's going to enjoy playing a `lame` game of...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I don't think $ZOE's going to enjoy playing a [color=#3b78e2][i]lame[/i][/color] game of...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, don't judge... This step really worked for me. Ogres 'N' Elves is actually kind of therapeutic...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: As soon as you figure out all your stats, pick your class and orientation, and start rolling some d20s, it gets good...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have no idea what you just said...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh boy...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's step four of the process?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, step four looks a lot like step one. Cry into a pillow until some new way to makeover your life comes into your head!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I stopped at step two, and Taylor stopped at step three, so this is new territory...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great... I'll just be doomed for the rest of my life not knowing what I'm interested in or where I belong...
Oh no! Zoe's been displaced, and she's having a lot of trouble figuring out what else she wants to do!
Play again and try to make some better choices so $ZOE doesn't have to leave the cheerleading squad!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Actually... There is one more thing.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm listening.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well... I'm not a huge fan of dirty campaigning... But there are a few tricks I know.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm `listening...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]listening...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm not saying we should spread a malicious rumor. That would be wrong and unethical.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Less listening...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: `But...` There are certain ways of phrasing things.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]But...[/i][/color] There are certain ways of phrasing things.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: For example, if you begin a sentence with 'some people say', you can get away with just about anything!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Watch! `Some people say` that $ZOE likes to cheat on her boyfriend with Ryan!
nodes.text_bbcode: Watch! [color=#3b78e2][i]Some people say[/i][/color] that $ZOE likes to cheat on her boyfriend with Ryan!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? They do?! But that's not true!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Which people said that?!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: See? Note how you're mad at some imaginary people... And not at all mad at me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoa...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I love it! Let's do it all the time!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I don't know about `all the time...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know about [color=#3b78e2][i]all the time...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But if we wanted to squeeze in a quick rumor at the end, well, that wouldn't be the worst thing in the world.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll do it! Film me! Film me!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I feel like I've given a little kid a stick of dynamite...
Angie starts the camera...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Everyone knows Jessica runs Ben's campaign... But `did you know` that she has quite a few dirty secrets?
nodes.text_bbcode: Everyone knows Jessica runs Ben's campaign... But [color=#3b78e2][i]did you know[/i][/color] that she has quite a few dirty secrets?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: In fact... `Some people say...`
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact... [color=#3b78e2][i]Some people say...[/i][/color]

options.label: Jessica makes out with a lot of guys.

nodes.text: Sara clears her head and focuses only on the rhythm of her strokes...
Her left arm hits the water, then her right, then her left...
Then her...
A long silence follows after...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: She looks so distraught... What should I say?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Look, Sara, I know it seems bad right now...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But enough about me... What are we going to do about you and Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: She must be furious with you...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Nick... I should have never asked you to be my campaign manager.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm not. It was worth it...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But it totally ruined your relationship with Sam...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sara, that wasn't your fault. And it's not ruined... I can fix it. I think.

options.label: Episode Six: Sara the TV Star

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I... I don't think I'm going to run, Jess.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why not?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've... I've already done everything I can. Nothing's ever going to feel as good as it did when I saved everyone...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And that's it? You're sure? Even knowing that this is something I want you to do for me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... I understand if you don't want to be with me any...
Jessica stands up.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Bye, Ben. We're over.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?!
Jessica doesn't stick around to explain herself...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jess...
Want to see a happier conclusion to Ben's story? Try again and see if you can score enough points to unlock it!
In the meantime, let's check out the next candidate...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Emily loves me so much, she'll follow in my footsteps, whatever I do...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But I'm a swimmer... That's what I do... And that's what she'll do...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: In fact, that's what I'm going to do now... Might as well...
Later that night, Sara sneaks into the pool and swims laps, the water cold and uninviting...
She tries not to think about what it will mean to swim and only swim for the rest of her life...
But the more she tries, the more it becomes evident to her...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm `alone...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]alone...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Want to see a happier ending to Sara's story? Try again and see if you can score enough points to unlock it!
In the meantime, let's check out the next candidate...
Later that week...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt! They just announced the candidates for President! You said you signed up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shrapnel must have rejected me...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I guess we'll have to find another way to make you attractive for college.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You saying I'm ugly, Princess?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No. I'm saying we need to...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know. That's enough, Tiny Hipster. I don't need to go to college.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What? You're sure?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm sure...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What about when `I` go to college...
nodes.text_bbcode: What about when [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] go to college...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's not happening anytime soon.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But it will happen...
Want to see a happier conclusion to Colt's story? Try again and see if you can score enough points to unlock it!
In the meantime, let's check out the next candidate...
That evening...
Howard and $ZOE walk into Howard's house where a beautiful dinner has been set out!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Welcome home, you two! Find a seat. Horace and I will be there soon.
Howard and $ZOE sit down.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm really glad I'm here with you tonight. I've had a rough day.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Definitely. It sounds like you deserve a good meal right now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've just been feeling so weird about what happened with Jessica earlier...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, hopefully it was just a one-time thing...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... I'm just going to ignore it, and it'll blow over eventually...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But right now, I'm looking forward to digging in!
Howard's family joins them, and they eat dinner.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: $ZOE, we are so glad you could join us.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah! We always get the good food when you're here.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We never get dessert on normal days!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee. Thank you for inviting me over. You know how much I love your guys' chicken and broccoli dish!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Well, isn't that sweet? It is my specialty.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: It's the only thing he can cook besides grilled cheese sandwiches...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Which are also delicious, I might add.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Of course they are, dear.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Anyway, $ZOE, are you free on the weekend right after school gets out for summer break?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: That's when we were going to host Howard's graduation party.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, right... Graduation is coming up soon...
$ZOE feels a heavy weight on her heart.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, yeah... I should be free.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh good! We're going to have it at the country club. It'll be fancy since this is a big deal!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: And here I never thought I would see Howard become a man.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: It's so strange to think of my little Howard growing up.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: It feels like just yesterday he was Kay and Kel's age.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh wow...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Does that mean tomorrow we can drive a car?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I want to drive a car!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh man, I'm glad I'll be `gone` when you two holy terrors start driving...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh man, I'm glad I'll be [color=#e23b3b][i]gone[/i][/color] when you two holy terrors start driving...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Gone'?
Suddenly, $ZOE feels like the air has been sucked out of the room.
$ZOE takes in a slow, steady breath as Howard's family talks around her.

nodes.speaker: Mom
