nodes.text: You never know, Howard. Depending on which college you get into, you might be seeing them more than you think.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What... What colleges have you applied to, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I sent out a few to colleges in the area... Centerscore U, for one.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I've also been hearing back from `other schools...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And I've also been hearing back from [color=#e23b3b][i]other schools...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Other schools?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Right! Tell her about the one that might offer you a full scholarship, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, uh, it's not a sure bet, but there's one college that wants me to join their football team.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Isn't that great?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: It'd make up for those years we spent paying for all your football equipment.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And it's a prestigious institution. You'd do well, even if you are far away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Far away?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Which school is it?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Kingston University. It's located on the East Coast, somewhere near New York.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: New York? That's... That's all the way across the country!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And it'd be difficult to visit. The plane flight's at least `six hours...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And it'd be difficult to visit. The plane flight's at least [color=#3b78e2][i]six hours...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: At Sam's house...
Nick rings the doorbell nervously. $ZOE opens the front door.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She wants me to tell you that she never wants to talk to you ever again.
$ZOE lowers her voice down to a whisper.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But if you rush past me, swearing that you have to speak to her right now, I'll corroborate your story.
Nick flashes her a grateful smile.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Out of my way, $ZOE! I have to speak with your cousin right away!
Nick passes her and runs up to Sam's room.
Sam is sitting on her bed, her face in her pillow.
Nick knocks on the door.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is that loser worm-face gone yet?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Not quite.
Sam's head jerks up, and for a moment, Nick shrinks back at the fury of her gaze.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, I came to talk, to tell you the truth.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've heard `the truth` from `everyone else!` Now get out of my room!
nodes.text_bbcode: I've heard [color=#3b78e2][i]the truth[/i][/color] from [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone else![/i][/color] Now get out of my room!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, you haven't heard the truth `from me.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you haven't heard the truth [color=#e23b3b][i]from me.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: At least hear me out.
Sam just glares at him. Nick takes her silence as acceptance.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, you're one of the most awesome people I know, and I care a lot about you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I can't stand to see you upset when you have nothing to be upset over.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The photo's misleading. Jessica just put it up on the site to throw Sara out of the election and to hurt you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sara had nothing to do with it, and neither of us did anything wrong.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It might sound far-fetched, but it's the truth.
Sam sighs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...I believe you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Unlike my last boyfriend, you're the kind of guy who actually means what he says.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you've got to understand that it's not just about whether or not you did something wrong...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's about whether you `would.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's about whether you [color=#3b78e2][i]would.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't quite follow.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Today has made me think a lot about you and Sara. Would something `ever` happen between you two?
nodes.text_bbcode: Today has made me think a lot about you and Sara. Would something [color=#3b78e2][i]ever[/i][/color] happen between you two?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If you can honestly tell me 'no', then I'll move past this. `We'll` move on.
nodes.text_bbcode: If you can honestly tell me 'no', then I'll move past this. [color=#3b78e2][i]We'll[/i][/color] move on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So tell me... Do you have any feelings at all for Sara?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, this is ridiculous.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Do` you?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Do[/i][/color] you?

nodes.text: Anger rises up once again within $ZOE! She tries to suppress it, but the longer she holds it inside her, the harder it becomes to contain!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eep! Gotta go!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What? Where are you going?!
$ZOE flees the auditorium...
...Sprints through the temporary cafeteria...
...And runs into the restroom, where she slams the door behind her, closes her eyes, and...
When she opens her eyes again, she sees Taylor staring at her wide-eyed, standing in front of the mirror...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shut. Up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I didn't know you had that in you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't either!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let me guess... Jessica?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We've got to take her down, Taylor! She might have beat us in the election, but I'm not done fighting!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I was thinking the exact same thing... And `not` because I lost to Ben... But because all day I've been hearing people say that they voted for someone else!
nodes.text_bbcode: I was thinking the exact same thing... And [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] because I lost to Ben... But because all day I've been hearing people say that they voted for someone else!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If so many people didn't vote for Ben, how did he win by a landslide?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Something smells fishy...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It does smell fishy in here. It's kinda gross. Probably the fishsticks from the kitchen coming in through the ventilation system...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I meant with the election!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, well, yeah!
At that moment, Denni bursts into the bathroom, slams the door behind her, closes her eyes, and...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: When she opens her eyes, she sees $ZOE and Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yes! She's the worst! You guys are fed up with her too?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's a rapidly growing club...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How'd she get to you?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, I was going over the voting trends for this article I promised Jessica I'd write for her...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Don't` ask. It's a favor from a long time ago...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Don't[/i][/color] ask. It's a favor from a long time ago...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Anyway, the numbers just didn't make sense!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The vote was in a dead heat all the way to the end... And then right before the polls closed, a ton of votes for Ben poured in!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm sure Jessica rigged the election somehow, but I don't have any evidence.  So instead of exposing her, I'm doing the exact opposite...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: She's got me writing a fluff piece about how amazing she and Ben are!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know. Kill me now, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Guys, we need to get evidence against Jessica! Otherwise, she's going to make all our lives miserable!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great plan, $ZOE! Let's just head on down to the evidence store and pick us up a big old bag of evidence!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry! Do you have a better idea?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Naturally! We could write, like, a computer program that analyzed everything that Jessica's done up to now! The computer will lead us right to the evidence!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: A computer program? Really? I didn't think I'd be saying this... But `evidence store` sounds like the most plausible idea.
nodes.text_bbcode: A computer program? Really? I didn't think I'd be saying this... But [color=#3b78e2][i]evidence store[/i][/color] sounds like the most plausible idea.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine! That wasn't perfect, but how about this idea? We `role-play` as Jessica. Then, we'll, like, know how she thinks!
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine! That wasn't perfect, but how about this idea? We [color=#3b78e2][i]role-play[/i][/color] as Jessica. Then, we'll, like, know how she thinks!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I assumed you already thought like her, but that's becoming less and less certain the more you speak...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, I used to be so good at being devious... What happened?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's it! That's the key! Taylor's gotten too nerdy to scheme the way Jessica does!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If only I could somehow trigger the `old` Taylor, I bet `she` could come up with a better plan!
nodes.text_bbcode: If only I could somehow trigger the [color=#3b78e2][i]old[/i][/color] Taylor, I bet [color=#3b78e2][i]she[/i][/color] could come up with a better plan!

nodes.text: $ZOE takes a deep breath...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry for what I'm about to say, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, Taylor, maybe you'd be better at being devious if you...
$ZOE has failed.

nodes.text: Later, as $ZOE and Taylor are leaving the school...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We messed that interrogation up, didn't we?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Or `you` did!
nodes.text_bbcode: Or [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] did!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess all we can do now is head back to the school...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And watch the Inauguration...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And see Jessica `win...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And see Jessica [color=#3b78e2][i]win...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Zoe has failed...

menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: The next afternoon, Nick walks through the school parking lot towards the Auto Shop when he hears a curious sound from behind a truck.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It sounds like... Someone's sobbing?
Quietly, Nick approaches the sound. Hiding behind a car, he peers around it.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's... Ryan!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Sniffle... Sniffle...
Despite the surprising situation, Nick can't help but notice what a great picture it would make.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jess, I'm going to run for President!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: For reals?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... I think I finally figured out why I want to run...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why?
Out of the corner of Ben's eye, he sees Justin leaving...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll tell you later... Right now, I think I've got a big problem.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What is it?
Ben tells Jessica about his conversation with Justin.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So what do you think, Campaign Manager?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If he's going to fight dirty, then we will too!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't want to sink to his level, Jess.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ben, remember how Justin tried to spend Sam's prize money so that the Spartans wouldn't get any of it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... That would have been a disaster.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If Justin wins, what's going to prevent the same thing from happening again? He can't see the big picture, Ben... Not the way you will...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're right, but I still don't like it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't worry, Ben... I'm not going to make you do something you don't want to do. I'm done with that. Leave the dirty stuff to me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... What are you going to do?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You'll see...
In the parking lot that night, Ben meets with Justin.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Is this your way of conceding the race before it even starts? If so, you could have just done it over the phone.
Ben hands Justin a manila folder.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What's this?
He opens it.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: These are personal letters I never sent to Angie! How did you get these?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Someone wanted me to use these against you... But I talked her out of it... I'm not going to use them.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I don't understand... Why give them to me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've decided to run for President, and I thought you should know my reason for running.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm not sure I care.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I want to make a difference.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What? That's...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Old-fashioned and lame? I know, but it's been pulling on me ever since the earthquake crisis...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I really loved helping people. And even though there isn't a life-threatening catastrophe happening every second, people still need help during the normal times.
Justin sighs...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I see you've made a couple of tough choices in the last few hours...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I have.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Then I guess... Thanks for choosing not to use the letters...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Did you read them?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Only enough to get the gist.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's... It's only fair that I fight a clean campaign. Nothing dirty. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ditto.
They shake hands.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Besides, I think we've got our work cut out for us now.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You didn't hear? We're not the only ones running for President.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? Who else signed up?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Emily loves me so much, she'll follow in my footsteps, whatever I do...
The next day, Sara is heading toward Ms. Lee's temporary office when she runs into Nick.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hey, Nick! I was just going to sign up to run for President!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Taking my advice? I'm surprised considering how dumb we guys are...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Actually, my motivation came from home.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: From your dad? Isn't he kind of... Not encouraging?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: To put it mildly. It came from my younger sister.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't know you had a sister...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, she's growing up, and I thought I'd try to be a better role model for her.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I guess we can add that to the list of Kessler verbs: Swimming, eating, and now, role-modeling.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hee hee! Very funny.
Nick reaches into his backpack, and pulls out a stack of glossy pictures.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I was planning on using these to convince you to run...
He hands them to her. Each one has a picture of Sara swimming, the entire image laid out perfectly.
Stylized text says, 'Vote for Sara. She's a Kessler. And that means, she cares about what she does.'

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: These are amazing!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't know if you've thought about this yet, since you've only just decided to run, but...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Do you want me to be your campaign manager?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, I like you.
Sara can't help but blush.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I mean, not like that. What I meant was...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I like you... Others will too.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Awww... I would really like it if you were my campaign manager, Nick.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: We'll be the Outsider Party.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Great! Because I just found out who else is running, and I think you'll need all the help you can get!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Wait... Who else is running?!
That night, Colt climbs in through Denni's window.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So, am I dating the new school President?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I wish.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What? I'm so shocked! You weren't able to convince the universe that 'The Coltster' should just `be` President, no work required?
nodes.text_bbcode: What? I'm so shocked! You weren't able to convince the universe that 'The Coltster' should just [color=#3b78e2][i]be[/i][/color] President, no work required?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, I'm wounded already, Princess. I don't need you to twist the knife any more than it's already twisted.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm sorry. What happened?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I got hit by some shrapnel, that's what.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Shapiro?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, she's a tough cookie. It looks like I'm going to have to run for President the normal way.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That means campaign posters, slogans, a lame speech. Blech. So much work.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This way sucks.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, sometimes you just have to `Denni` it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, sometimes you just have to [color=#3b78e2][i]Denni[/i][/color] it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is that what the normal way's called?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yup. And luckily, you've got me to help you through it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait a second, maybe I don't want you as my manager. How good are you at `Denni-ing?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a second, maybe I don't want you as my manager. How good are you at [color=#e23b3b][i]Denni-ing?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The best. This way `is` named after me, after all.
nodes.text_bbcode: The best. This way [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] named after me, after all.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh. You're hired.
Colt takes Denni's hand. She looks up at him.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, uh... Do you think I can really do it?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The normal way? It's not `that` hard, Colt.
nodes.text_bbcode: The normal way? It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] hard, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, I mean... Do you think I could go to college?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: If you tried, Colt, I think you could probably do just about anything.
Colt looks deeply into Denni's eyes.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's just... No one's ever gone to college in my family...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No one's ever even mentioned college to me...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're the first, Princess.
He leans down and kisses her.
After a long time, they part.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why are you smiling so much?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I just realized that with you helping me out, I can't lose!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That might have been true if you were just running against Justin...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, which nerd can compete against me?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You didn't hear?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Who is it? Who else is running?
Congratulations! You played a great game, and got to meet four of the candidates!
Let's tally your score!
The next day after school, $ZOE and the other cheerleaders gather in the Wilson High gym right before a basketball game.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, these losers are so lucky they have a gym.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Girls, huddle!
The cheerleaders crowd around Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Listen, I want to switch things up `temporarily... `
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen, I want to switch things up [color=#3b78e2][i]temporarily... [/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jessica nods at $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wonder what that means...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nicole, you've been cheering from the front row for the last few weeks. Why don't we change that?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What? But... I'm always in front!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know, and times are changing. Everyone should have a turn...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So that's why I want someone new and special to stand in the front row...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is she going to pick me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Someone who really deserves it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Jill!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Jill![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: What? But I...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: This is great! I'm usually the mascot!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But where am I supposed to go?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Don't tell me I have to wear that smelly old suit!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You can take $ZOE's place in the back.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...But what about me?
Jessica gives $ZOE a wide smile.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I thought you might `temporarily` enjoy being mascot.
nodes.text_bbcode: I thought you might [color=#3b78e2][i]temporarily[/i][/color] enjoy being mascot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh really?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's just for one night...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Unless you decide you `really` love it...
nodes.text_bbcode: Unless you decide you [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] love it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's what you always wanted to do, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's making me mascot because I wouldn't endorse Ben!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's time to go out and cheer! Have fun!
She winks at $ZOE and runs onto the court.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll show her... I'll try to be the best mascot ever!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want things to change...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They won't change that much...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What if you move across the country? What then?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We'll figure out how to be together. No matter where I go.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do `you` feel about everything?
nodes.text_bbcode: How do [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] feel about everything?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I'm sad. I don't want to leave Twin Branches...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But at the same time, it's exciting. College will be something interesting and new.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If we went to the same college, it wouldn't matter how long we were apart. We'd still end up together.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, I have an idea... I'm going to Centerscore University later this week for a campus tour.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why don't you come with me? We can check out the campus... Eat some college food... Crash some parties...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean, see how cool college is compared to high school?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, at the very least we could time exactly how far apart we would be from each other.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Trust me, everything's going to be just fine. Like it is now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Except that everything `isn't` fine now...
nodes.text_bbcode: Except that everything [color=#3b78e2][i]isn't[/i][/color] fine now...

nodes.text: Howard wraps his arms around her. They stay that way for long while...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have to keep it together... I don't want to lose it in front of Howard's family.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's great news, Howard. Kingston is a very good school. I'll keep my fingers crossed.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE. We'll see how I do on my interview with them next week.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Besides, I'm not even sure I want to go.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Just make sure you consider it.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: We can figure it out when we get there. In the meantime...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Kay and Kel, since you've had so much dessert, why don't you two do the dishes?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Aww...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yay, bubbles!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I should head home. Thank you for dinner.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: You're very welcome. Goodnight, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll walk her out.
Howard walks $ZOE to the door.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, what's wrong? You didn't seem like yourself at the end.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, you're going off to college... Soon, you'll be moving out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All this talk about you going away scares me.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, honestly, I always felt that you could be, like, my manicured right hand... My backup dancer... My fashionable second-in-command...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Think about all the perks! I could bring you to parties, borrow all your clothes, give you makeovers...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure... That's nice, but...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And you know, I've been real busy lately. It's getting hard to think of new choreography every other week.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I could use some help thinking up a whole new routine...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean... I could use my own choreography?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'd help, of course, but it'd mainly be to supervise. Once Ben wins, it'd just be `so` hard to be First Girlfriend `and` Cheer Captain...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'd help, of course, but it'd mainly be to supervise. Once Ben wins, it'd just be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] hard to be First Girlfriend [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] Cheer Captain...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So will you endorse him?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam was right! She's really pushing this on me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what should I tell her?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: To be honest, Jessica... I don't want to be the mascot.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's too bad. It looks like it'll be a great fit for you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Unless...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Unless what?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, there's a possibility my boyfriend's going to be President, and if that happens, I won't be able to devote all my time to cheerleading...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Someone would have to take my place...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're talking about being Head Cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, of course not! `I'm` Head Cheerleader. But you could take my spot in front. That's better than mascot, isn't it?
nodes.text_bbcode: No, of course not! [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] Head Cheerleader. But you could take my spot in front. That's better than mascot, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Most things are...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Great! Then it's settled... You'll support Ben!

options.label: I'm still not sure about that...

nodes.text: Her gaze finally lands hard on $ZOE, and $ZOE meets her eyes, the tension growing between them.
Then suddenly... Jessica laughs.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, don't be silly...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wasn't `threatening` you with the mascot costume. I was just giving Jill a break!
nodes.text_bbcode: I wasn't [color=#3b78e2][i]threatening[/i][/color] you with the mascot costume. I was just giving Jill a break!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You were?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course! The mascot costume isn't punishment! Who do you think I am? Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sheesh. You try to do someone a favor, and that's how they repay you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're a cheerleader, not an animal.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But all those things you said about endorsing Ben...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Endorsing Ben, schmendorsing Ben. Who cares? I just wanted your bid, and I was hoping you'd help me out.
Jessica laughs, and this prompts some nervous laughter from the other girls.
Suddenly, $ZOE knows exactly what's happened.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's being nice to me because she can't kick me off the team. She knows the other girls support me, and if she dumps me, she'll risk alienating them!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's really funny, Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I guess this means we'll have to find a new mascot.
Jessica's eye twitches.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah... A `new` mascot. Nicole, Maria, get on that.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... A [color=#3b78e2][i]new[/i][/color] mascot. Nicole, Maria, get on that.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Right away!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Other than that, you girls are free to go. I have some planning to do...
Jessica brushes past $ZOE, lowering her voice.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This may have worked `one` time, but you'd better stay in line... Or I'll find a way to make you stay there!
nodes.text_bbcode: This may have worked [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] time, but you'd better stay in line... Or I'll find a way to make you stay there!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just kidding!
Jessica gives $ZOE a very hard pat on the back and stalks off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I did it! I stood up to Jessica! That means, I don't have to be mascot, and I can stay on the team!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But Jessica did look furious... I just hope I didn't start something I can't handle...
Congratulations! You helped $ZOE navigate through some very tough spots!
Not only did you help her calm down about Howard going to college, but you also helped her stand up to Jessica!
No more mascot costumes for you `or` her!
nodes.text_bbcode: No more mascot costumes for you [b]or[/b] her!

nodes.text: Let's just hope what $ZOE has done doesn't have too many `bad` consequences...
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's just hope what $ZOE has done doesn't have too many [b]bad[/b] consequences...

nodes.text: As he leaves, $ZOE can feel anger course its way through her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But you're wrong, Howard... This isn't your fault...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's `Jessica's.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#3b78e2][i]Jessica's.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I know exactly what I'm going to do...
A few minutes later, $ZOE bursts into Dex's den where the nerds are playing Ogres 'N' Elves.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ack!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: $ZOE! What a surprise!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: A cheerleader knows where I live?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, guys, but I want to talk to `Taylor.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, guys, but I want to talk to [color=#3b78e2][i]Taylor.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE draws Taylor aside.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going to endorse you for President.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Really? That's amazing! I could totally...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not done yet!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, uh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll support you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But we're not stopping at just beating Ben in the election.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're going to utterly destroy Jessica. We're going to ruin her so bad, she's going to be utterly terrified to show her face in public. We're going to go `scorched earth.`
nodes.text_bbcode: We're going to utterly destroy Jessica. We're going to ruin her so bad, she's going to be utterly terrified to show her face in public. We're going to go [color=#3b78e2][i]scorched earth.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That won't be a problem.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I want your `promise.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I want your [color=#3b78e2][i]promise.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I've never seen this side to you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, well, get used to it! Jessica ruined Howard, and now I'm going to get back at her for it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do I have your word or not?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah! I... I promise! I swear!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good.
$ZOE turns away from Taylor and leaves the den, fury burning in her eyes.
Behind her, Taylor shakily sits down...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I didn't even know $ZOE could get that angry...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I `like` it...
nodes.text_bbcode: But I [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] it...

nodes.text: Good job! It's terrible that Howard isn't going to Kingston... But you helped $ZOE figure out that Jessica needed to be taken down a notch!
You played a great game! Come back next week to see what $ZOE and Taylor get up to!
Coach storms off, knocking over a life preserver on the way!
The rest of the team swims over to Sara, forming a circle around her...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm sorry, girls. I think my dad's just high-strung because the tournament's coming up.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We're used to your dad freaking out about `every` race... But he's got a point this time!
nodes.text_bbcode: We're used to your dad freaking out about [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] race... But he's got a point this time!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What point is that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That you `are` distracted, Sara!
nodes.text_bbcode: That you [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] distracted, Sara!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: It shouldn't have even been a close race!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's true, Sara... You're way faster than me!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's all because of this TV interview for her campaign!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe you're doing one! It's kind of selfish, Sara! It's like you're sacrificing us to boost `your` Presidential campaign!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe you're doing one! It's kind of selfish, Sara! It's like you're sacrificing us to boost [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] Presidential campaign!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What? That's not true at all... I promise you... I'll make sure...

options.label: You all get to be on TV!

nodes.text: Sara keeps her rhythm and touches the wall an instant before Linda does!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yes! I did it!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What happened out there, Sara?!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What do you mean? I came in first!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Against the other girls, yeah, but not against yourself!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You're going to have to race your best if you're going to hold your own at the Wilson Tourney! You're three seconds off your best pace!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: So? You're distracted, it's obvious!
Sara starts to get out of the pool...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You said everyone who doesn't get first has to swim extra laps!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And by my count, `no one` came in first...
nodes.text_bbcode: And by my count, [color=#e23b3b][i]no one[/i][/color] came in first...

nodes.text: Sara settles back into the water...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: We'll talk about what's distracting you tonight, young lady.
Sara has failed.
`Luckily,` you get another chance! See if you can help Sara keep her head above water, beat Elliana, and unlock the Good Ending!
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Luckily,[/b] you get another chance! See if you can help Sara keep her head above water, beat Elliana, and unlock the Good Ending!

nodes.text: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: As Sara lifts her head out of the water, she hears the chants from the crowd...
`Ell-i-a-na! Ell-i-a-na! Ell-i-a-na!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Ell-i-a-na! Ell-i-a-na! Ell-i-a-na![/b]

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: There you have it! The winner of the match is `Elliana!` Wilson High wins the Wilson Tournament once again!
nodes.text_bbcode: There you have it! The winner of the match is [color=#e23b3b][i]Elliana![/i][/color] Wilson High wins the Wilson Tournament once again!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! I am better than a machine! That means I am a goddess!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I guess I lost...
All Sara can see is disappointment on the faces of those she cares about...
Even on the face of Nick...
As she scans the crowd for some sign of support her eyes settle on the beaming face of Jessica...
Sara dunks her head back under the water, hoping that when she resurfaces it'll all be different...
But deep down she knows... When she comes back up, nothing will change...
Sara flails her arms about, trying desperately to finish the final leg of the race! She reaches out her hand, touching the near wall...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't know if I won, but I know that wasn't my best effort just now...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I think so... Just can you do me a favor? Can you convince me that I actually `want` to win the tournament, now that it will mean airing that interview on TV?
nodes.text_bbcode: I think so... Just can you do me a favor? Can you convince me that I actually [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] to win the tournament, now that it will mean airing that interview on TV?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Are you serious? Sara, no matter what, that guy's going to come across like an idiot! And you're going to come across like someone who knows what she's doing!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You think so?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You should have seen yourself... Next to him, you were brilliant! Believe it or not, this is `exactly` what we wanted!
nodes.text_bbcode: You should have seen yourself... Next to him, you were brilliant! Believe it or not, this is [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] what we wanted!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Thanks for saying that, Nick, even if it isn't true...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It is. Besides, there is another reason for you to want to win... It's the same reason you wanted to win before you ever heard about the interview...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What's this? Nick Brown's talking about school pride?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe... I'm also talking about Sara pride too...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What's Sara pride?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's you going out there and forgetting about all these distractions and just swimming your best because it's what you love to do...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh yeah... That.
A bell sounds.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's time for the match... Wish me luck.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I would, but you don't need it.
For one moment, Sara feels warm, the same way she felt when they nearly kissed...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I like Nick Brown!
At the end of the meet, Sara stands at the foot of a platform overlooking the water. Elliana limbers up in front of the platform next to hers.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Very happy I'm not going up against the Walrus Hips over there. You... You are more like a pile of bones.
Sara tries to ignore Elliana... She begins to feel the pressure from all angles...
`From the stands...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]From the stands...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Go, Sara!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, Sara!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay, Swimmers!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't mess up or anything because there's, like, a lot of people here!
`From the swim team...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]From the swim team...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We're better than them!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: `Way` better!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Way[/i][/color] better!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Take this girl `out!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Take this girl [color=#3b78e2][i]out![/i][/color]

nodes.text: `From her father...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]From her father...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Come on, Sara! Let's go! Prove me wrong!
She sees Nick in the front row of the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You can do it!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Okay, I can do it... Breathe... Relax...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Don't mess with my hair...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Ladies and gentleman! This is the final head-to-head match between Sara Kessler from Twin Branches and Elliana Concertina from Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: You stand no chance, little girl.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: The winner of this match will determine which school is the victor of the Wilson Freestyle Tournament.
Sara steps onto the platform. Elliana does the same in the lane next to her...
Sara gets into position... The crowd quiets... And she waits for the sound of the starting bell...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But it doesn't mean anything!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It does to me! I don't want to spend our entire relationship wondering if you're going to leave me for Sara!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Even if Sara and I get along, it doesn't mean I'm just going to ditch you. Who you want to be with is a choice!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And you're mine.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Nick. I can't do it. I can't be with you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe it's a selfish and impossible dream...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But for just `once,` I'd like to be the `only` choice.
nodes.text_bbcode: But for just [color=#3b78e2][i]once,[/i][/color] I'd like to be the [color=#3b78e2][i]only[/i][/color] choice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're `over.`
nodes.text_bbcode: We're [color=#3b78e2][i]over.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam... You... You can't mean that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You should go now.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Get. Out.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Get. Out.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nick walks out of the room.
The next day in school...
Nick looks bleakly down at his desk as the morning announcements play on TV.
Erik appears onscreen next to a dour Justin.
On cue, Erik starts singing a jaunty tune.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { Morning announcements with Justin and Erik... {

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { Your news has never been more generic... {

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { Tune in to hear all the fun good stuff... As we regale you with weather, traffic, elections, and fluff! {

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Stop with the `inane` singing...
nodes.text_bbcode: Stop with the [color=#e23b3b][i]inane[/i][/color] singing...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, someone woke up on the mopey side of the bed today! And I bet I know why!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Twin Branches, your votes have been cast, and your voice has been heard!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Your President for the new school year is...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Ben Kale!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ben Kale![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Erik claps his hands, while Justin rolls his eyes.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yes, congratulations to our new `President.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, congratulations to our new [color=#e23b3b][i]President.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hopefully, Ben's tenure will bring a golden period devoid of budget deficit, petty prank wars, and overly indulgent partying.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ditto, Justin! Hear hear! Long live `President Kale!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ditto, Justin! Hear hear! Long live [color=#e23b3b][i]President Kale![/i][/color]

nodes.text: In the classroom...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw man... I lost to Tweed?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Did no one like my bunny campaign?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So much for stopping Jessica...
Meanwhile, Ben cheers!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah! I did it! I won!
Around him, everyone starts clapping. Reluctantly, Nick joins in.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Long live `President Kale!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Long live [color=#3b78e2][i]President Kale![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jessica stands at Ben's side and shoots everyone a wide smile. When her gaze lands on Nick, she smiles even wider.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Next year, `things are going to change.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Next year, [color=#3b78e2][i]things are going to change.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Well, it sucks for Nick that Ben has won the election... And it's a bummer that Sam decided to break up with Nick...
But somehow, someway, this is the good ending! Be glad that you at least got Nick to talk to Sam!
But what will happen when Ben ascends to the Presidency? Will Jessica ever have to answer for all the terrible things that she's done?
Check in next week to see!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: If you win, I win! And if you lose, I watch you get pummeled! Of course we have a deal!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, Taylor!
$ZOE drags Taylor out from behind the tree!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great going! We don't even have a pillow!
Just then a petite girl charges at them and swings a pillow at $ZOE's head!
On the Wilson High campus, $ZOE and Taylor manage to track Steph down to the Wilson High computer lab...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: You guys are lucky it's so late in the day... Otherwise, you would have been punked just for showing your pathetic faces around here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's nice to see you too.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are `you` doing here this late?
nodes.text_bbcode: What are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing here this late?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I pretty much live here...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: There aren't many nerds at Wilson. The school's computer lab is really just `my` computer lab. So you're kind of all up in my personal space right now...
nodes.text_bbcode: There aren't many nerds at Wilson. The school's computer lab is really just [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] computer lab. So you're kind of all up in my personal space right now...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: By the way, that means `get out.`
nodes.text_bbcode: By the way, that means [color=#3b78e2][i]get out.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Taylor whispers under her breath to $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good cop, bad cop...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's on...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think it's pretty obvious that of the two of us, I'm the good cop!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just have to choose the right moments to either be nice or to let Taylor step in and be mean!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Steph, we know you helped Jessica run The Dirty Dish and rig the election.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: You don't `know` anything!
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] anything!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For everyone you've hurt... All the damage you've caused... It's over, Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Totes` over.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Totes[/i][/color] over.

lines.text: $ZOE presses the 'Enter' button.
Meanwhile, on the screen above Jessica, her video plays...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Imagine what next year will be like...
...The video feed is interrupted! The screen turns to static!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Uh... Technical difficulties...
The image shifts and shows Jessica talking to Steph in her computer lab...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Uh...
The crowd starts booing...

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: So on the last night of the election, you want me to hack the system and add in a bunch of votes for this Ben guy?

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Why do you keep repeating everything like that? Yes! Duh!

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: And why would I help you out? You're a Lizard!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Because I'll use my political weight as First Lady to leech all the funding from stupid sports programs, except for cheerleading, of course...

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: Why do I care?

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: I really have to spell it out? Gah! You Wilson idiots really `are` stupid!
lines.text_bbcode: I really have to spell it out? Gah! You Wilson idiots really [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] stupid!

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: Thanks, no offense taken!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: None given!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Without funding, we'll lose, like, `every` game to Wilson High.
lines.text_bbcode: Without funding, we'll lose, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] game to Wilson High.

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: That does sound like a sweet deal...

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: Do you really have that much influence?

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: You have no idea... I can pretty much get Ben to do `whatever` I want.
lines.text_bbcode: You have no idea... I can pretty much get Ben to do [color=#3b78e2][i]whatever[/i][/color] I want.

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: You should have seen how easy it was to get him to break up with his lame hipster ex-girlfriend. It was like a baby `gave` me candy!
lines.text_bbcode: You should have seen how easy it was to get him to break up with his lame hipster ex-girlfriend. It was like a baby [color=#3b78e2][i]gave[/i][/color] me candy!

lines.speaker: Steph
lines.text: Well, then... I'm in!
Static fills the screen... For one moment, the auditorium is stunned, silent.

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Ha! What a great April Fool's joke that was, wasn't it?
$ZOE and Taylor leap onto the stage!

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: It's no April Fool's joke! Jessica rigged the election! She used Steph to run the Dirty Dish, too!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: `You!`
lines.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You![/i][/color]

lines.text: The crowd boos!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: This is all a misunderstanding!
$ZOE and Taylor step toward Jessica! She turns to flee the stage...
But stops when she sees...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Ben!
Ben stands in front of her, his jaw taut...

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: You used me.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: You `used` me.
lines.text_bbcode: You [color=#e23b3b][i]used[/i][/color] me.

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Fine, yeah, I did! I used you. I knew I could turn you into the President, and I wanted all the perks of being the First Lady...

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Perks?! You `broke` me and Denni up for `perks?!`
lines.text_bbcode: Perks?! You [color=#e23b3b][i]broke[/i][/color] me and Denni up for [color=#e23b3b][i]perks?![/i][/color]

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: I did...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: I'm sorry for that...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: I deceived you, but Ben...
Jessica steps forward and raises her hand to caress Ben's face, but he stops her!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Don't you dare. You don't get to touch me ever again.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Was everything fake?!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: My feelings were real, Ben.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: No, they weren't. You have to be human first to have feelings.

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: What are you saying?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Did you ever stop for even one moment to think that what you were doing was wrong?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: When you were betraying me, hurting Denni, and throwing all of Twin Branches under the bus!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Do you have a conscience?!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: No... You don't... You don't care about anyone but yourself...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Come on, Ben. You know I'm not like that. You know I love you...

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I don't know that because it isn't true. This isn't love... This is just lies and poison!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I thought I knew you... I thought I loved you... But I don't love this Jessica... The `real` Jessica... The `real` you.
lines.text_bbcode: I thought I knew you... I thought I loved you... But I don't love this Jessica... The [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] Jessica... The [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] you.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: And I don't `ever` want to see you again!
lines.text_bbcode: And I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]ever[/i][/color] want to see you again!

lines.text: As the crowd continues to boo, food flies from the audience and onto the stage at Jessica... She flees...
Amid the chaos, Ben and Denni lock eyes... Neither sure of what the other is thinking...
$ZOE gets behind the podium...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: I know it's hard, but please try to calm down everyone... Please, could you just calm down? Guys? Please...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: `Please!`
lines.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Please![/i][/color]

lines.text: The auditorium falls silent.

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: I think I know Ben well enough to say that he doesn't want to win the election this way.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I don't...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: I'm also proud to know how much all of you actually care about who your President is... Enough to riot like this!

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: Enough to vote and campaign for them!

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: That's why I'm going to personally make sure that all the votes you cast get counted, so that we can declare an official President in just a few weeks!
Applause fills the auditorium!

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: And on one, final note...
$ZOE looks at Taylor.

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: Value the friendships you have. They rarely last forever. They can often come from nowhere, but when you find them... Treasure them.
The audience applauds...

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: With Jessica gone, I think $ZOE should step in as the new Head Cheerleader!

lines.speaker: Hector
lines.text: Yeah! $ZOE!

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Woo! $ZOE for Head Cheerleader!

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: But I already voted for Pony!
One by one the cheerleaders call out for $ZOE to become the Head Cheerleader...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: I'm... I'm so flattered... I... I...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: I accept!
The crowd cheers!
Congratulations! You played a great game!
You helped $ZOE express her anger, follow the trail of evidence that led to Jessica's demise, and become the Head Cheerleader!
You became the New Girl, Unleashed!
Before we tally your score, remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam! If you're lucky, you can even Tweet with Amanda!
You have unlocked the bonus scene! Enjoy!
Achieving a grade of A or higher will unlock a special bonus scene!
Taylor sits at the Center Table for the first time in months...

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: Are you a new student?

lines.speaker: Taylor
lines.text: Hi, Amanda.
Brendan sits down next to Taylor...

lines.speaker: Brendan
lines.text: Never sat here before!

lines.speaker: Nicole
lines.text: Two nerds at the Center Table? Jessica, tell them how that's...

lines.speaker: Nicole
lines.text: Oh, right... Never mind.

lines.speaker: Taylor
lines.text: What's the matter, Nicole? Lost your buddy?

lines.speaker: Hector
lines.text: So are you guys gonna sit with us now? No more Nerd Table?

lines.speaker: Taylor
lines.text: We decided it'd be good for me to have more exposure to cool people.

lines.speaker: Brendan
lines.text: So we're going to alternate days! Now, you might be wondering how that works given that there are five days in the school week, an unfortunately odd number.

lines.speaker: Taylor
lines.text: Brendan! What'd I tell you before we sat here?

lines.speaker: Brendan
lines.text: No nerd talk at the cool table.

lines.speaker: Taylor
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: Brendan
lines.text: Oh, right... Uh, any cool parties coming up?

lines.speaker: Carson
lines.text: Only the best party ever!

lines.speaker: Hector
lines.text: Uh, probably want to get a different phrase... We've used that one a lot.

lines.speaker: Carson
lines.text: Only the `hottest` party ever!
lines.text_bbcode: Only the [color=#e23b3b][i]hottest[/i][/color] party ever!

lines.speaker: Hector
lines.text: Carson and I have been planning something so awesome, it will blow your minds!

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: I'm immune to mind-blowing!
As Hector and Carson lay out their party plan, $ZOE can't contain her excitement...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: `Head` Cheerleader! Next year is going to be amazing! I can't wait!
lines.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Head[/i][/color] Cheerleader! Next year is going to be amazing! I can't wait!

lines.speaker: Howard
lines.text: Yeah, amazing...

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: Oh, Howard... I'm sorry. I forgot that you won't be here...

lines.speaker: Howard
lines.text: What do you think we should do?

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: I don't know... We can't ignore the fact that you're graduating...

lines.speaker: Howard
lines.text: No, we can't.

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: It's going to happen.
Howard grabs $ZOE's hand and squeezes it.
Meanwhile, out in the parking lot...

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: All right, Princess, I can't stand it. Hit me with the bad news.

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: You and Tweed. Jessica broke you up. Just get it over with, and tell me what we both know is going on.

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: Actually, I think this is a rare case in which only you know what's going on...

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: Are you leaving me for Ben?
Denni punches Colt in the shoulder.

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: Ow! Hey!

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: I'm with you, Doofus.

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: Tell me the thought hadn't crossed your mind now that you know Jessica's responsible for what happened.

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: It... It did, actually.

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: I knew it!

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: Relax... I mean... There was a moment in the auditorium when we looked at each other...

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: That son of a...

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: Colt! He wasn't giving me `the look!` He was just looking at me, okay?
lines.text_bbcode: Colt! He wasn't giving me [color=#3b78e2][i]the look![/i][/color] He was just looking at me, okay?

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: I don't know the difference.

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: I know you don't. But, listen, okay... We looked at each other, and there was nothing there.

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: What? Really?

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: Yeah, it's like... So much time has passed... Ben and I are over. He's the past. `You're` my future.
lines.text_bbcode: Yeah, it's like... So much time has passed... Ben and I are over. He's the past. [color=#3b78e2][i]You're[/i][/color] my future.

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: Can I still beat him up a little? For looking at you, I mean?

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: No! If you beat up every guy who looked at me, you'd be beating up `a lot` of guys!
lines.text_bbcode: No! If you beat up every guy who looked at me, you'd be beating up [color=#3b78e2][i]a lot[/i][/color] of guys!

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: Really? What are their names?

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: Wow. You're incorrigible.

lines.speaker: Colt
lines.text: Hey! You're a... Dirigible. Didn't think I knew that word, did you?

lines.speaker: Denni
lines.text: You got me there, baby.
And somewhere very far away... Jessica looks at the schedule of classes at her new school...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: What kind of school is this? Ice fishing? Walrus identification?

lines.speaker: Astrid
lines.text: Helllllooooooooo! Oh how much I enjoy your hair! Enough grease to hold a flame for many days!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Oh no...

lines.speaker: Astrid
lines.text: Do you see the way we are looking? We are twins! Like seahorses galloping across oceans in search of our aqua-equine matings!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Why are you talking to me?

lines.speaker: Astrid
lines.text: You are Jessica, no? The fattest whale of my former school!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Astrid
lines.text: By this I mean you were the most desirable and popular...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Oh, totes! I `am` Jessica!
lines.text_bbcode: Oh, totes! I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] Jessica!

lines.text: Astrid checks over her shoulders...

lines.speaker: Astrid
lines.text: Then I have a message for you...

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: You want to help me rule this school?
Astrid reaches into her jacket and pulls out a steaming cup of coffee!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: Wha?
She tosses it on Jessica!

lines.speaker: Jessica
lines.text: `Ack!`
lines.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ack![/i][/color]

lines.speaker: Astrid
lines.text: That is for mistreating my friends!
Looks like Taylor's finding that healthy balance between nerd and cool, $ZOE and Howard have to deal with Howard's impending graduation...
Denni and Colt are going to be fine...
But Jessica has a long, scalding hot future ahead of her!
Hope you enjoyed your bonus scene!
What will cheerleading be like with $ZOE in command? Stay tuned for the next season of Surviving High School...

nodes.text: She re-locks Jessica's computer, quickly setting up a new password.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are you doing? We `just` hacked the mainframe! Why are you setting it back up?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you doing? We [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] hacked the mainframe! Why are you setting it back up?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We can't stoop to Jessica's level, Taylor. We'll end up becoming just like her.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're just coming to this conclusion `now?!` Are you insane?!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're just coming to this conclusion [color=#3b78e2][i]now?![/i][/color] Are you insane?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought of all the things Jessica's done, and I just couldn't bear the idea that I'd ever do something even remotely on her level.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sometimes the best way to fight evil is to be passive... The monster will walk right past you...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, and sometimes the monster eats everything in its path including you and everyone you love!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sometimes the best way to fight evil is to `actually` fight evil!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sometimes the best way to fight evil is to [color=#3b78e2][i]actually[/i][/color] fight evil!

nodes.text: Andrew whispers to Dex...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You getting this? Two hot chicks are fighting right in front of us! About fictional monsters! Whilst surrounded by technology!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Are you kidding? I've never blogged so fiercely!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fighting isn't the answer, Taylor. Passive resistance is!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, you can go sit in the corner and be passive while I switch the videos!
Taylor tries to get to Jessica's laptop, but $ZOE blocks her.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey!
Taylor pushes $ZOE's chair, rolling her out of the way!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey!
As Taylor tries to guess $ZOE's password, $ZOE leaps out of her chair, grabbing at Taylor's hair!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Girls! Stop fighting!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Brendan! Shut up!
The girls struggle, falling to the ground! Taylor puts $ZOE in a headlock!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fighting me isn't very passive, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, you seemed like the kind of monster that would eat my loved ones!
Andrew holds up his phone, filming the fight.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: New greatest day. This afternoon, I saw a pillow fight at Centerscore U. And now, `this!`
nodes.text_bbcode: New greatest day. This afternoon, I saw a pillow fight at Centerscore U. And now, [color=#e23b3b][i]this![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Meanwhile, Jessica's video plays uninterrupted...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Imagine what next year will be like...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Instead of clubs with no purpose...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Or money going toward programs no one cares about...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We'll have parties, like, all the time!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's going to be `totes` the best!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]totes[/i][/color] the best!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Thanks for voting for Ben, everyone! It's like you voted for me!
Definitely not the ending $ZOE wanted! You must play again and see if you can put an end to Jessica's tyranny!

nodes.title: Photo Op
nodes.subtitle: Can you help Nick find his place at Twin Branches?

nodes.text: After school one afternoon...
Howard, $ZOE, Sam, and Nick are spending time in the park.
I'm so glad we all made it out of that earthquake. Can you imagine if any of us were stuck?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I prefer to think of happier things.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, it's hard to forget with the school being shut down and all.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I really hate how we have to go to class in those mobile classrooms in the parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: At least they're only temporary...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, Howard, where are the football players practicing now that the football field's all torn up?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Coach found a place for us to do our off-season training in the park nearby. We're going to be meeting there from now on...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Though I really hope they'll repair the football field by the time graduation rolls around...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I hate the thought of never getting to play on the field again.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Why is that an issue?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard is... Graduating this year.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Already?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. It's about time.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, that was fast...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Tell me about it. I don't know what I'm going to do without him...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What if he goes really far away?
$ZOE and Howard look forlornly down at the ground.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I'm sure, no matter the distance, you guys will be fine!
Sam nudges Nick and mouths the words 'say something' at him.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah... Long distance relationships are...
After Ryan's photo shoot, Nick finds his way to the Auto-Shop.
It's a wreck! A chunk of the ceiling has collapsed, covering most of the room in heavy rubble and dust.
In the middle of everything, Megan and Kenji pick at the rubble, slowly sweeping the debris and dust off their shop.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I don't know if this is helping... It doesn't look like we're making much of a dent.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Keep talking like that, cuz, and I'll put a dent in your face. My second favorite bike's under there, and we're digging her out.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, hello?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I couldn't help but overhear... So you guys are cleaning up the Auto-Shop?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: No, we're twirling in tutus... What do you `think` we're doing?!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, we're twirling in tutus... What do you [color=#3b78e2][i]think[/i][/color] we're doing?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, nothing really. I wanted to get some photos for a newspaper article about the earthquake.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: No way. I don't want you in here, mucking things up while Kenji and I bust our butts off cleaning.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And I don't like the idea of you taking any picture that makes Auto-Shop look bad.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It wouldn't make the Auto-Shop look bad...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You don't think so?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No. I think an image of the devastation of this place will inspire people to help.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Oh yeah. I'm sure they'll just come `running` to clean `this` place up...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah. I'm sure they'll just come [color=#3b78e2][i]running[/i][/color] to clean [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] place up...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay. Well, what if I help you?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Why would you do that?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: To give people hope.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I don't follow, Skinny Jeans.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm thinking of taking comparison shots.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I could take a picture now, help you clean up, and then do a picture afterwards.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: A before-and-after shot would give people hope that we can eventually return to our school. It'd make the Auto-Shop a positive model for the future.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, 'positive' in the sense that people will find the earthquake less devastating. Auto-Shop should still really try to focus more on creating vehicles that are less dependent on gasoline to run...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Kid, word of warning... Shut up. Don't tell me how to run Auto-Shop, or I'll stuff you into a dumpster.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And you've convinced me. I'm not going to say 'no' to a volunteer... If you want your 'after' picture... You can start cleaning up over there at the back corner.
Nick takes a quick picture of the Auto Shop, then rolls up his sleeves and gets to work.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: If I want those pictures...
In Ms. Prez's mobile classroom one morning...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: All right, all right. Let's settle down for the announcements...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Unless you want to be the one who makes my headache worse!
The class quiets down, and Ms. Prez turns on a video monitor.
On the screen, Erik and Justin are sitting side-by-side...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Heeeelllllooooooo Twin Branches!
After a few seconds, Erik anxiously looks at Justin...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh... Justin, you're supposed to say...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Someone's` a Grumpy Gus, and I think I know why!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Someone's[/i][/color] a Grumpy Gus, and I think I know why!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's Nomination Week! If you want to run against Justin for school President, now's the time!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Sign-ups take place in the library...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hate to break it to you, my PA pal, but sign-ups `actually` take place in Ms. Lee's temporary office!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hate to break it to you, my PA pal, but sign-ups [color=#e23b3b][i]actually[/i][/color] take place in Ms. Lee's temporary office!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If anyone went to the library, they'd be knee-deep in a pile of rubble! What a gaffe!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hmph!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, that's about it! Except...
Erik removes his glasses, cleans them, and puts them back on...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: On a more serious note, I'd personally like to say that if you're planning on running for office, you should be mature...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The same way you'd be if you were eating sandwiches with my grandma!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So before you sign up, ask yourself... Why should `I` run?
nodes.text_bbcode: So before you sign up, ask yourself... Why should [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] run?

nodes.text: After school one day, Sam and $ZOE are walking towards their after school programs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So I heard Nick got a lot of praise for his work with the newspaper article.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. Apparently he's good at taking pictures. Who knew?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's wrong? You're making a sad face. And you know how I feel about sad faces.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They make me sad too!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well... I'm glad Nick is really committing to photography...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I know `I'm` the one that told him to get his own hobby and have his own life...
nodes.text_bbcode: And I know [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] the one that told him to get his own hobby and have his own life...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I'm kind of starting to regret it now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't approve of photography?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not the photography I have a problem with. It's the subject matter.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Am I the only one who thinks it's weird that he's decided to become Sara's campaign manager?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, they did seem to hit it off as friends. Sometimes you just get along with someone else.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe... But he could stand to be less happy about it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I guess I should let him have friends, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, Sam. Friends are good.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Anyway, what about you? Why are you heading this way? Don't the cheerleaders practice in the park?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm actually meeting them at the diner.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you guys eat now? So much has changed since I was on the team...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, no... It's not like that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A lot of Twin Branches students go to the diner after class since the school closed...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica wants us to hang out there and hand out things for Ben's Presidential campaign.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-oh. And so it begins...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just mean... It's gross how she's making the cheerleaders do all her dirty work.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can't you see she's taking advantage of you?
The next afternoon, Howard takes $ZOE around Centerscore U.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, this is nice.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is the main quad where everyone hangs out. They hold festivals and host live bands and stuff like that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If this is the school I end up at, I could be passing through here every day...
Despite the sadness within her, $ZOE puts on her best smile.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Here's a question. What are you going to study?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's what my parents want to know. I'm not sure honestly.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess that's why you have general eduation classes the first year or so. To figure out what you want.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But if I had to choose right now...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Science. Biology, probably.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Science? Really?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You don't think I can do it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't know you were interested! Mr. Russell catches you sleeping in his class all the time!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Because we're talking about genetics or whatever.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I aced the animal section!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And come on... I know everything there is to know about ducks.
Howard playfully nudges her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know... Don't you have to study a lot for science? I thought you didn't like studying all that much.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure, High School Howard doesn't. But maybe `College Howard` will `enjoy` studying. It could be his new hobby.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure, High School Howard doesn't. But maybe [color=#e23b3b][i]College Howard[/i][/color] will [color=#e23b3b][i]enjoy[/i][/color] studying. It could be his new hobby.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just hope College Howard isn't `too` different...
nodes.text_bbcode: I just hope College Howard isn't [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] different...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, we're coming up on Greek row. This is where all the fraternities are...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you thinking of turning Greek?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'd seriously consider it. It could be fun... My friend, $USR, hangs out at MAN a lot... It's a lot of fun.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I hear... Mainly from Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She would know. I can totally picture her joining OMG her first year.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: OMG?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know, the sorority. They're always hanging out around MAN house and throwing awesome parties...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They hold the best social events on campus.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's bad enough Howard is going away... But he's going to a place where he'll meet a ton of girls!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, I know this is hard. But talk to me. What are you feeling?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
