nodes.text: I'm just worried about...

nodes.title: The Last Straw
nodes.subtitle: Can you help $ZOE stand up to Jessica?

nodes.text: $ZOE and Sam are walking towards the temporary classrooms set out in the school parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Today is going to be a good day, I just know it.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And I can already tell today is going to suck.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We've been at school for ten minutes, and I've already lost my phone. I have no idea what happened to it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure it'll turn up. Are you sure you didn't leave it at home?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I was texting Nick the whole ride over. Here's hoping it turns up...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what's got you all worked up? You're practically bouncing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just woke up on the right side of the bed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It might also help that Jessica's been really nice to me since I made that speech last week.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And no one's had to wear that musty old mascot costume for an entire week!
Erik skips past them, wearing his mascot costume!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Lizards smell by tasting the air! Wow!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, no one that doesn't want to anyway.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hah. Well, good for you. Standing up for yourself.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I have to say... I didn't think that Jessica was going to let you go that easy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I told you that she couldn't speak out against me because everyone supported what I had to say...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's the first time I ever participated in girl politics and won!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha. Just don't let it go to your head.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course not. Howard wouldn't approve.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, where `is` that guy? I haven't seen his mopey face around lately.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, where [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] that guy? I haven't seen his mopey face around lately.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's been prepping all week for his interview with Kingston University. It's today, right after school.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is the final interview before they decide if they're going to give him a scholarship or not.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's so nervous. Kingston is his top pick.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If he doesn't do well at this interview, he won't be able to go.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow. No pressure.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know. I hope he does well...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you sure about that? Kingston is far, far, `far` away...
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you sure about that? Kingston is far, far, [color=#3b78e2][i]far[/i][/color] away...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I don't want him to go to Kingston, but it's a good chance for him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what are you going to do if it comes down to him moving across the country?
Suddenly, it all falls into place for $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Sam! Jessica's not just going to stop with you! She's going after everyone around me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then we're going to take her down...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... I can't...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know you said you just wanted her to leave you alone, but this is `way` over the line! You can't always be nice!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know you said you just wanted her to leave you alone, but this is [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] over the line! You can't always be nice!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not that! If she's going after everyone I love...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's going after Howard too!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The interview!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have to get to him!
$ZOE turns away from Sam and sprints towards the makeshift library where Howard is meeting the Kingston interviewer.
Cast your vote in the poll at the end of this episode for Taylor, Colt, Sara, Ben, Amanda, or Justin for President!
Cast your vote in the poll at the end of this episode for Taylor, Colt, Sara, Ben, Amanda, or Justin for President!
Cast your vote in the poll at the end of this episode for Taylor, Colt, Sara, Ben, Amanda, or Justin for President!
Cast your vote in the poll at the end of this episode for Taylor, Colt, Sara, Ben, Amanda, or Justin for President!
The winner will be declared in an upcoming episode! Who will it be?! `YOU` decide!
nodes.text_bbcode: The winner will be declared in an upcoming episode! Who will it be?! [b]YOU[/b] decide!

nodes.text: And now...

nodes.title: The Campaign Trail
nodes.subtitle: Who is the best Presidential candidate?

nodes.text: It's Monday morning, and Ben and Jessica are watching the morning announcements in Ms. Prez's mobile classroom!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Good moooooooooorning, Twin Branches!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: First, the weather portion... It's sunny with a sixty percent chance of rain, so keep those umbrellas by your sides, ladies and gents!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But by gosh, forty percent sun! Isn't that peachy, co-host Justin?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You should stop drinking coffee...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can't quit! The black bean's got its grip on me!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh, in other news, it's Presidential Campaign Week...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We have a handful of exciting events that will showcase your favorite Presidential candidates!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Debates, formal interviews, speeches, and video campaigns, oh my!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Check out the posters outside each classroom for a schedule of events!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And before we close out... I'm sure everybody is just as interested in the latest polls. We asked you what candidate you were planning to vote for, and here are the results!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can't wait... This ought to be good.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Leading candidate Ben isn't as far ahead as we thought!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ben may have the support of 20% of the entire school population, but all the other candidates are split evenly around 15%...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Anyone could still beat Ben if they do well enough this week! Which means that I have a lot of campaigning to do!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I've prepared one hundred speaking points and will proceed to go through them starting with...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Sidewalk cracks on the area in front of the school...
Back in the classroom, Jessica leans over to Ben and whispers.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can't believe I used to date that guy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But he has such a great sense of humor...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ha ha, yeah right.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So, campaign manager... What do you think of those polls?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's not a sure thing like I thought...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What if I don't win?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, Ben...
Jessica pats his arm comfortingly.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I have a feeling that you'll be just fine...
Because at that moment...
Every students' phone buzzes with a link to `The Dirty Dish...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Every students' phone buzzes with a link to [b]The Dirty Dish...[/b]

nodes.text: ...And it has the dirt on `every` candidate...
nodes.text_bbcode: ...And it has the dirt on [b]every[/b] candidate...

nodes.text: It's Friday morning...
And Ben and Jessica are just beginning to watch the morning announcements...
On screen, Erik and Justin sit behind a big table, holding stacks of official papers.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hellllllooooo Twin Branches!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's been such an exciting week with all this official campaigning...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Here's a recap of the highlights!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Taylor made a campaign commercial...
Erik runs Taylor's video.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: And that's why you should vote Taylor for President!
Early one morning, Nick comes running up to Sara, a smile spread across his face!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Nick. You seem... Oddly cheery.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I know, it's weird. But I `am` cheery. You will be too when you find out what I've done for you! It's so big, it's going to give you a real shot at the Presidency!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know, it's weird. But I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] cheery. You will be too when you find out what I've done for you! It's so big, it's going to give you a real shot at the Presidency!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Really?! What is it?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Nuh huh. I'm not going to tell you `that` easily! You've got to guess!
nodes.text_bbcode: Nuh huh. I'm not going to tell you [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] easily! You've got to guess!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: When did we return to elementary school?
Nick walks away at an exaggeratedly slow pace...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I guess... You... Don't... Want to... Know...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Okay, okay! I'll guess! Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Wait... Shouldn't you at `least` give me some kind of hint?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... Shouldn't you at [color=#3b78e2][i]least[/i][/color] give me some kind of hint?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Fine. `One` hint. `Television.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. [color=#e23b3b][i]One[/i][/color] hint. [color=#e23b3b][i]Television.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh no, Nick, you didn't! You mean...

options.label: I'm going to be on TV?!

nodes.text: That night, Sara sits at the dinner table with her father.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: When does Mom come back from her conference?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: This Sunday. She's upset that she's going to miss your big meet. She hasn't missed any of them.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I know...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: `You` haven't missed any of them either...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You[/i][/color] haven't missed any of them either...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You've never come to a meet without your `absolute` focus.
nodes.text_bbcode: You've never come to a meet without your [color=#e23b3b][i]absolute[/i][/color] focus.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: This interview, your whim to run for President, this Nick boy... They're all just a bunch of unwanted distractions.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But I `want` to be President.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] to be President.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You don't know what you want, Sara.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And you do?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I know what's best for you, and I know that today's practice was one of the most embarrassing moments of my life!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: How? How was that embarrassing for `you?`
nodes.text_bbcode: How? How was that embarrassing for [color=#3b78e2][i]you?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You represent me. You represent this family. And we don't slack off!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You're `my` daughter!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] daughter!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And do you have any idea how hard it is to be your daughter, Dad?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I know you're under a lot of pressure, but the solution is simple! Stop running for President!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh, I get it! Now I know why you're upset... This isn't about me being distracted, you're just worried about...

nodes.title: Ballot Breakup
nodes.subtitle: Can you help Nick talk to Sam?

nodes.text: At lunchtime on voting day, Nick walks up to Sam and $ZOE who are talking over takeout cups of hot chocolate.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, Sam... How's it...
Sam hurls her hot chocolate at Nick's face!
Outside in the parking lot, Nick turns from the classroom and runs straight into Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sorry, man, I...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `You.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're `Nick. Frikkin'. Brown.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're [color=#e23b3b][i]Nick. Frikkin'. Brown.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, that seems to be everyone's middle name today... I... `Hyk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that seems to be everyone's middle name today... I... [color=#e23b3b][i]Hyk![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer grabs a fistful of Nick's shirt and lifts him up.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whoa!
Spencer glares at Nick.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're the creep that cheated on Samface, is that right?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Is that right?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Is that right?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Backstage at the Inauguration, Ben paces back and forth, his hands shaking as he practices his speech...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My beloved Centerscorians, er... Twin Branchites, er... This is hopeless!
Jessica comes in through the curtain.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How are you doing, President Kale?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nervous. Really `really` nervous! How does it look out there?
nodes.text_bbcode: Nervous. Really [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] nervous! How does it look out there?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's a packed house. Almost showtime!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Gulp.` I don't know why I asked... I'm never going to be a good President!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Gulp.[/i][/color] I don't know why I asked... I'm never going to be a good President!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Listen, Ben...
Jessica takes Ben's hand as he walks by. He stops pacing and looks at her.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I've never been more proud of you than I am right now.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why? I haven't really done anything...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you kidding me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You transformed yourself, you went from a nerdy no-name with `unbearably` googly eyes to the super hot guy standing in front of me right now...
nodes.text_bbcode: You transformed yourself, you went from a nerdy no-name with [color=#3b78e2][i]unbearably[/i][/color] googly eyes to the super hot guy standing in front of me right now...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're Ben Kale! A patriot in the Spartan Games, a hero in the earthquake, and now, a totes cute President!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You've always been so good to me...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, Ben... You've been good to me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I haven't always been the nicest girl, but you've stuck with me.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And whenever I started to stray from the right path...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You were, like, `right there...` To keep me honest.
nodes.text_bbcode: You were, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]right there...[/i][/color] To keep me honest.

nodes.text: Ben puts a strand of Jessica's hair behind her ear.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I love you, Jess.
Tears well up in Jessica's eyes...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I love you too, Ben.
A tear starts to fall down her cheek. Ben catches it on his finger.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Remember when we first dated, we were at your house, and we looked at your tears through my pocket microscope...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How could I forget that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Those were a different kind of tears then, weren't they?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Completely. I'm a much happier girl today...
Jessica wraps her arms around Ben, and they kiss...
Just then...
The lights go out! Jessica separates herself from Ben!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Again?! Seriously, I've got every nerd in the school working here, and we can't keep the stupid lights on!
Jessica storms off in the direction of the video control room...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess that gives me more time to work on my speech...
Behind a nearby curtain, Denni uses the darkness to dispose a pair of wire cutters...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I hope my little act of sabotage gives $ZOE and Taylor a few more minutes to find evidence against Jessica! Come on, guys! Where are you?
On the Wilson High campus, $ZOE and Taylor manage to track Steph down to the Wilson High computer lab...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: You guys are lucky it's so late in the day... Otherwise, you would have been punked just for showing your pathetic faces around here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's nice to see you too.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are `you` doing here this late?
nodes.text_bbcode: What are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing here this late?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I pretty much live here...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: There aren't many nerds at Wilson. The school's computer lab is really just `my` computer lab. So you're kind of all up in my personal space right now...
nodes.text_bbcode: There aren't many nerds at Wilson. The school's computer lab is really just [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] computer lab. So you're kind of all up in my personal space right now...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: By the way, that means `get out.`
nodes.text_bbcode: By the way, that means [color=#3b78e2][i]get out.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Taylor whispers under her breath to $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good cop, bad cop...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's on...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think it's pretty obvious that of the two of us, I'm the good cop!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just have to choose the right moments to either be nice or to let Taylor step in and be mean!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Steph, we know you helped Jessica run The Dirty Dish and rig the election.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: You don't `know` anything!
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] anything!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: It was nice to meet you, Sara.
Sara makes a disgusted face as she leaves.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Why are guys such idiots?
After getting changed, Sara runs into Nick on the school's front yard...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh, hey, Sara. Have you seen Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No, she usually leaves with the other girls.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, thanks. Wait... You don't leave when they leave?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm a Kessler.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And that means?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That means I pretty much do two things... Swim and eat, which of course I only do so I can have energy to swim.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Now if you'll excuse me, I have to go...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Eat?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You guessed it. Thanks for disproving my theory about your gender being nothing but idiots.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Don't get me started. If I see one more football player at lunch bragging about how many eggs he can fit in his mouth, I'll scream.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Haha!
Sara starts to walk away...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wait... Sara?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe you can do more than swim and eat...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh yeah, like what?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Why don't you run?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh, no thanks! Being a Kessler also means being a one-sport athlete.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No, I mean run... For President!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Okay, I take it back. You guys `are` all idiots.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, I take it back. You guys [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] all idiots.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Heh. I'm serious.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't think so. Why don't `you` run?
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't think so. Why don't [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] run?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm more of a behind-the-camera guy. But you've... You've got something.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What? A spark?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No, not anything that cliche. I don't know what it is...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, don't think about it too hard. I'm not running.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Come on... I heard that you ran for Homecoming Princess. Tell me it didn't feel good to do something that wasn't swimming or eating.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It did, I admit. But I'm not going to run, Nick... I'm...

nodes.prompt: I'm not going to run, Nick... I'm...

nodes.text: Sara goes upstairs to her room...
Later... There's a light knock at the door...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Go away, Emily...
The door opens, and Sara's sister Emily steps into her room.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So, you're just ignoring me now, is that it?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah... Why?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Come on... The day before a huge swim meet... You and Dad are always getting into a fight...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I must have missed it while I was over at Kimi's...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It wasn't pretty.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'll bet. Still, it must be kinda nice being you...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: How so?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Dad cares about you so much, and all you have to do is swim fast!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's a little more complicated than that. He cares about you too, you know?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, but I don't swim nearly as fast as you.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You will, Em. Just wait until your body develops a little more...
Emily blushes... Then...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You really think so?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Of course.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I think I'm going to be a high school swimmer too... Just like you!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Just try not to get stressed out, okay?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I won't let it get to me.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Now get out of my room. I've got to rest up for tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sheesh. Bossy. Good night, Sara.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Good night, Em.
After Emily leaves her, Sara lies there, gazing at nothing in the darkness...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: All I have to do tomorrow is not embarrass myself on camera and then swim my hardest...
She sighs...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I hope I can do that...
The next morning, Sara arrives at the Wilson swimming center. She sees Nick standing beside a cameraman and another man holding a microphone.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sara, this is Tucker Garrety.

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: How do you do, Miss Kessler?
Tucker shakes Sara's hand.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: To be honest, I'm a little nervous.

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Don't be! There's nothing to be nervous about. I'm just going to ask you a few questions about your habits, and then I'll be out of your hair...

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Nothing but softballs.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That's a relief.

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: You've got a big match to swim in a few minutes, Sara. All we want is for you to be focused on what matters... `You.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You've got a big match to swim in a few minutes, Sara. All we want is for you to be focused on what matters... [color=#e23b3b][i]You.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That's...

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Refreshing? Surprising? Expecting something else?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Just when I think of sports broadcasters I usually think of ex-football players with huge egos.

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Please. All that fake, macho, chest-pounding stuff. That isn't journalism.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I love this guy!
The cameraman gets into position. A red light on the camera blinks... Off to the side, Nick gives Sara a wink...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Just don't touch your hair.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Who cares about preparing? This is going to be easy.
The cameraman starts counting down... `Three...`
nodes.text_bbcode: The cameraman starts counting down... [b]Three...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: You ready?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I think so...

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Girl, you have `no` idea what you're in for!
nodes.text_bbcode: Girl, you have [color=#e23b3b][i]no[/i][/color] idea what you're in for!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh oh...
The red flashing light on the camera turns steady.

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: `Heyoooooo!` This is Tucker `G!` Handsomest man on TV!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Heyoooooo![/i][/color] This is Tucker [color=#e23b3b][i]G![/i][/color] Handsomest man on TV!

nodes.text: If you find another better brother, brother don't bother, cause Tucker G's hotter than the `hottest` water!

nodes.text: `Hoo!` Speaking of water, we are poolside with my girl, Sara `The Machine` Kessler, winner of the Wilson Freestyle Tournament! Say something to the boys at home, Sara.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It was easy to anticipate your questions since they were the same ones Andrew asked me `last week!` How did you get them?

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: It was some girl. She said it was 'totes' important that I ask you these questions. Paid me a lot of money, too!

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Now if you'll excuse me... I'm getting a mani-pedi, a trim, and then I'll probably do something awesome like watch myself on TV.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You're not even going to stay to watch the meet?
Tucker yawns.

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Great timing! That was an actual yawn by the way! Also, to answer your question, no... Camera Guy's going to film it.

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Oh, and you'd better win since I said twice in the interview that you won the tournament! Otherwise, we'll all look bad!
Tucker leaves, and the cameraman sets up to film the meet...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure Jessica's the girl behind those questions...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sara? You okay?
Sara thinks about all the pressure she's been feeling...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No! I'm not okay, Nick! I can't handle this!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What's the matter?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What's the matter?! Everything! Everything's the matter!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That interview was embarrassing!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: My dad expects me to break a record every time I swim!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: My teammates think I'm selfish! They're not even the least bit supportive!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Jessica's scheming to tear me down because I'm a threat to Ben!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And my sister is trying to follow in my miserable footsteps!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So how's that for `what's the matter?`

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm really sorry, Sara...
Nick tries to hold Sara, but she backs away.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No! You're the worst part, Nick...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How am I the worst? I thought I was being your friend...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I think... I think I like you... But we can't do this because you're with Sam...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's like there's this wall between me and `the one` guy who actually cares about me.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's like there's this wall between me and [color=#3b78e2][i]the one[/i][/color] guy who actually cares about me.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm... I'm so sorry...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it's not your fault...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Are you going to swim?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No... I'm through with swimming... I'm just a big disappointment...

nodes.speaker: Sara

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe... I'm also talking about Sara pride too...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What's Sara pride?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's you going out there and forgetting about all these distractions and just swimming your best because it's what you love to do...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh yeah... That.
A bell sounds.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's time for the match... Wish me luck.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I would, but you don't need it.
For one moment, Sara feels warm, the same way she felt when they nearly kissed...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I like Nick Brown!

nodes.speaker: Elliana

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: You did fine, Sara. You even managed to sneak in all that lame stuff about running for President.

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Caught me off-guard... No easy feat.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It was easy to anticipate your questions since they were the same ones Andrew asked me `last week!` How did you get them?
nodes.text_bbcode: It was easy to anticipate your questions since they were the same ones Andrew asked me [color=#3b78e2][i]last week![/i][/color] How did you get them?

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Whoa whoa whoa! A true reporter never, uh... Something noble about sources... But, yeah, it wasn't some guy named Andrew.

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: It was some girl. She said it was 'totes' important that I ask you these questions. Paid me a lot of money, too!

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Now if you'll excuse me... I'm getting a mani-pedi, a trim, and then I'll probably do something awesome like watch myself on TV.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You're not even going to stay to watch the meet?
Tucker yawns.

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Great timing! That was an actual yawn by the way! Also, to answer your question, no... Camera Guy's going to film it.

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Oh, and you'd better win since I said twice in the interview that you won the tournament! Otherwise, we'll all look bad!
Tucker leaves, and the cameraman sets up to film the meet...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure Jessica's the girl behind those questions...

nodes.text: Sara? You okay?
Sara thinks about all the pressure she's been feeling...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No! I'm not okay, Nick! I can't handle this!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What's the matter?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What's the matter?! Everything! Everything's the matter!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That interview was embarrassing!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: My dad expects me to break a record every time I swim!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: My teammates think I'm selfish! They're not even the least bit supportive!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Jessica's scheming to tear me down because I'm a threat to Ben!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And my sister is trying to follow in my miserable footsteps!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So how's that for `what's the matter?`

nodes.text: $ZOE, don't be silly...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wasn't `threatening` you with the mascot costume. I was just giving Jill a break!

nodes.text: $ZOE, you're a cheerleader, not an animal.

nodes.text: But all those things you said about endorsing Ben...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Endorsing Ben, schmendorsing Ben. Who cares? I just wanted your bid, and I was hoping you'd help me out.

Suddenly, $ZOE knows exactly what's happened.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's being nice to me because she can't kick me off the team. She knows the other girls support me, and if she dumps me, she'll risk alienating them!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's really funny, Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know.

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.speaker: Zoe

Everyone at Twin Branches was affected by the earthquake!
Let's see how others are coping in the aftermath...
At night, Denni lies in her bed, staring up at the ceiling.
What I wouldn't give right now for something stimulating...
Your wish is my command, Princess.
Colt stands at her window.
Colt!
Did you climb up the side of my house?
What? Are you not happy to see me?
Just worried about my parents' drainpipe.
What are you doing here? I was just thinking about you.
Well, more like, how bored I am... Turns out breaking half the bones in your leg make it impossible for you to go anywhere easily!
I figured you'd be desperate. So I brought you something.
Like what?
Geez, don't make that face. We're all good here.
Colt reaches into his backpack and pulls out a media player, a thermos, and a marker.
Here. For you.
Denni picks up the music player.
1000 Weeping Violins, Fatalistic Reduction, and Red Bean Toast? Awesome! I've never heard of any of these bands!
Neither has anyone else, so you're good.
Denni takes the thermos and opens it. She gets a whiff of good coffee.
Mmmm... Where'd you get that?
Stole it.
Really?
You'll never know.
What's the marker for?
It's about time someone signed that cast, Princess.
Ha ha! Colt, this is so great! Thank you so much...
Colt starts to draw on Denni's cast...
Please. No lewd pictures.
Then I'm putting the marker away.
What am I going to do with you?
Keep me around?
More like `keep you in line.`
As if you wanted to...
Elsewhere...
Just outside the ruins of the old school, Principal Shapiro stands, surveying all the damage on the property.
This is a terrible mess.
Uh... Excuse me.
Shapiro turns at the sound of Monte's voice.
I saw there was a car here where there shouldn't have been one. I thought I'd check it out, make sure there wasn't some hooligan messing up the place.
I appreciate it. But it's not like the school isn't `already` a mess.
You know, I spent the last thirteen years working on this campus... And it's never looked so hopeless as it does now.
Oh, Monte Carlos, what are we going to do? How are we going to get ourselves out of this hole?
Officer Monte takes Shapiro's hand and squeezes it.
One stone at a time, Kathy. One stone at a time.

Ryan, out!

Then yes!

Whew, glad that's over...
And I'm happy we found someone... I don't even know what Jessica would do to me if we didn't...
Hey, where `is` Jessica? Isn't she supposed to be in charge of stuff like this?
She said she had something really important planning to do...
But I have no idea what she's up to...
Elsewhere in the sleepy town of Centerscore...
Jessica punches keys on her computer keyboard, updating a certain website.
$ZOE thinks `she` can challenge `me` and get away with it?!
I'm going to show `her!`
She thinks she's won because I didn't kick her off the squad?!
Well, when I'm done, she's not going to have anything left!
Uh-oh! Looks like Jessica has something nasty in store for $ZOE!

Oh, Sam! Jessica's not just going to stop with you! She's going after everyone around me!
Then we're going to take her down...
No... I can't...
I know you said you just wanted her to leave you alone, but this is `way` over the line! You can't always be nice!
It's not that! If she's going after everyone I love...
She's going after Howard too!
The interview!
I have to get to him!
$ZOE runs off, leaving Sam fuming in the parking lot.
`Jessica... `
Sam finds the cheerleaders at practice and storms up to Jessica...
Sam... What are you doing here?
I thought you'd for sure be making out with your 'sweet emo cakes'...
Or maybe you'd prefer to keep telling him how 'cutely dark' he is?
Shut up... Don't remind me how much I want to punch you right now...
Why would you want to do that?
Because `you're` the one that planted `my` texts on `that` website!
That website has been around for ages! I have nothing to do with it!
And you can't prove I did anything...
Can't I?
It's not my fault you `misplaced your phone.`
So `you` admit it! You took it!
Or you can look in your `backpack...` Which is where `you` probably `left it...`
Sam checks her bag and finds the phone.
Okay, fine. So you didn't get `caught`...
But this isn't over, Jessica... I'll find proof that you did this...
And you're going to regret it!
Sam leaves the park.
She hurries to swim practice, trying to collect herself...
And that's when she spots Nick and Sara talking to one another...
Ready to hear my new plan for getting my name out there?
Sure.
`Posters.`
How two-dimensional.
Ha ha... Come on... It's just as good as your button idea...
The door behind Sam closes with a slam, causing Nick to look up.
Hey, Sam...
Nick sees Sam's face.
Why do you look upset?
`Why?` Why aren't you upset at all?
Over what?
You know what!
I do?
You don't care that everything we had together is just... Broadcast to the entire freakin' world?
What are you talking about?
Just... Just get out of here... I can't talk to you right now.
Oh... Uh, okay, I'll just go then...
Nick hurries out.
...Whoa.
Don't you start.
Hey, I have no idea what you're talking about.
You didn't get a text?
I don't really have that many friends... A text about what?
Someone put all the texts between me and Nick up on a website. It's all there... For everyone to see.
Even the stupid details... How much I like this glasses... Or his skinny jeans... Or his emo hair...
I'm sorry.
To be fair, I don't think Nick knew. He would probably be just as upset, don't you think?
I don't know...
Well, he's a sensitive guy...
Really? He doesn't seem to be `that` sensitive. I mean, he does all that research on war and stuff for his newspaper articles, doesn't he?
That's different. When it comes to personal feelings... He's the most sensitive guy I know... Or the only guy, really.
Huh... You're right... I didn't see it that way...
Well, it seems like I just ruined his day. I should apologize.
I'm sure it's not that bad... He's very willing to forgive, I think.
Thanks, Sara...
No problem!
I'll apologize right after practice...
Hey... I've got some steam to blow off... Want to race?
If you think you can keep up!
And that's it for your bonus scene!
Want to see what $ZOE and Sam do to get back at Jessica? Come back next time to find out!

Jumping back right before the Presidential interviews with Andrew...
Jessica and Ben prepare in the classroom near the auditorium, waiting for their chance to shine.
On a small TV in the corner of the room, Jessica watches Sara's interview...
But we all know the truth, Sara!
Have you stopped making out with Nick yet?
Whoa, Andrew's questions are like land mines.
Yeah... Seriously.
At least we get to see Sara's interview first. Andrew won't be able to throw you for a loop on your turn.
He wouldn't anyway. I have nothing to hide.
And it's a good thing I don't have weird rumors floating around.
Yeah, good thing.
Are you ready for your big debut on camera?
Yes. But I do want to read my notes one more time...
Okay... You do that. I'm going to check on the microphones to make sure everything's perfect.
Jessica leaves the green room and enters the auditorium.
She is just about to hop onstage when she hears voices...
You were perfect up there...
Well, I couldn't have done it without your help...
Jessica quickly ducks behind some of the chairs.
I thought they left!
Nick, I didn't think I could do this, but with you by my side, I...
As Jessica watches, she can see Sara and Nick moving closer and closer to one another...
They're going to kiss!
Quickly, Jessica pulls out her phone and snaps a picture.
And that's when Sara and Nick abruptly pull away from each other.
As they talk, Jessica looks down at her photo... The picture frames Nick and Sara poised to kiss perfectly.
This is `so` going to come in handy...
Uh-oh! Jessica has a compromising picture of Sara and Nick!
What's going to happen now? Find out next time on Surviving High School!

Let's check in with $Travis and Ryan on the day of the swim meet...
$Travis is driving down the road while Ryan throws tomatoes out the window at parked cars!
Hey, $Travis! Do you think anyone's as cool as we are?
I doubt it.
Up ahead, fumes waft up from the hood of a shiny sports car... A man is looking under the hood, his face obscured by the smoke.
Ooh! That one's fancy-looking! You ready?
I was born with this tomato in my hand!
$Travis hugs the edge of the road as Ryan leans out the window, his arm cocked back...
Suddenly, the smoke dissipates and $Travis sees the face of his idol, Tucker Garrety!
Tucker G! Hold your fire, dude!
$Travis slams on the brakes! Ryan pitches forward, and the truck comes to a screeching halt, just inches from Tucker's sports car!
What the?! Dude, I just threw the tomato at my face!
$Travis looks at Ryan... Half his face is covered in dripping tomato guts...
Heh. You look stupid.
You're about to look really stupid if you don't get us out of here!
Don't you know who that is, man?! The legend! That's Tucker Garrety!
Before Ryan can reply, $Travis bounds out of his car and over to Tucker...
You almost hit my car, kid!
Heh. I know who you are!
Oh no.
You look just as handsome as I imagined you would.
Am I about to be kidnapped?
Can I get your autograph?
Sure, just stand far away, okay, kid?
I don't have any pen or paper...
Anything that writes?
I have... Blood?
Please do not go into any further details.
Tucker goes the long way around his car and gets out a marker...
Do you have anything that can be signed at all? A picture or a magazine or something.
Nah. I don't really read much. Mostly me and my friend just work on cars...
You know about cars? Would you and your friend be interested in fixing mine?
Sure! You probably just have an overheated engine!
Whatever it is, fix it, and I'll pay you double for it...
I'd rather have something else...
Oh no... Not my vital organs or anything like that, right?
Heh...
Later, as the sun sets, $Travis floors the accelerator of Tucker's sports car as Tucker leans out the window, holding a fresh tomato!
Now what?
Throw it, man!
Tucker throws it at a nearby car... `Splat!` He pulls his head back inside...
No one is as cool as you guys!
This is the happiest day of my life!
Awww... $Travis got to hang out with his idol... And even though Tucker is pretty lame as far as idols go...
$Travis doesn't know that!

At lunch after the Presidential announcement is made...
Nick finds Sara in the makeshift cafeteria, her lunch spread around her.
Mind if I sit?
No, go ahead.
So... About the campaign... Sorry about the loss.
Me too.
At least we had some fun.
Yeah, it was good while it lasted.
But you know what? There's always next year.
Would you consider running again?
You know...
I would...
I mean, we'd have to run a different campaign... But you'd be more experienced, so it'd be much easier.
Nick...
And now we have all year to plan for it. If we start early, I can introduce you to more constituents...
Nick...
And then think about all the time we have to modify your speeches...
`Nick.`
Nick trails off. Sara puts a hand on his arm.
I thought we said we weren't going to hang out after this election.
Oh, yeah... About that...
Did Sam change her mind?
Sam, uh, broke up with me.
Sara draws her hand back in surprise.
What? Even after you explained everything? If you need me to talk to her...
No, it's not that. She believed me when I said the photos were just posted to hurt your campaign.
Then why would you break up?
Well, she only wanted to be with me if I could tell her there was no one else, and...
And?
There is. It's you.
Nick watches Sara's face for a reaction, but she looks down.
Well, I'm sorry to hear about you and Sam. I mean, you were a really good couple.
You don't want to say any more about the fact that I just confessed I like you?
Nick... I feel the same way.
You do?
But what do you think is going to happen right now? You just broke up with Sam...
And with my dad being so strict... He'd never let me date anyone...
It doesn't seem like the right time to do anything about it.
Oh, I see...
False starts don't help you win marathons, is all I'm saying.
No, I get it. I do. I've just... I've had a bad day, you know.
Well, I'm going to leave you alone...
Nick, we're still friends, right?
Yeah, of course. We're still friends.
Sara puts a hand on his shoulder.
And, you know... Maybe someday after this blows over...
But suddenly, the loud slam of a door cuts off whatever Sara was going to say.
Sara instinctively draws her hand back, just as her dad enters the cafeteria.
Sara, what are you doing? You're late for your noontime training session!
Sorry, Dad, I must have forgot... Let me just get my things!
Sara gives Nick an apologetic look and runs out.
Coach Kessler gives Nick one long hard look then exits after her.
Well, it looks like a hard day just got harder for Nick!
But hopefully things will turn out better in the end!

Taylor sits at the Center Table for the first time in months...
Are you a new student?
Hi, Amanda.
Brendan sits down next to Taylor...
Never sat here before!
Two nerds at the Center Table? Jessica, tell them how that's...
Oh, right... Never mind.
What's the matter, Nicole? Lost your buddy?
So are you guys gonna sit with us now? No more Nerd Table?
We decided it'd be good for me to have more exposure to cool people.
So we're going to alternate days! Now, you might be wondering how that works given that there are five days in the school week, an unfortunately odd number.
Brendan! What'd I tell you before we sat here?
No nerd talk at the cool table.
So...
Oh, right... Uh, any cool parties coming up?
Only the best party ever!
Uh, probably want to get a different phrase... We've used that one a lot.
Only the `hottest` party ever!
Carson and I have been planning something so awesome, it will blow your minds!
I'm immune to mind-blowing!
As Hector and Carson lay out their party plan, $ZOE can't contain her excitement...
`Head` Cheerleader! Next year is going to be amazing! I can't wait!
Yeah, amazing...
Oh, Howard... I'm sorry. I forgot that you won't be here...
What do you think we should do?
I don't know... We can't ignore the fact that you're graduating...
No, we can't.
It's going to happen.
Howard grabs $ZOE's hand and squeezes it.
Meanwhile, out in the parking lot...
All right, Princess, I can't stand it. Hit me with the bad news.
What are you talking about?
You and Tweed. Jessica broke you up. Just get it over with, and tell me what we both know is going on.
Actually, I think this is a rare case in which only you know what's going on...
Are you leaving me for Ben?
Denni punches Colt in the shoulder.
Ow! Hey!
I'm with you, Doofus.
Tell me the thought hadn't crossed your mind now that you know Jessica's responsible for what happened.
It... It did, actually.
I knew it!
Relax... I mean... There was a moment in the auditorium when we looked at each other...
That son of a...
Colt! He wasn't giving me `the look!` He was just looking at me, okay?
I don't know the difference.
I know you don't. But, listen, okay... We looked at each other, and there was nothing there.
What? Really?
Yeah, it's like... So much time has passed... Ben and I are over. He's the past. `You're` my future.
Can I still beat him up a little? For looking at you, I mean?
No! If you beat up every guy who looked at me, you'd be beating up `a lot` of guys!
Really? What are their names?
Wow. You're incorrigible.
Hey! You're a... Dirigible. Didn't think I knew that word, did you?
You got me there, baby.
And somewhere very far away... Jessica looks at the schedule of classes at her new school...
What kind of school is this? Ice fishing? Walrus identification?
Helllllooooooooo! Oh how much I enjoy your hair! Enough grease to hold a flame for many days!
Oh no...
Do you see the way we are looking? We are twins! Like seahorses galloping across oceans in search of our aqua-equine matings!
Why are you talking to me?
You are Jessica, no? The fattest whale of my former school!
Hey!
By this I mean you were the most desirable and popular...
Oh, totes! I `am` Jessica!
Astrid checks over her shoulders...
Then I have a message for you...
You want to help me rule this school?
Astrid reaches into her jacket and pulls out a steaming cup of coffee!
Wha?
She tosses it on Jessica!
`Ack!`
That is for mistreating my friends!
Looks like Taylor's finding that healthy balance between nerd and cool, $ZOE and Howard have to deal with Howard's impending graduation...
Denni and Colt are going to be fine...
But Jessica has a long, scalding hot future ahead of her!
Hope you enjoyed your bonus scene!
What will cheerleading be like with $ZOE in command? Stay tuned for the next season of Surviving High School...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Dude, did you guys read what she said about us?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I saw the picture... That's all I need to know...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: But listen...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: 'Though the tremendous loss of the earthquake was difficult to handle, many intrepid and resilient students are putting on a brave face...'

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Ha ha, awesome. See this brave face?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: You don't even know she's talking about `you.` What about me?
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't even know she's talking about [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color] What about me?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm glad they liked it...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you girls see the article in the newspaper?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All I saw was my awesome self glaring at the camera!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's perfect! Everyone's going to see my beautiful face next to the campaign article!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just liked the part where Denni wrote about what a rich range of emotions we all felt.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I just heard that I should become a model...
The girls twitter excitedly about the picture, and Nick smiles to himself.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hey, so that guy really did put us in the paper.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Pft. So? It's just a picture.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: But it's nice. And that writer girl even said we were 'good models of the ways students can contribute to the rebuilding effort, a symbol of hope for the community'.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: She said that?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I don't know if I like being a model... But it's kind of a nice thing to think about.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Well, all right...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: They seem happier...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: We loved it! The unicorn was a really nice touch!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I printed out two copies of it! One to keep in my room, and the other to keep with me at all times!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I just can't believe we're celebrities now...

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: I liked the picture less than pi but more than calculus.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: More than calculus? High praise!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I got a good look at the draft of Denni's report before she sent it off to press.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The part where she says it's important to be able to laugh during hard times directly refers to our picture.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I feel really well represented.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's great to hear!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Nick, we saw the picture you put into the article...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, how's that working out for you guys?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Our Faceplace party page has been totally spammed with people wanting to come to our party!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's going to be epic!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Hey, you should come!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'll think about it...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah! Anyway, we're out... The party planning awaits...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Of course...
They walk away, talking logistics.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'll admit, I didn't think anyone would ever catch on...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm glad you figured it out.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're not going to get away with it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Haven't you been listening? I already have! Who's going to believe `you?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Haven't you been listening? I already have! Who's going to believe [color=#3b78e2][i]you?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: After all, you're the ex Head Cheerleader who's super desperate to reclaim her power...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I'm just a fun girl!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, and BTW, now that we've covered the whole thing, can I just say...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I sound `so` cool!
nodes.text_bbcode: I sound [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] cool!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh. You're the worst...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Let's face it! I'm three steps ahead of everyone else, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're not even going to believe what I've got up my sleeves...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Anyway, say goodbye to your boyfriend when you see him 'cause you're not going to be seeing very much more of him!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Bye-bye now!
Jessica leaves. Taylor stands there in front of the mirror, her mouth open, gaping.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I can't believe it... I've got to do something!
Erik's question echoes in Taylor's head...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why should `I` run?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why should [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] run?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I `have` to stop Jessica! I `have` to be President!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to stop Jessica! I [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to be President!

nodes.text: The other cheerleaders avoid meeting her gaze and look down.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Does anyone else have anything to say?
Silence.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good! Because I have one last thing...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're off the team.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: She is just delightful!
In the classroom, the students buzz with excitement.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Whoa! I'll actually remember that commercial! Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm voting Taylor for sure!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'd improve relations with the former Spartans, increase attendance at school functions, and clean up that disgusting mold in the guy's locker room!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: That's an unexpectedly articulate and issue-driven answer!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, `some` of the other candidates might prefer to focus on dirty politics... I believe in taking the high road and focusing on ways to improve the school!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] of the other candidates might prefer to focus on dirty politics... I believe in taking the high road and focusing on ways to improve the school!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: How pleasantly surprising!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Indeed, Past Principal Shapiro! Moving on...

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: `And that's because I want to win... I want to make a difference!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]And that's because I want to win... I want to make a difference![/i]

nodes.text: The video feed ends.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ooh boy! Those were some tough questions, but she came out smelling like the sea!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey, it's that guy! President McPresidentson!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: He looks cuter on the TV screen...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I would have voted for him even if Jessica hadn't ordered us to do it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Looks like `someone` has some followers...
nodes.text_bbcode: Looks like [color=#3b78e2][i]someone[/i][/color] has some followers...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's good, right?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Colt impressed some people with his surprisingly civil debate style...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Sara did a remarkably good interview, looking cool and collected under Andrew's intense barrage of questioning...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Taylor's video managed to amaze everyone with its display of her newer, softer side...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: So even though Ben's speech went over well...
`Ell-i-a-na! Ell-i-a-na! Ell-i-a-na!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Ell-i-a-na! Ell-i-a-na! Ell-i-a-na![/b]

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: There you have it! The winner of the match is `Elliana!` Wilson High wins the Wilson Tournament once again!
nodes.text_bbcode: There you have it! The winner of the match is [color=#e23b3b][i]Elliana![/i][/color] Wilson High wins the Wilson Tournament once again!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! I am better than a machine! That means I am a goddess!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I guess I lost...
All Sara can see is disappointment on the faces of those she cares about...
Even on the face of Nick...
As she scans the crowd for some sign of support her eyes settle on the beaming face of Jessica...
Sara dunks her head back under the water, hoping that when she resurfaces it'll all be different...
But deep down she knows... When she comes back up, nothing will change...
Sara has failed.
`Luckily,` you get another chance! See if you can help Sara keep her head above water, beat Elliana, and unlock the Good Ending!

nodes.text: But as soon as he comes close, Sara's nose crinkles.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What `is` that smell?
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] that smell?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's, uh... It's probably milk...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sticky... Weird... Brown milk... I really hope it was milk...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sorry, I... I've also had a rough morning.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm just going to stand over here.
Nick takes a step backwards.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Speaking of which... Enough time's probably passed. I should go talk to her.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Good luck!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Listen, $ZOE! You may think everything's all shiny and perfect in your life, but it isn't!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let me know how it feels when your boyfriend's off at college, applying sunscreen to girls hotter than me who `don't` have a curfew!
nodes.text_bbcode: Let me know how it feels when your boyfriend's off at college, applying sunscreen to girls hotter than me who [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] have a curfew!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And if you keep giving me attitude the way you've been giving me, I will move you to the bottom of the cheer pyramid! Like! That!
Taylor snaps her fingers defiantly.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh... Cheer pyramid? You're `not` the Head Cheerleader anymore Taylor...
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Cheer pyramid? You're [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] the Head Cheerleader anymore Taylor...

nodes.text: Suddenly, Taylor perks up...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! I know how to get evidence on Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE, $ZOE, $ZOE! You sly little minx! You tricked me, didn't you?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Here I was, all mad at you and the whole time you were trying to get me to think how I used to! That was so clever!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It reminds me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor! Enough! How do we get Jessica?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: If you didn't interrupt her, I would have...
